Result: 直接语言化置信度表现意外强劲：审计基准错误后正确性预测AUROC达0.956与0.937。三样本一致性显著更弱（0.765与0.790），与语言化置信度做固定插值无统计上可靠收益。一模型9个错误中4个、另一模型8个错误中2个获得全体样本一致支持，说明自一致性可能放大共享误解。对同一固定答案用等价提示重新诱导置信度，平均变化0.043–0.084，在0.8阈值下翻转4%–9%的判定。传记断言审计仅发现被支持与被反驳断言间存在温和的置信度差距。

Conclusion: 有用的自我报告仍受诱导方式、错误相关性和基准噪声影响；语言化置信度是较强但脆弱的信号，不能简单视为可靠的校准度量，自一致性也非可靠的错误检测手段。

Abstract: Large language models can report a numerical confidence together with generated content, but it is unclear whether this report is more than calibrated rhetoric. We analyze three training-free signals: confidence verbalized with the answer, post-hoc $P(\mathrm{True})$, and agreement with three additional generations on the same 100 TriviaQA questions for two model families. Direct verbalization is a surprisingly strong baseline: after auditing benchmark errors, it reaches AUROC 0.956 and 0.937 for correctness prediction. Three-sample agreement is substantially weaker (0.765 and 0.790), and a fixed interpolation with verbalized confidence has no statistically reliable benefit. Four of nine errors from one model and two of eight from the other receive unanimous sample support, showing that self-consistency can amplify shared misconceptions. Re-eliciting confidence for the same fixed answers with equivalent prompts changes scores by 0.043 to 0.084 on average and flips 4\% to 9\% of decisions at a 0.8 threshold. An exploratory audit of 100 confidence-tagged biography claims further finds only a modest confidence gap between supported and contradicted claims. These results argue that useful self-reports remain sensitive to elicitation, correlated errors, and benchmark noise.

</details>


### [159] [Steering the Compass: Aligning Dynamic Psychological Counseling Conversations with Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20565)
*Zimu Wang,Yiwen Jiang,Xiangyu Zhao,Yaling Shen,Jiahe Liu,Stephanie Fong,Maxmartwell H Cheng,Guilherme C Oliveira,Anh Nguyen,Robert Desimone,Barnaby Nelson,Dominic Dwyer,Zongyuan Ge*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出StratCBT数据集，用于认知行为疗法（CBT）心理咨询对话，包含9,688个会话、约256K条话语，每条咨询师回复对应八种CBT策略之一，旨在支持基于来访者实时心理状态的动态决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CBT的成功高度依赖依据来访者实时心理状态进行的动态决策，但现有研究常忽视这一方面，限制了咨询灵活性与治疗效果。现有数据集缺乏策略标注与真实咨询技能覆盖。

Method: 构建StratCBT数据集：基于来访者负性思维建模客户，通过self-chat生成高质量咨询对话，并引入真实会话作为引导；每条咨询师回复对齐八种CBT策略之一。

Result: 数据集规模为9,688个会话、约256K条话语，在通用咨询与CBT专项技能上显著超越现有数据集；实验证明策略对齐生成的有效性，并借助LLM模拟来访者评估其专业性与疗效。

Conclusion: StratCBT为CBT心理咨询提供策略级标注数据，验证了策略对齐生成在提升LLM咨询专业性与效果方面的潜力，数据已开源。

Abstract: Recent advancements in large language models have revolutionized the field of psychological counseling, especially in the context of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). While the success of CBT relies heavily on dynamic decision-making informed by the client's real-time mental state, this aspect has often been overlooked in current research, limiting both flexibility and therapeutic outcomes. In this paper, we introduce StratCBT, a dataset specifically designed for psychological counseling conversations with CBT Strategies, consisting of 9,688 sessions and around 256K utterances, with each counselor's response aligned with one of eight distinct strategies. The creation of StratCBT involves modeling clients based on their negative thoughts and generating high-quality counseling conversations through self-chat, incorporating realistic sessions as guidance, thereby significantly surpassing existing datasets in both general counseling and CBT-specific skills. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of strategy-aligned generation and evaluate its efficacy in delivering professional and effective counseling with LLM-simulated clients to reflect real-world scenarios. The dataset can be obtained from https://github.com/zimuwangnlp/StratCBT.

</details>


### [160] [SAFARI: An Industrial Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20584)
*Chenxi Wu,Zimu Wang,Haiyang Zhang,Wei Wang,Zhijie Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SAFARI——首个面向ISO 26262汽车HARA任务的工业级LLM基准，含3000条脱敏工业案例，覆盖开放式危害分析与标准化风险评估两个耦合任务，并提出首个参考锚定的LLM-as-a-judge评测协议。实验表明前沿LLM能生成貌似合理的危害叙述，但在ASIL风险分类上表现薄弱（最佳macro-F1仅0.261）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型日益被考虑用于安全关键工程，但其在受监管的功能安全流程（如ISO 26262）中的可靠性仍缺乏充分探索，缺少贴近工业实际的评测基准与评测方法。

Method: 构建SAFARI基准，包含3000条脱敏工业HARA案例，定义开放式危害分析与标准化风险评估两项耦合任务；提出首个参考锚定（reference-anchored）的LLM-as-a-judge协议，并验证其与专家评分的高相关性；对九个前沿LLM开展实验，考察Chain-of-Thought提示的影响并做错误分析。

Result: 模型常能产出看似合理的危害叙述，但在ISO 26262风险分类上普遍偏弱，最佳ASIL macro-F1仅0.261；Chain-of-Thought提示收益有限，且常导致类别型风险评估性能下降；错误分析将主要失败归因于危害生成阶段的场景关键上下文遗漏，以及风险评估阶段的可控性误判。

Conclusion: 当前LLM尚不足以独立胜任ISO 26262 HARA中的风险分级任务，需专家重点监督危害生成中的上下文完整性与风险评估中的可控性判断；SAFARI为后续研究与模型改进提供了工业级评测基础。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for safety-critical engineering, yet their reliability in regulated functional-safety workflows remains underexplored. We introduce SAFARI (Safety-Aware Functional Automotive Risk Inference), the first industrial benchmark for LLM-assisted automotive Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) under ISO 26262. It contains 3,000 de-identified industrial HARA cases and evaluates two coupled tasks: open-ended hazard analysis and standards-grounded risk assessment. To evaluate open-ended HARA artifacts, we propose the first reference-anchored LLM-as-a-judge protocol with high expert correlation. Experiments with nine frontier LLMs show that models often produce plausible hazard narratives but remain weak at ISO 26262 risk classification, with the best ASIL macro-F1 reaching only 0.261. Chain-of-Thought prompting provides limited benefit and often degrades categorical risk assessment. Error analysis further localizes major failures to scenario-critical context omissions during hazard generation and to controllability misjudgments during risk assessment, indicating where expert oversight should be concentrated. The dataset can be obtained from https://github.com/xixi47520-hash/HARA.

</details>


### [161] [WiC is Not WSD: A Study on LLMs and Lexical Ambiguity Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20593)
*Yi Zhou,Kiamehr Rezaee,Danushka Bollegala,Mohammad Taher Pilehvar,Jose Camacho-Collados*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究上下文词义理解（WiC）任务对语言模型的困难来源，提出缺少显式义项清单（sense inventory）是关键因素，并通过实验证明提供候选义项能提升开放LLM的WiC表现，同时指出许多所谓错误实为标签歧义或义项粒度不匹配所致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WiC任务在语言模型上仍然极具挑战，尽管词汇语义任务已有进展。作者假设困难不仅源于比较同一词的两个上下文用法，还源于缺少显式义项清单来界定合理的语义粒度层次。

Method: 在相似设置下评估开放大语言模型（open LLMs）在WiC和传统词义消歧（WSD）上的表现；为模型提供候选义项，如同传统WSD做法，并比较不同设置下的效果；结合人工评估分析模型判定与标注者义项边界之间的关系。

Result: 在所有设置中，提供候选义项均能提升WiC性能；显式义项信息帮助模型做出更一致、更有针对性的判断；人工评估显示许多表面上的WiC错误反映的是标签歧义或模型与标注者义项边界不匹配，而非词汇理解的简单失败；LLMs常对词义区别"过度思考"，导致基于过细粒度区分而产生错误。

Conclusion: 显式义项信息是改善WiC表现的重要因素，WiC的困难部分来自语义粒度与义项边界的不确定性；应重新审视WiC评测中错误归因，模型错误常源于过细的义项区分而非理解失败。

Abstract: Word-in-Context (WiC) remains challenging for language models, despite recent progress on lexical-semantic tasks. We hypothesise that this difficulty arises not only from comparing two contextual uses of a word, but also from the absence of an explicit sense inventory that specifies the relevant level of semantic granularity. We evaluate open LLMs on WiC and traditional Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) under similar settings. We find that providing candidate senses, similar to what is done in traditional WSD, improves WiC performance in all settings. In general, explicit sense information helps models make more consistent and targeted judgements. Human evaluation further shows that many apparent WiC errors reflect label ambiguity or mismatches between model and annotator sense boundaries rather than simple failures of lexical understanding. In particular, results show that LLMs overthink the sense distinction often leading to errors based on overly fine-grained distinctions.

</details>


### [162] [What Does Privileged Information Add to On-Policy Self-Distillation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20612)
*XiuYu Zhang,Wei Chow,Junfeng Fang,Zhenkai Liang,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建 AMPLE-Math 数据集，分离并量化了 on-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）中"参考信息"与"蒸馏本身"的贡献，发现 OPSD 主要提升跨推理模式的已有能力调用，参考解的价值在于促进这种跨模式迁移，而非其揭示的解题步骤多少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD 中教师模型可看到答案或解题过程，直观上能给学生更多学习信号，但其中"额外参考信息"相对于"蒸馏本身"的独立贡献尚不清晰，需要可控实验来隔离。

Method: 构建 AMPLE-Math（5,319 道数学题，每题六种共享同一答案的推理视图），将每种视图与匹配的无参考蒸馏对比；以 thinking-enabled 教师监督 direct-response 学生 rollout；在 Qwen3-1.7B 与 SmolLM3-3B 上比较，并进行教师画像与匹配损失干预分析。

Result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上，无参考蒸馏已解释大部分提升（域内及外部基准）；额外参考收益有限，仅精炼解题过程最强。SmolLM3-3B 在第 50 步时完整 trace 带来约 2 个百分点增益。收益依学生训练方式而定：在相同 checkpoint 下，用长 thinking rollout 替代短 direct-response rollout，在问题、参考与评测不变时收益转为损失。教师画像与匹配损失干预显示，改变 token 级监督可基本不改变学生行为。

Conclusion: OPSD 通过 direct-response 与 thinking-enabled 推理共享的参数改善对已有推理能力的调用；privileged reference 的价值在于促进这种跨模式迁移，而非揭示多少解题内容。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) lets a language model learn from a frozen copy of itself that sees an answer or a worked solution. Giving the teacher this extra information seems to offer the student more to learn, but how much does it add beyond distillation itself? To isolate that contribution, we construct AMPLE-Math, a reusable suite of 5,319 mathematical problems with six reasoning views that share the same answer, and compare each view with matched reference-free distillation. With a thinking-enabled teacher supervising direct-response rollouts, reference-free distillation accounts for much of Qwen3-1.7B's improvement under thinking-enabled evaluation, both in domain and on external benchmarks. Evidence for an additional reference benefit is modest in Qwen, strongest for a polished solution, whereas complete traces add two percentage points in SmolLM3-3B at step 50. These benefits depend on the student being trained. At the same checkpoint, replacing short direct-response rollouts with long thinking-enabled rollouts turns gains into losses in both families while the problems, references, and evaluation stay fixed. Teacher profiles and matched loss interventions in Qwen further show that changing token-level supervision can leave student behavior largely unchanged. Together, these findings suggest that OPSD can improve access to existing reasoning capabilities through parameters shared by direct-response and thinking-enabled inference. The value of a privileged reference is what it adds to this cross-mode transfer, not how much of the solution it reveals.

</details>


### [163] [Chronicle: Cut-Point Replay for Regression Testing of LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20625)
*Tisha Chawla,Susheem Koul*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Chronicle 将 LLM agent 运行在非确定性边界记录为不可变信封，并提出 cut-point replay：选择性重放部分边界、其余用新代码实时执行，从而把历史故障转化为可在 CI 中运行的回归测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent 的失败难以复现：推理非逐位确定、工具读取变化状态、多步轨迹重跑难以重复。现有工具只记录运行用于追踪或打分，无法用于针对代码变更的回归测试。

Method: Chronicle 在 agent 运行的非确定性边界处记录为不可变信封（immutable envelopes），并可从记录重放。核心操作 cut-point replay：选定边界子集从记录中供给，互补子集用新代码实时执行。

Result: 在含 6 个记录故障、模型边界模拟的基准上：记录每次跨界仅增加 23 μs（按 300 ms 模型调用计为 0.008%）；完整重放零模型调用，20 次重复逐位稳定；cut-point 测试对所有 6 个故障在错误代码上失败、在受保护及良性变更上通过。对受保护工具的变异研究中，cut-point 测试能捕获所有使记录中不安全动作通过的变异体，而用相同断言对每个边界打桩的基线一个也捕获不到。

Conclusion: Chronicle 通过边界级记录与 cut-point replay，使 LLM agent 的历史故障可作为稳定的 CI 回归测试，开销极低且检出能力显著优于全打桩基线；Chronicle 与基准已开源。

Abstract: Large language model responses are non-deterministic, so failures in LLM agents are hard to reproduce: a failure depends on inference that is not bitwise reproducible, on tools that read changing state, and on a multi-step trajectory that a re-run rarely repeats. Record-and-replay makes a run reproducible, but existing agent tooling records runs only to trace or score them, not to test a code change against them. We present Chronicle, which records an agent run at its non-deterministic boundaries as immutable envelopes and replays it from the record. Its central operation, cut-point replay, serves a chosen subset of boundaries from the record and executes the complementary subset live with new code, turning a recorded incident into a regression test that runs in continuous integration. On a benchmark of 6 recorded failures with simulated model boundaries, recording adds 23 μs per crossing (0.008% of an assumed 300 ms model call), full replay issues zero model calls and is bit-stable across 20 repetitions, and cut-point tests fail on faulty code and pass on guarded and benign changes for all 6 incidents. In a mutation study of the guarded tools, cut-point tests catch every mutant that lets the recorded unsafe action through, while a baseline that stubs every boundary, using the same assertion, catches none. Chronicle and the benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/theagentplane/chronicle.

</details>


### [164] [UniPolicy: Unified Objective-Specific Policies for Generative Search Advertising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20630)
*Kun Yao,Yuhang Zhou,Yichi Zhang,Zeliang Tong,Shengri Xue,Haitao Wang,Siyu Lu,Qianlong Xie,Xingxing Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: UniPolicy是一个面向搜索广告的目标感知多策略对齐框架，通过参数分层解耦与多目标偏好构建，在离线与在线实验中实现多指标均衡提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有搜索广告系统通常仅将预训练生成模型对齐到单一业务奖励（如eCPM），或采用朴素奖励融合做初步多目标对齐，难以同时兼顾相关性、点击倾向与商业价值等异构目标，且梯度竞争会导致全局次优。

Method: 提出UniPolicy：结合目标专属前缀token、稀疏MoE-LoRA路由和目标专属残差FFN，在共享主干内分层解耦参数，为不同业务目标提供差异化参数与策略表达空间；从多阶段行为反馈构建成对偏好，补充"曝光未点击"样本的相对偏好信息并强化被点击候选的相对优势；推理时支持并行、业务可定制的多策略束搜索，在固定召回预算下灵活分配各目标的候选配额。

Result: 大规模离线实验显示，UniPolicy在保持召回质量的同时于多项指标上取得均衡提升，优于单目标强化学习与朴素奖励融合基线；在真实搜索广告系统为期7天的在线A/B测试中，CTR提升0.71%，RPS提升1.58%，广告收入提升1.32%，且服务延迟保持稳定。

Conclusion: UniPolicy通过目标感知的多策略参数解耦与多目标偏好对齐，有效缓解梯度竞争，实现用户体验与商业价值的多目标平衡，并具备线上可部署性与低延迟特性。

Abstract: Search advertising connects user intent with commercial content and plays a critical role in platform monetization. Recent systems typically align pretrained generative models with a single business reward, such as eCPM, or use naive reward fusion for preliminary multi-objective alignment. However, an ideal search advertising system must jointly account for heterogeneous objectives, including relevance, click propensity, and commercial value, to balance user experience and business value while mitigating globally suboptimal performance caused by gradient competition. We propose UniPolicy, an objective-aware multi-policy alignment framework. UniPolicy combines objective-specific prefix tokens, sparse MoE-LoRA routing, and objective-specific residual FFNs to hierarchically decouple parameters within a shared backbone, providing differentiated parameter and policy-expression spaces for different business objectives. It further constructs pairwise preferences from multi-stage behavioral feedback, supplementing the relative preference information in exposed-but-unclicked samples and strengthening the relative advantage of clicked candidates in the generation distribution. At inference, UniPolicy supports parallel, business-customizable multi-policy beam search, flexibly allocating candidate quotas across objectives under a fixed retrieval budget. Large-scale offline experiments show that UniPolicy delivers balanced improvements across multiple metrics while preserving retrieval quality, outperforming single-objective reinforcement learning and naive reward-fusion baselines. In a 7-day online A/B test on a real search advertising system, UniPolicy improves CTR by 0.71%, RPS by 1.58%, and advertising revenue by 1.32%, while maintaining stable serving latency.

</details>


### [165] [HerHealthEval: Evaluating Multilingual and Register-Sensitive Understanding of Women's Health Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20684)
*Hassan Saeed Hassan Albattra,Mazen Mohammed Bahgat,Rahatara Ferdousi,Hana Essam Sayed Ahmed Amrya,Mariam Mousa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出HerHealthEval评估框架，用于检验大语言模型对女性健康沟通的多语言理解能力，揭示聚合准确率与一致性会掩盖安全相关的失败（如漏诊分诊）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医疗场景下大语言模型评估多聚焦回复质量，默认模型已正确理解用户诉求，忽视了跨语言、跨语体表达差异及澄清需求的识别，可能掩盖安全隐患。

Method: 构建HerHealthEval受控评估框架：每个临床病例提供英语、法语、现代标准阿拉伯语三语匹配版本，覆盖六种沟通形式（规范、临床、外行、间接/模糊、情绪担忧、刻意信息不足）；前五种保持相同临床信息，末种刻意省略细节以测试澄清行为。在多语言指令模型及QLoRA适配变体上评估诉求分类、风险校准、澄清行为、解析合规性与跨形式一致性。

Result: 聚合准确率与一致性掩盖了安全相关失败：在语言不对称风险监督下，多语言适配模型在法语和阿拉伯语的下分诊率高达0.994；改用源语派生、语言不变的风险标签进行受控再适配后，下分诊率分别降至0.572和0.558。

Conclusion: 稳健的多语言医疗评估需显式测试语体变异、不确定性处理，以及适配标签的来源与不变性，避免以总体指标掩盖安全风险。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in healthcare communication, yet most evaluations emphasize response quality while assuming that the user's concern has been interpreted correctly. We introduce HerHealthEval, a controlled evaluation framework for multilingual understanding of women's-health communication. For each clinical case, HerHealthEval provides matched versions in English, French, and Modern Standard Arabic using six communicative forms: canonical, clinical, layperson, indirect or hedged, emotionally concerned, and deliberately under-specified. The first five express the same underlying concern and retain the same clinical information, whereas the under-specified form intentionally omits relevant details to test whether the model recognizes that clarification is needed. We evaluate a multilingual instruction model and QLoRA-adapted variants on concern classification, risk calibration, clarification behavior, parse compliance, and cross-form consistency. Results reveal that aggregate accuracy and consistency can conceal safety-relevant failures. A multilingual adaptation model reaches 0.994 under-triage in French and Arabic under language-asymmetric risk supervision. A controlled re-adaptation using source-derived, language-invariant risk labels reduces under-triage to 0.572 and 0.558, respectively. These findings show that robust multilingual healthcare evaluation requires explicit testing of register variation, uncertainty handling, and the provenance and invariance of adaptation labels.

</details>


### [166] [Summarization Bias: The Directional Collapse of Objective Projection into Told-Mode Labels in Large Language Models --- A Conceptual Framework and Registered Test Protocol](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20712)
*Levent Bulut*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"摘要化偏见"这一构念，指LLM倾向将叙事意义表示为抽象标签而非可重建的推理结构；并将其划分为生成与评价两种机制，重新解读既有可靠性研究作为方向性证据，同时预注册双机制检验与证伪规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益充当评判者与奖励模型，若其存在方向性偏见，将形成选择压力，使文本退化为平铺直叙的"告知"模式。作者希望在此风险显性化之前，定义并检验该偏见。

Method: 概念建构+理论定位+证据重读+预注册。基于Bulut Doctrine的"告知—展示"轴（展示模式通过客观投射以物理线索间接重建，为高负荷条件）；提出两机制假设：(i)生成机制——被要求以客观投射呈现情感时默认直接声明；(ii)评价机制——评判文本质量时奖励告知式显性、低估展示式抑制。随后将一项已完成的独立可靠性研究重新解读为与该偏见一致的方向性证据，并预注册双机制检验及放弃该构念的决策规则。

Result: 本文未提供偏见已被验证的结论。仅完成构念定义、与LLM-as-judge类偏见的对照定位，以及对既有独立研究的重新解读，作为方向性（非确证性）证据；实证检验尚待预注册方案执行。

Conclusion: 摘要化偏见是待检验的构念而非既定结论；其最具后果的是评价机制，因为它可能通过奖励模型施加选择压力、削弱散文质量。作者以两机制测试与明确证伪规则来约束该主张。

Abstract: This paper introduces and operationalizes summarization bias: a proposed systematic tendency of large language models (LLMs) to represent narrative meaning as an abstract summary label rather than as the reconstructable inferential structure that produces it. Within the Bulut Doctrine, narrative effect is theorized along a told-shown axis: in told mode, emotional and informational content is declared explicitly and requires little reader reconstruction; in shown mode, that content is suppressed at the surface and must be reconstructed from physical cues and indirection (Objective Projection). Shown mode is the higher-load condition the doctrine is designed to measure.
  The claim is that LLMs fail along this axis in a specific direction. Summarization bias is hypothesized to operate in two regimes: (i) a generative regime, in which a model asked to render an emotion through Objective Projection defaults to declaring it instead; and (ii) an evaluative regime, in which a model judging narrative quality rewards told-mode explicitness and under-detects shown-mode suppression. The evaluative regime is the more consequential, since LLMs increasingly serve as judges and reward models, and a directional bias toward told mode would impose a selection pressure degrading prose toward flat declaration.
  This report does not claim the bias is validated. It defines the construct, situates it against LLM-as-judge biases, rereads a completed independent reliability study as directional evidence consistent with it, and pre-registers a two-regime test with decision rules under which the construct would be abandoned.

</details>


### [167] [On-Demand Attention: Language Models Know When to Recall](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20734)
*Haibo Feng,Ruiqi Liang,Hanyang Peng,Shiqi Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 On-Demand Attention (ODA)，一种local-first解码方法，利用轻量级recall head依据预测收益动态触发global attention，仅训练recall head，并在vLLM中实现GPU侧条件执行，在长上下文中实现加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中，full-attention解码每步都读取不断增长的历史，而不论其对下一步预测是否有益，造成计算与访存浪费。作者发现预训练模型的解码状态在全局读取前就已包含预测该收益的信息，因此希望以此为依据按需访问历史。

Method: 提出ODA：local-first解码，用轻量recall head预测global attention的收益并选择性调用；仅训练recall head，冻结预训练权重，保留完整历史KV cache以供未来recall；在vLLM中实现GPU侧条件执行，将减少的global reads转化为实际解码加速。

Result: 在Qwen与Gemma模型（含hybrid-attention骨干）上的实验表明，selective recall可恢复local attention下损失的大部分性能，同时显著减少global reads，并在长上下文长度上相对full attention取得实际解码加速。

Conclusion: 结果表明，预训练模型能够引导自身对所保留信息的访问，为高效长上下文推理提供了可行路径：在保持性能的同时大幅降低全局读取开销。

Abstract: Reasoning and agentic workloads increasingly demand efficient long-context inference. Yet full-attention decoding reads the growing history at every step, regardless of its benefit to the next prediction. We show that a pretrained model's decoding states already contain information predictive of this benefit, before the global read. Building on this finding, we introduce On-Demand Attention (ODA), a local-first decoding method that uses a lightweight recall head to selectively invoke global attention as its predicted benefit changes during generation. ODA trains only the recall head, leaving pretrained weights unchanged and the complete historical KV cache available for future recall. We further implement GPU-side conditional execution in vLLM, translating reduced global reads into practical decoding speedups over full attention at long context lengths. Experiments across Qwen and Gemma models, including hybrid-attention backbones, show that selective recall recovers most of the performance lost under local attention while substantially reducing global reads. These findings support long-context inference in which pretrained models guide their own access to the information they retain.

</details>


### [168] [dQwen3.5: Hybrid-Attention Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20751)
*Anton Xue,Litu Rout,Aditya Akella,Adam Klivans,Sujay Sanghavi,Sanjay Shakkottai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究将混合架构自回归模型（Qwen3.5，0.8B/2B/4B/9B）适配为扩散语言模型，得到 dQwen3.5 系列，证明混合骨干是高效且有效的适配起点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散语言模型的适配几乎都基于全注意力 Transformer，而自回归建模已转向注意力与 RNN 层交错的混合架构。由于 RNN 结构上具有因果性、难以双向化，这种架构差异为适配带来障碍，本文旨在探究混合骨干能否成为有效的扩散语言模型。

Method: 在 0.8B、2B、4B、9B 四个规模上对 Qwen3.5 进行适配，构建 dQwen3.5 家族，并与全注意力对照模型进行对比实验，考察训练效率与解码行为。

Result: 与全注意力对照相比，混合骨干达到相同训练损失仅需约一半的 token 量；在不同规模上，dQwen3.5 的任意顺序解码行为与全注意力扩散语言模型相似，并在并行解码下表现强劲。

Conclusion: 混合（注意力+RNN）骨干可以作为扩散语言模型适配的高效起点，其解码行为与性能和全注意力扩散语言模型相当。

Abstract: Adapting a pretrained autoregressive (AR) model is a cost-efficient route to a diffusion language model (DLM). While nearly all such adaptations start from a full-attention transformer, AR modeling has shifted toward hybrid architectures that interleave attention and RNN layers. This creates an obstacle for adaptation: unlike attention, RNNs are structurally causal and nontrivial to bidirectionalize. Despite this mismatch, we investigate whether such backbones can become effective DLMs by adapting Qwen3.5 at 0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 9B scales, yielding the dQwen3.5 family. We find that hybrid backbones can be efficient starting points for adaptation: against a full-attention control, the hybrid reaches a given training loss in about half the tokens. Across scales, dQwen3.5 resembles full-attention DLMs in any-order decoding behavior and performs strongly under parallel decoding.

</details>


### [169] [Harm Laundering in GPT Models: Evidence That Gender Discrimination Is Transformed Rather Than Reduced Across Safety-Trained Generations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20779)
*Sarah Wyer,Sue Black,Noura Al Moubayed*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"伤害洗白"（harm laundering）概念：显性歧视内容在大语言模型迭代中并非被消除，而是被转化为表层分类器无法识别的形式。通过分析45万条性别定向补全，作者证明毒性评分下降与表征伤害上升同时发生，并提出三准则检验与三阶段检测协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型安全评估依赖表层文本分类器（如毒性打分），报告跨模型代际的伤害分数持续下降，给人以安全改进的印象。作者怀疑该方法存在系统性盲区：内容并非被移除而是被转化，因此需要一个更细粒度的、能捕捉表征层面伤害的评估框架。

Method: 分析OpenAI GPT谱系15个模型（GPT-2至GPT-5）在三种人口统计条件下的45万条性别定向补全；采用主题聚类识别内容分布变化，并结合三类独立分类器（含毒性评分Detoxify、表征伤害评分REGARD）和情感分析；通过主题多样性比率（W/M）与发布日期做相关性检验；最后形式化"伤害洗白"的三准则检验并设计三阶段检测协议。

Result: GPT-2中妇女定向输出普遍存在的性暴力聚类在GPT-4中消失；男性定向补全获得照护、情感表达、盟友身份等正向表征区域，而妇女定向补全未获得；GPT-5最明显，Topic 5（1,997篇）将乳腺癌框定为男性权利议题，妇女定向输出中无对应聚类，且三种独立分类器均判其为非毒性。情感分数在GPT-4发生反转：早期模型贬低女性，后期模型过度矫正。妇女定向补全的主题多样性相对男性在GPT-4对齐边界下降36%（W/M从GPT-2的0.91降至0.58）。REGARD表征伤害差异与发布日期相关（ρ=+0.55，p=.034），而Detoxify不相关（ρ=-0.23，p=.42）——毒性分数下降的同时表征伤害上升。

Conclusion: 在OpenAI GPT谱系内，毒性评分下降不足以作为伤害减少的代理指标；"伤害洗白"揭示了显性偏见被转化为隐性表征失衡的系统性机制。作者提出的三准则检验与三阶段检测协议可推广至任意生成模型，主张安全评估应纳入表征层面的度量。

Abstract: Safety evaluations for large language models rely on surface-form classifiers that report declining harm scores across model generations. We provide evidence that this methodology is systematically incomplete: explicit discriminatory content is transformed rather than removed. We call this \emph{harm laundering}. Analysing 450,000 gender-directed completions across 15 models spanning GPT-2 through to GPT-5 (OpenAI GPT lineage; three demographic conditions), we show that sexual violence clusters prevalent in GPT-2 women-directed output disappear by GPT-4, while men-directed completions gain positive representational territory (caregiving, emotional range, ally identity) that women-directed completions do not. The pattern is most visible at GPT-5: Topic~5 (1,997~documents) frames breast cancer as a men's rights debate, while zero equivalent clusters appear in women-directed output. Three independent classifiers score this content as non-toxic. Sentiment scores invert at GPT-4: early models demean women; later models over-correct. Topic diversity in women-directed completions falls 36\% relative to men at the GPT-4 alignment boundary (W/M~$= 0.58$, from $0.91$ at GPT-2). REGARD representational harm disparity correlates with release date ($ρ= +0.55$, $p = .034$) while Detoxify does not ($ρ= -0.23$, $p = .42$): toxicity scores fall as representational harm grows. We formalise harm laundering as a three-criteria test and provide a three-stage detection protocol applicable to any generative model. Within the OpenAI GPT lineage, toxicity score reduction is not a sufficient proxy for harm reduction.

</details>


### [170] [RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20784)
*Yan Yu,Zhengxi Lu,Yizhou Liu,Yichen Pan,Aozhe Wang,Qipeng Chen,Hua Yang,Wenqi Zhang,Weiming Lu,Qianglong Chen,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 RetireOPD（自退场同策略蒸馏）：先用环境奖励训练一个解耦的技能条件教师，再让无技能学生联合使用 RL 与 OPD 训练；学生基于自适应退场机制（当师生差距不再缩小且成功率达到教师目标比例时）自行停止蒸馏，仅保留 RL。在 Qwen2.5 1.5B–7B 上，ALFWorld 成功率较 RL 基线提升 14.1%–18.8%，WebShop 准确率提升 11.8%–19.0%，并在所有设置下超越其技能条件教师。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮智能体用 RL 训练时每条轨迹仅有一个标量奖励，监督稀疏；现有自同策略蒸馏（OPD）试图用具备特权任务技能的自教师提供 token 级密集监督，让无技能学生内化这些技能。但在智能体任务中存在两个问题：一是仅有特权信息并不总能使教师可靠，二是教师监督的收益具有阶段依赖性。因此需要一种能够判断教师可靠性与监督时机的蒸馏方案。

Method: RetireOPD 分两阶段：先以环境奖励优化一个解耦的、技能条件化的教师；再联合 RL 与 OPD 训练无技能学生。不采用预定义蒸馏日程，而是使用自适应退场（Adaptive Retirement）：当师生差异不再缩小，且学生达到教师成功率的某个目标比例时，学生自行放弃教师，之后仅用 RL 继续训练。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5 1.5B 至 7B 模型上，RetireOPD 相对 RL 基线在 ALFWorld 成功率上提升 14.1%–18.8%，在 WebShop 准确率上提升 11.8%–19.0%，并在所有设置下超过其自身的技能条件教师。

Conclusion: 教师监督并非越久越好，其价值具有阶段性；通过解耦的技能条件教师与基于师生差距和成功率阈值的自适应退场机制，可以在恰当阶段提供密集监督并及时撤除，从而让学生稳定超越教师与 RL 基线。

Abstract: Multi-turn agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) receive a single scalar reward per trajectory, which motivates self on-policy distillation (OPD) to supply dense token-level supervision from a self-teacher with privileged task skills, letting a skill-free student internalize them. This recipe, however, is undermined by two findings in agentic tasks: privileged information alone does not always make a teacher reliable, and the benefit of teacher supervision is stage-dependent. We therefore propose RetireOPD (Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation), which first optimizes a decoupled, skill-conditioned teacher with environment rewards and then trains a skill-free student jointly with RL and OPD. Rather than following a predefined distillation schedule, RetireOPD adopts Adaptive Retirement: the student drops the teacher on its own once their discrepancy stops shrinking and it reaches a target fraction of the teacher's success rate, after which training proceeds with RL alone. Across Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 7B, RetireOPD improves ALFWorld success rate over RL baseline by 14.1% to 18.8% and WebShop accuracy by 11.8% to 19.0%, and surpasses its own skill-conditioned teacher in every setting.

</details>


### [171] [JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20800)
*Taoyong Cui,Zhongyao Wang,Xinyue Xu,Weiyang Liu,Zhaochen Yu,Yuying Zhang,Qiang Gao,Mengyue Yang,Wanli Ouyang,Pheng Ann Heng,Yingcheng Wu,Zhenfei Yin,Ling Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出领域无关的世界建模框架 JEPA-Anything，基于正交预测因子分解（OPF），在七个领域验证其预测、泛化与干预能力，并获得实验与科学规律验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测模型普遍局限于单一领域，缺少能跨迥异系统通用的世界建模学习原则；研究旨在探索是否存在一种共通的因子化预测原理，支撑跨领域的世界建模、干预指导与科学发现。

Method: 提出 JEPA-Anything，扩展联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），核心为正交预测因子分解（OPF）：将潜在目标分解为互补因子，经专门通路学习，并在共享预测设计中重组。评估覆盖视觉、生物、临床轨迹、控制、分子动力学、物理场和天气七个领域，任务包括表示学习、干预预测、分布外泛化和长时程动力学。

Result: 相比匹配的 JEPA 基线，在全部 10 个动力学任务上提升报告指标，Interventional Pong 单次干预预测误差降低 34.8%；在四个分子系统中取得最低的一步与 100 步分子误差（含 100 步 rollout）。因子提名的一个生物干预在细胞共培养、患者来源类器官、肿瘤碎片和小鼠中获得实验支持；潜在轨道模式以拟合斜率 −1.4991 复现开普勒标度指数。

Conclusion: 结果表明存在一种跨异构世界的共通因子化预测原理，将世界建模与干预、实验支撑的科学发现相连接，为领域无关的世界模型提供了可行范式。

Abstract: World modeling enables intelligence to anticipate consequences, guide interventions, and learn from interaction. Yet predictive models remain domain-specific: can a common learning principle support world modeling across radically different systems? We introduce JEPA-Anything, a domain-agnostic framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization (OPF). Extending joint-embedding predictive architectures, OPF decomposes latent targets into complementary factors, learns them through dedicated pathways, and recombines them within a shared predictive design. We evaluate JEPA-Anything across seven domains: vision, biology, clinical trajectories, control, molecular dynamics, physical fields, and weather. Experiments span representation learning, intervention prediction, out-of-distribution generalization, and long-horizon dynamics, including 10 matched dynamics tasks, forecasting of over 1,000 clinical events, and 100-step molecular rollouts across four systems. Against matched JEPA baselines, JEPA-Anything improves reported metrics on all 10 dynamics tasks and reduces single-intervention prediction error on Interventional Pong by 34.8%. It achieves the lowest one-step and 100-step molecular errors among compared methods in all four systems. Beyond prediction, a factor-nominated biological intervention receives experimental support in cell co-cultures, patient-derived organoids, tumor fragments, and mice; latent orbital modes recover the Keplerian scaling exponent with a fitted slope of -1.4991. These results support a common factorized predictive principle across heterogeneous worlds, connecting world modeling with intervention and experimentally grounded scientific discovery. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/JEPA-Anything

</details>


### [172] [Unifying Models of Intergroup Hostility in Online Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20808)
*Patrick Gerard,Julia Mendelsohn,Kristina Lerman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究基于2024年美国大选期间TikTok、Truth Social与Twitter/X上的286万条帖子，将六种群体间敌意理论（边界建构、威胁建构、替罪羊、负面评价、去人性化、行动导向）纳入统一实证框架，揭示其结构组织与时间序列规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 敌意言论会正常化排斥、加剧极化与政治暴力。既有调节敌意言论的努力依赖社会心理学、道德心理学与政治学的基础理论，但这些理论多平行发展，对敌意形成机制的解释彼此不同甚至冲突，且很少在真实话语中相互检验，导致对敌意修辞机制的理解碎片化，无法明确其在现实话语中的表现及相互关系。

Method: 使用2024年美国总统选举期间TikTok、Truth Social和Twitter/X的286万条帖子，将六种群体间敌意理论的机制——边界建构、威胁建构、替罪羊、负面评价、去人性化、行动导向——置于共同的实证框架中进行建模，以还原敌意修辞的整体组织方式。

Result: 结构上，边界建构与威胁建构是该系统的锚点；时间上，这些机制呈现规律性顺序：边界建构、贬抑与行动导向倾向较早出现；去人性化与威胁建构较晚；替罪羊最晚。

Conclusion: 描绘这些理论框架在话语中的实际表现，弥合了社会科学传统之间长期存在的分歧，并为计算社会科学提供了更清晰的实证基础，使其能够在超越单一标签检测的层面上对群体间敌意修辞进行建模。

Abstract: Hostile rhetoric toward social groups can normalize exclusion and justify mistreatment, as well as contribute to rising polarization and political violence. Efforts to moderate hostile rhetoric in online speech draw on foundational theories in social and moral psychology, and political science. However, these theories were developed largely in parallel, often propose different and sometimes conflicting accounts of how hostility develops, and have rarely been tested against each other in real discourse. The result is a fragmented understanding of the rhetorical mechanisms of hostility, without a clear sense of how they appear, and relate to each other, in real-world discourse. Using 2.86 million posts from TikTok, Truth Social, and Twitter/X during the 2024 U.S. presidential election, we model the mechanisms of six foundational theories of intergroup hostility -- boundary construction, threat construction, scapegoating, negative evaluation, dehumanization, and action orientation -- within a common empirical framework to recover the broader organization of intergroup hostility rhetoric. Structurally, we find that boundary construction and threat construction anchor the system; temporally, we find that these mechanisms tend to follow a regular ordering: boundary construction, derogation, and action orientation tend to appear early; dehumanization and threat construction later; scapegoating latest. Mapping how these theoretical frameworks actually manifest in discourse bridges longstanding divisions across social science traditions and presents computational social science with a clearer empirical foundation for modeling intergroup hostility rhetoric beyond single-label detection.

</details>


### [173] [Embedding Models Measure in Peculiar Ways](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20821)
*Juri Opitz,Andrianos Michail*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究检验词嵌入空间是否反映质量、距离、时间、体积等物理量测度的客观语义等价与距离，发现其在嵌入空间中建模很弱，且受表层字符串相似性强烈影响，重校准相似度也难以显著改善对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 嵌入空间定义了语义相似度与距离的概念，但这类相似度是否与物理量测度所具备的唯一、客观的语义等价和距离相一致尚不明确，作者希望验证嵌入表示能否真实刻画物理测量。

Method: 以质量、距离、时间、体积等具有客观量纲与换算关系的物理测量为对象，考察其嵌入表示中的语义等价与距离模式；并进一步分析表层字符串相似性对表示的影响，以及通过重新校准相似度度量能否改善对齐。

Result: 物理测量在嵌入空间中仅被弱建模，呈现出颇为奇特的度量模式；嵌入表示强烈受表层字符串相似性影响，且相似度重校准并不能实质性提升与客观物理度量的对齐程度。

Conclusion: 嵌入空间并未可靠反映物理测量的客观语义结构，其相似性判断更多由表层字符串形式驱动，说明当前词嵌入在刻画具有客观度量体系的语义关系上存在明显局限。

Abstract: Embedding spaces define notions of semantic similarity and distance. We study whether those embeddings reflect physical measurements of mass, distance, time and volume, which admit a unique, objective notion of semantic equivalence and distance. We find that physical measurement is only weakly modeled in the embedding space, and that instead quite peculiar measurement patterns can be observed. Further analysis indicates that embedding representations of physical measurements are strongly influenced by superficial string similarity, and recalibration of similarity does not substantially improve the alignment.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [174] [SiliconBench: Speed, Memory, and Fidelity for LLM Serving on Unified-Memory Desktops](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19169)
*Ranran Haoran Zhang,Aysa Xuemo Fan,David Munhá Correia,Alex Cheema,Rui Zhang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出 SiliconBench，从速度、内存、保真度三个维度评测九种 Apple Silicon 本地 LLM 服务引擎，并给出架构就绪度、内存纪律与多机扩展性的判读框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一内存桌面上的并发本地 LLM 服务必须同时保证内存余量（headroom）与输出保真度，而仅以速度排名会忽略这些关键约束，因此需要一个多维评测基准。

Method: SiliconBench 对九种 Apple Silicon 服务引擎在 Qwen3、Qwen3.5、Gemma 4 上进行 chat 与 agent 场景评测；用分类任务对照 NVIDIA 参考检查质量回退，并以 DGX Spark 作为服务性能参照；围绕服务架构就绪度、内存纪律、多机扩展三项准则解读结果。

Result: Qwen3-0.6B 上 vllm-metal 在并发 1→16 时两类负载吞吐均翻倍以上，CUDA vLLM 与 SGLang 同提示下并发扩展更强；显式内存预算不保证余量，两种栈虽完成全部请求但内存逼近物理容量且吞吐下降；新模型架构引擎支持更窄，所评实现与保真度参照一致；仅三种栈通过完成度、保真度与模型覆盖三项门槛；在更大稠密与 MoE 模型上，vllm-metal 的 packed prefill-decode 路径在并发下首 token 延迟低于 omlx；双机配置中 Thunderbolt RDMA 张量并行可扩展，而 TCP 流水线并行出现回退。

Conclusion: 速度单指标不足以评估统一内存桌面上的本地服务，需综合内存纪律、保真度与模型覆盖；同时释放基准代码、逐次运行结果与维护日志，并配套有界代理修复与人工复核的工作流。

Abstract: Concurrent local LLM serving on unified-memory desktops must preserve memory headroom and output fidelity, which speed-only rankings overlook. We introduce SiliconBench, which evaluates nine Apple Silicon serving engines through three lenses: speed, memory, and fidelity. We evaluate chat and agent serving on Qwen3, Qwen3.5, and Gemma 4. We use a classification task to check for quality regressions against an NVIDIA reference. DGX Spark provides a complementary serving-performance reference. Three desiderata guide interpretation: serving architecture readiness, memory discipline, and multi-node scaling. On Qwen3-0.6B, vllm-metal alone more than doubles throughput on both workloads from concurrency 1 to 16. CUDA vLLM and SGLang show stronger concurrency scaling on the same prompts. Explicit memory budgets do not guarantee memory headroom: two stacks complete every request while memory use approaches physical capacity and throughput declines. The newer model architectures have narrower engine support. Their evaluated implementations match the fidelity reference. Only three stacks satisfy the completion, fidelity, and model-coverage gates. Comparisons on larger dense and MoE models reinforce the importance of scheduling prompt processing alongside ongoing generation: vllm-metal's packed prefill-decode path maintains lower first-token latency than omlx under concurrent load. In the tested two-machine configurations, tensor parallelism over Thunderbolt RDMA scales while pipeline parallelism over TCP regresses. We release benchmark code, per-run results, and maintenance journals, supported by a workflow combining bounded agent fixes with human review.

</details>


### [175] [CovR: Coverage-Aware Hardware Verification via Reasoning-Guided Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19189)
*Manar Abdelatty,Maryam Nouh,Sherief Reda*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: CovR：面向覆盖率驱动的LLM测试平台生成智能体框架，结合自反思、仿真反馈与强化学习，显著提升覆盖质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计验证占硬件开发工作量的70%，现有LLM测试平台生成方案多关注功能正确性，忽视覆盖率质量这一关键指标，存在明显空白。

Method: 提出CovR智能体框架：将自反思循环与仿真反馈结合以最大化覆盖率；用强教师模型构建16,514条自然语言规格-RTL推理-测试平台三元组数据集，实现覆盖率感知监督；再提出面向覆盖率驱动测试平台生成的强化学习框架，利用仿真与覆盖率反馈的工具派生奖励优化学生模型；最终将微调模型回注智能体精炼流程，并作为插件式激励引擎接入完整验证流程。

Result: 微调模型在VerilogEval与RTLLM V2.0上cov@10达93.81%，CVDP上达87.76%，分别超越SOTA 7.97%与3.59%；回注精炼流程后，cov@10进一步提升至94.27%（VerilogEval/RTLLM V2.0）与91.39%（CVDP）；作为插件式激励引擎时，覆盖率提升18.95%，变异检测得分提升1.19%，并揭示4.46%的未检测失败。

Conclusion: 覆盖率是LLM硬件验证中被长期忽视的优化目标；CovR通过覆盖率感知数据监督与工具奖励强化学习，配合智能体迭代精炼，证明针对覆盖率优化可实质提升验证完备性与缺陷检测能力。

Abstract: Design verification remains one of the most resource-intensive stages of hardware development, often consuming up to 70% of the total design effort. While recent work has explored using Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate testbench generation, most existing approaches focus narrowly on functional correctness, overlooking the critical aspect of coverage quality. To bridge this gap, we present CovR, an agentic framework for automated testbench generation that combines self-reflection loops with simulation-based feedback to maximize coverage. Using this pipeline, we construct a large-scale dataset of 16,514 natural specification RTL reasoning testbench tuples with a strong teacher model, enabling coverage-aware supervision. Building on this, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) framework tailored for coverage-driven testbench generation, leveraging tool-derived rewards from simulation and coverage feedback to optimize a student model. Experimental results show that the CovR finetuned model achieves 93.81% cov@10 on VerilogEval and RTLLM V2.0, and 87.76% cov@10 on CVDP, outperforming state-of-the-art approaches by 7.97% and 3.59%, respectively. Furthermore, deploying the finetuned model back into the agentic refinement pipeline further improves cov@10 to 94.27% on VerilogEval and RTLLM V2.0 and 91.39% on CVDP. Moreover, when integrated as a plug-in stimulus engine for full verification workflows, CovR improves coverage by 18.95% and mutation detection score by 1.19%, while revealing 4.46% undetected failures, highlighting the importance of optimizing for coverage in LLM-based hardware verification.

</details>


### [176] [Epic: Efficient Programming Paradigm for In-Storage Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19206)
*Yuyue Wang,Zhenyu Zhang,Glenn Reinman,Huaicheng Li*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出Epic——一个基于NVMe的存储内计算(ISC)栈，通过统一抽象捕获数据驻留与生命周期，将卸载工作流表达为带位置的有状态数据流，配合存储感知编译器与运行时实现I/O-计算重叠，在多类负载上取得显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多阶段应用的ISC收益需要协调数据放置、I/O-计算重叠与设备端状态，但现有接口缺乏统一抽象来支撑这些决策。

Method: Epic在程序中捕获数据驻留与生命周期：location类型声明逻辑驻留，dataflow推导中间值与操作状态的生存期，keep原语跨调用扩展选定状态；存储感知编译器执行移动感知的逻辑映射与融合并暴露I/O-计算重叠，运行时利用执行期信息异步绑定工作到物理资源并管理设备驻留状态。

Result: 在12个文件扫描、数据库与机器学习负载上，Epic平均比五种既有ISC系统中最强的一个快1.6倍，相较对应主机基线平均加速4.2倍、最高16.1倍，应用侧代码最多减少14倍。

Conclusion: 通过将卸载工作流统一表达为带位置的有状态数据流，Epic有效协调数据放置、计算重叠与设备端状态，验证了该抽象在性能与编程效率上的优势。

Abstract: In-storage computing (ISC) reduces host--storage data movement by executing computation inside computational storage devices (CSDs). For multi-stage applications, realizing these benefits requires coordinating data placement, I/O--compute overlap, and device-resident state across the workflow, yet existing interfaces lack a unified abstraction for these decisions. We present Epic, an NVMe-based ISC stack that provides this abstraction by capturing data residency and lifetime in the program: location types declare logical residency, dataflow derives lifetimes for intermediate values and operation state within an invocation, and a keep primitive extends selected state across invocations. These semantics expose the complete offloaded workflow as a located, stateful dataflow. A storage-aware compiler transforms this workflow, performs movement-aware logical mapping and fusion, and exposes I/O--compute overlap; a runtime completes the plan using execution-time information, asynchronously binding work to physical resources and managing device-resident state. Across 12 file-scanning, database, and machine learning workloads, Epic is 1.6$\times$ faster on average than the strongest of five prior ISC systems, while achieving 4.2$\times$ speedup on average and up to 16.1$\times$ over the corresponding host baselines, and reducing application-side code by up to 14$\times$ in our implementations.

</details>


### [177] [MeshKV: A Network-on-Chip KV Cache Fabric for Scalable Transformer Decoding Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19207)
*Dong Liu,Yanxuan Yu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: MeshKV 提出一种 KV 缓存网络（fabric），将 KV 块以分组化流的形式在轻量级 NoC 上搬运，通过 TaKV 仿射条带化、Mare 组播去重与 Pad 流水重叠三项协同设计，把互连背压转化为有效 KV 传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归 Transformer 解码受限于分块加速器上不规则 KV 缓存搬运；先前的压缩与 DRAM 放置方案仍将流量集中于集中式内存路径，成为长上下文服务的瓶颈。

Method: MeshKV 在轻量级 NoC 上以分组化流搬运 KV 块，并协同设计三部分：(i) TaKV 仿射条带化以分散 home 位置、降低热点负载；(ii) Mare 组播并带经验证的重复抑制；(iii) Pad，在信用对齐 FIFO 后重叠预取、tile 乘法与流式 softmax。

Result: 在 8x8 FPGA 实现上，使用 LLaMA-2-7B 与 Mistral-7B、序列长度 8K-32K：互连流量最多降低 58%，KV 带宽利用率提升 2.1 倍，多流吞吐最高提升 1.9 倍。

Conclusion: 将 KV 缓存作为可路由的分组化流在片上网络中搬运，可缓解集中式内存路径瓶颈，并显著提升长上下文多流服务的互连效率与吞吐。

Abstract: Autoregressive transformer decoding is constrained by irregular key-value (KV) cache movement on tiled accelerators. Prior compression and DRAM-placement systems still concentrate traffic on centralized memory paths that bottleneck long-context serving. We present MeshKV, a KV cache fabric that moves blocks as packetized flows over a lightweight NoC. It co-designs (i) TaKV affine striping to spread homes and cut hotspot load, (ii) Mare multicast with verified duplicate suppression, and (iii) Pad, which overlaps prefetch, tile multiply, and streaming softmax behind credit-aligned FIFOs. Together they convert bisection back-pressure into useful KV transfer. On our 8x8 FPGA implementation with LLaMA-2-7B and Mistral-7B at 8K-32K, MeshKV reduces interconnect traffic by up to 58%, improves KV bandwidth utilization by 2.1x, and delivers up to 1.9x multi-stream throughput.

</details>


### [178] [MiX: Micro-Inverted-Scaling for End-to-End Low-Bit Vision-Language Model Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19683)
*Yuan Liao,Jae-sun Seo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Micro-Inverted-Scaling (MiX) 量化格式与 MiX-MX 推理框架，解决 VLM 边缘部署中的内存带宽瓶颈与极端离群值问题，在精度、面积、速度和能耗上均优于 NVFP4 与 SOTA 加速器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Vision-Language Models (VLM) 在边缘设备部署受限于内存带宽，需激进的亚 8-bit 量化。但边缘加速器受面积与功耗约束，要求端到端量化模型。多模态 token 间极端的动态范围差异导致标准 block 格式出现"microscaling collapse"：单个巨大离群值劫持共享指数，使周围元素下溢，破坏注意力图。

Method: 提出 Micro-Inverted-Scaling (MiX)，在数学上反转 microscaling 范式：不将多个尾数分组于一个共享指数下，而是将私有的逐元素指数分组于单一共享尾数下。针对非对称 VLM 离群值拓扑，引入自适应双格式 (MiX-MX) 推理框架。通过代数分解提取共享 MiX 尾数，将该框架映射到定制加速器，用高效移位器替代乘法器。

Result: 在多个 VLM 上端到端评估，4.5-bit MiX 在多模态基准上精度与 NVFP4 相当或更优。MiX 加速器相比 NVFP4 基线面积效率提升 25%；相比 SOTA 加速器 Focus，跨模型实现 2.3-4.5x 加速与 1.4-2.9x 能耗降低。

Conclusion: 倒置缩放数据通路 (inverted-scaling datapath) 在物理层面对高效 VLM 部署更具优势，MiX 兼顾精度与硬件效率，为边缘端 VLM 部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: The deployment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on edge devices is severely bottlenecked by memory bandwidth, necessitating aggressive sub-8-bit quantization. Since edge accelerators are strictly constrained by area and power, they require end-to-end quantized models. However, the extreme dynamic range gap between multi-modal tokens causes standard block formats to suffer "microscaling collapse," where a single massive outlier hijacks the shared exponent, underflowing surrounding elements and destroying attention maps. To break this bottleneck, we propose Micro-Inverted-Scaling (MiX), a novel format that mathematically inverts the microscaling paradigm: rather than grouping multiple mantissas under one shared exponent, MiX groups private, per-element exponents under a single shared mantissa. To handle asymmetric VLM outlier topologies, we introduce an adaptive dual-format (MiX-MX) inference framework. By algebraically factoring out the shared MiX mantissa, this framework maps to a custom accelerator, replacing multipliers with efficient shifters. Evaluated end-to-end on multiple VLMs, our 4.5-bit MiX formulation exhibits equivalent or superior accuracy on multi-modal benchmarks compared to NVFP4. Simultaneously, the MiX accelerator delivers a 25% improvement in area efficiency over the NVFP4 baseline and a 2.3-4.5x speedup with 1.4-2.9x energy reduction across models compared to the state-of-the-art accelerator Focus, proving the inverted-scaling datapath is physically superior for efficient VLM deployment.

</details>


### [179] [High-frequency Multispeculative Multiply-Accumulation Unit for Fused Posit Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19859)
*Mario Alonso,Miguel Ángel Sacristán,Guillermo Botella,Alberto A. Del Barrio*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向32/64位Posit的高频Multispeculative PositMAC架构，通过流水线重构、Booth-4+Kogge-Stone乘法拓扑以及多推测加法器替代宽quire累加器，实现面积缩减19.8%、能耗降低超50%，并获得最高工作频率与最多79.0%的周期时间缩减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Posit算术相比IEEE 754具有更高精度，其融合乘加通过quire宽定点累加器避免中间舍入，保证精确可复现；但quire带来巨大的面积与功耗开销，因此需要优化架构以兼顾性能与资源效率。

Method: 1) 重构流水线以平衡各阶段；2) 评估高速乘法拓扑，采用Booth-4编码配合Kogge-Stone加法器达到0.5ns（2GHz）目标；3) 用Multispeculative Adder替代宽单块quire累加器。

Result: 面积最多减少19.8%，能耗降低超50%；相较其他先进设计具有最高工作频率，周期时间较64位quire方案缩减最多79.0%；且面积更小、每周期能耗更低。

Conclusion: 该Multispeculative PositMAC在保持甚至减小面积与降低每周期能耗的同时，显著提升频率并缩短周期时间，优于所有支持quire的同类设计。

Abstract: Posit arithmetic offers a compelling alternative to the IEEE 754 floating-point standard, providing enhanced accuracy. Its fused multiply-accumulate operations avoid intermediate rounding, ensuring exact numerical reproducibility through the quire, a wide fixed-point accumulator spanning the format's full dynamic range to prevent precision loss and overflow during long accumulations. However, integrating such large accumulators incurs significant area and power overheads. This paper presents an optimized, high-frequency Multispeculative PositMAC architecture for 32- and 64-bits Posit. First, the pipeline is restructured to balance the different stages. Second, high-speed multiplication topologies are evaluated, showing that a Booth-4 scheme with Kogge-Stone adders meets a stringent 0.5ns target (2Ghz). Finally, the wide monolithic quire accumulator is replaced with a Multispeculative Adder, diminishing area up to 19.8\% while reducing energy consumption by more than 50\% when compared to the baseline. Compared to other state-of-the-art designs, our proposal achieves the highest operating frequency and reduces cycle time by up to 79.0\% with respect to 64-bit quire-enabled alternatives. This performance is attained without increasing resource overhead, as the design remains strictly smaller in area and achieves lower per-cycle energy consumption than all quire-capable counterparts.

</details>


### [180] [Evaluation of Power-Clock Waveforms for Positive Feedback Adiabatic Logic in 16 nm FinFET Technology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19998)
*Maciej Szymon Pyrzowski,Franciszek Łukowski,Aida Todri-Sanial*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文在TSMC 16 nm FinFET工艺下研究正反馈绝热逻辑（PFAL），构建功能完备的门级库，并通过能量-延迟积优化电源时钟的幅度、频率与波形，证明三角波形最优，PFAL相对静态CMOS最高节能3.83倍（进位先行加法器达5.3倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 绝热逻辑可通过准可逆开关回收负载电容上的部分能量，但其在FinFET工艺及多GHz频率下的波形优化运行仍缺乏研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 在TSMC 16 nm FinFET工艺中设计并验证功能完备的PFAL门级库，针对电源时钟的幅度、频率和波形形状进行能量-延迟积（EDP）优化；基于该库搭建2:1多路复用器、4位行波进位加法器与4位Brent-Kung进位先行加法器等组合电路。

Result: 电源时钟扫描表明最小能量波形趋近三角波而非传统梯形波；优化后的单门PFAL单元能耗比等效静态CMOS门最高低3.83倍；正弦激励相较梯形激励最高改善能耗1.32倍并扩展有效工作范围；进位先行加法器在三角电源时钟下相较静态CMOS能耗估计最高获得5.3倍增益。

Conclusion: PFAL在FinFET工艺与多GHz频段具备显著能效优势，波形形状应作为关键设计变量，三角/正弦类波形优于传统梯形激励，该门级库可有效支撑大型绝热组合电路的低功耗设计。

Abstract: Adiabatic logic can recover part of the energy stored on load capacitances through quasi-reversible switching, but its waveform-optimized operation in FinFET technology and at multi-GHz frequencies remains underexplored. This work investigates Positive Feedback Adiabatic Logic (PFAL) in the TSMC 16 nm FinFET process. A functionally complete PFAL gate library is designed, verified, and characterised using energy-delay product optimization over power-clock amplitude, frequency, and waveform shape. The power-clock sweep shows that the minimum-energy waveform approaches a triangular shape rather than a conventional trapezoid. The optimized single-gate PFAL cells achieve up to 3.83x lower energy than equivalent static CMOS gates, while sinusoidal excitation improves energy by up to 1.32x compared with trapezoidal excitation and extends the valid operating range. The library is then used to construct larger combinational circuits, including a 2:1 multiplexer, a 4-bit ripple carry adder, and a 4-bit Brent-Kung carry look-ahead adder. The carry look-ahead adder reaches a gain of up to 5.3x compared with the static CMOS energy estimate for the triangular power-clock.

</details>


### [181] [Evaluating Positive Feedback Adiabatic Logic in 16nm FinFET with a Realistic Power-Clock](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19999)
*Franciszek Łukowski,Maciej Pyrzowski,Aida Todri-Sanial*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文在TSMC 16nm FinFET工艺下系统评估正反馈绝热逻辑（PFAL），揭示三类非绝热损耗机制，并通过标准单元、乘法器/比较器电路及四相电源时钟发生器验证其能耗优势与可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 绝热逻辑通过准可逆开关复用负载电容能量，能耗可低于传统静态CMOS，但其在FinFET工艺及多GHz时钟频率下的实用性尚未被研究，因此需要系统性评估。

Method: 在TSMC 16nm FinFET工艺中仿真PFAL，构建标准单元门及2×2乘法器、4位比较器等组合电路，以能量延迟积（EDP）和能量优势指标η=E_CMOS/E_PFAL与静态CMOS对比；设计并联耦合正交压控振荡器作为四相电源时钟发生器，并进行负载（扇出）研究。

Result: 瞬态仿真揭示三类非绝热损耗：两类源于PMOS/NMOS锁存器（阈值电压相关损耗及此前未报道的输出节点冗余充电），一类源于PFAL逻辑树复杂度。低阈值Buffer/NOT单元在V_CLK=0.6V、f_CLK=7.94GHz时最小EDP为1.23×10^-26 J·s；PFAL在较低频率和较高电源电压下相对静态CMOS保持约5倍能量优势。非理想四相电源下3GHz时Buffer/NOT能耗与理想正弦情况相差在2%以内；负载研究量化了扇出增加引起的相移与幅度衰减。

Conclusion: 结果为16nm FinFET中PFAL提供了面向设计的评估，并激励将绝热逻辑用于未来低功耗系统架构。

Abstract: Adiabatic logic reuses the energy stored on load capacitances through quasi-reversible switching, enabling a lower minimum energy consumption than conventional static CMOS. Yet its practicality in FinFET technologies and at multi-GHz clock rates has yet to be investigated. This work provides a systematic evaluation of Positive Feedback Adiabatic Logic (PFAL) simulated in the TSMC 16nm FinFET process. A set of PFAL standard-cell gates were realised, along with two representative combinational circuits - a 2$\times$2 multiplier and a 4-bit comparator - and compared against static CMOS logic using the energy--delay product (EDP) and the energy advantage metric $η= E_{\mathrm{CMOS}} / E_{\mathrm{PFAL}}$. Transient simulations reveal three sources of non-adiabatic loss: two specific to the PMOS/NMOS latch, threshold-voltage-related loss and a previously unreported redundant charging of the output node and one related to the complexity of PFAL logic trees. The low-threshold Buffer/NOT cell achieves a minimum EDP of $1.23\times10^{-26}$J$\cdot$s at $V_{\mathrm{CLK}} = 0.6$V and $f_{\mathrm{CLK}} = 7.94$GHz, while PFAL preserves an energy benefit over static CMOS of up to roughly $5\times$ at reduced frequencies and elevated supply voltages. A parallel-coupled quadrature voltage-controlled oscillator is designed as a realistic four-phase power-clock generator. With this non-ideal supply, the Buffer/NOT energy stays within $2\%$ of the ideal sinusoidal case at $3$GHz. A loading study quantifies the phase shift and amplitude reduction induced by increasing fan-out. Overall, the results provide a design-oriented evaluation of PFAL in 16nm FinFET and a motivation to exploit adiabatic logic for future low-power system architectures.

</details>


### [182] [Spectral Signatures for Parametric Fault Detection in Flexible Electronics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20315)
*Paula Carolina Lozano Duarte,Sule Ozev,Mehdi Tahoori*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于VCO频谱能量的频域测试签名电路，用于IGZO柔性单极性TFT的AMS电路故障与参数偏差检测，无需精密参考或ATE，面积仅6390μm²、功耗16.7μW。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IGZO柔性单极性TFT适合可穿戴与生物监测等应用，但其低成本单极性工艺带来器件变异性大、无刚性封装易失效、参数故障不引发数字硬失效等问题；专用ATE昂贵且现场不可用，而传统基于ADC的测试方案面积开销过大，且ADC自身受PVT波动影响会导致测试失效。

Method: 设计频域测试签名电路：利用压控振荡器（VCO）将故障引起的控制电压偏移转换为频率偏移，经轻量模拟滤波器提取谐波分量的RMS值作为紧凑签名；该签名对工作点偏差具单调敏感性且在各PVT角下保持排序一致性，从而无需精密参考或匹配比较器；并引入比例化（ratiometric）细化以抑制温度与电源漂移的后校准误差。

Result: 签名可通过两个I/O引脚读出，支持无ATE的现场测试；电路面积6390 μm²，功耗16.7 μW；相比紧凑型ADC实现26倍面积缩减，相比SAR实现近1500倍缩减；比例化细化可将温度与电源变化引起的后校准漂移最多抑制一个数量级。

Conclusion: 该频域VCO签名方案为资源受限的IGZO柔性FE系统提供了低面积、低功耗、PVT鲁棒的AMS内建测试途径，规避了ADC与专用ATE的局限，适用于一次性柔性电子系统的现场测试。

Abstract: Flexible electronics (FE) based on indium gallium zinc oxide (IGZO) unipolar thin-film transistor (TFT) technologies enable lightweight, conformable systems for wearable sensing, biomedical monitoring, and human-machine interfaces. These applications rely on analog and mixed-signal (AMS) blocks that must remain accurate despite key challenges: increased device variability from low-cost unipolar fabrication; susceptibility to post-manufacturing failures due to the absence of rigid packaging; parametric faults that degrade analog accuracy without hard digital failures; and the high cost and in-field inaccessibility of specialized Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) for disposable FE systems. Conventional test approaches relying on analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) incur prohibitive area overhead in resource-constrained systems; critically, ADC accuracy is itself subject to process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations, leading to test invalidations. This work proposes a frequency-domain test signature circuit exploiting spectral energy from a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) to detect faults and parametric deviations in AMS circuits under test. The VCO converts fault-induced control-voltage deviations into frequency shifts processed through lightweight analog filters. RMS values of harmonic components serve as compact signatures with monotonic sensitivity to operating-point deviations while preserving ordering across PVT corners, ensuring robust operation without precision references or matched comparators. A ratiometric refinement suppresses post-calibration drift from temperature and supply variation by up to an order of magnitude. The signature is readable via two I/O pins, enabling in-field test without ATE. The circuit occupies 6390 $μ$m$^2$ and consumes 16.7 $μ$W, achieving 26$\times$ area reduction versus compact ADCs and nearly 1500$\times$ versus SAR implementations.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [183] [Generative Query Suggestion via Intent Coverage and Query-Level Credit Assignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19209)
*Xinpeng Liu,Lu Ma,Jiayi Qiao,Mengyu Zhou,Linglong Li,Xiaofeng Bian,Haonan Chen,Xiaoxi Jiang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出意图驱动的查询建议框架，通过双阶段优化同时提升单条查询质量与整版意图覆盖度，并在大规模生产数据上验证了CTR、查询质量与意图覆盖的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式查询建议的核心挑战在于：既要保证候选中每条查询单独有用，又要让整个查询列表覆盖不同的用户意图，而现有方法难以兼顾个体质量与整体多样性。

Method: 采用双阶段优化框架：第一阶段为意图感知的多样性建模，构建与意图对齐的监督微调（SFT）数据，并设计意图感知多样性奖励来优化意图覆盖；第二阶段为查询级信用分配，将个体质量信号路由到对应的查询token，同时在整版层面共享多样性信号。

Result: 在大规模生产数据集上，结合在线A/B测试与离线评估，方法在点击率（CTR）、查询质量和意图覆盖度上均取得提升。

Conclusion: 该框架通过双阶段优化有效解耦并协同优化个体查询质量与整版意图多样性，验证了在真实生产环境中的实用性与有效性。

Abstract: Generative query suggestion aims to enhance user engagement by anticipating user intents and recommending relevant follow-up queries. A central challenge is to generate slates whose individual queries are useful while the slate covers distinct intents. We propose an Intent-Driven Query Suggestion Framework with dual-stage optimization. First, intent-aware diversity modeling constructs intent-aligned supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data and uses an Intent-Aware Diversity Reward to optimize intent coverage. Second, query-level credit assignment routes individual quality signals to the corresponding query tokens while sharing a slate-level diversity signal across the slate. Experiments on a large-scale production dataset, including online A/B testing and offline evaluation, show improvements in click-through rate, query quality, and intent coverage.

</details>


### [184] [Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) Improves Classification Accuracy of Bacterial Raman Spectral Data Enabling Portable Diagnostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19453)
*Kaitlin Zareno,Jarett Dewbury,Siamak K. Sorooshyari,Hossein Mobahi,Loza F. Tadesse*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对拉曼光谱病原体耐药性检测中算法泛化差、预处理复杂的问题，引入锐度感知最小化（SAM）优化器，在临床菌株分类任务上相较Adam最高提升10.5%单次划分精度、平均提升2.7%，证明SAM可推动AI辅助拉曼光谱工具的临床应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抗菌素耐药性预计到2050年每年致死1000万人，资源受限地区受影响最严重。拉曼光谱作为新型病原体诊断手段，可在数小时内完成快速便携的耐药性检测（金标准方法需数天）。但现有拉曼光谱分析算法存在两大局限：1）在有限数据集上难以跨多样患者群体泛化；2）因拉曼光谱数据质量低，需依赖特征提取等非平凡预处理步骤，导致模型复杂度上升。

Method: 采用锐度感知最小化（Sharpness-Aware Minimization, SAM）优化器，以提升模型在临床细菌分离株分类任务中跨多种超参数配置的泛化能力。

Result: 在光谱分类任务中，SAM相较传统优化器Adam：单一数据划分上精度最高提升10.5%；所有划分上的平均精度提升2.7%。

Conclusion: SAM具备提升AI驱动拉曼光谱工具临床应用能力的潜力，可缓解泛化性差与预处复杂等问题。

Abstract: Antimicrobial resistance is expected to claim 10 million lives per year by 2050, and resource-limited regions are most affected. Raman spectroscopy is a novel pathogen diagnostic approach promising rapid and portable antibiotic resistance testing within a few hours, compared to days when using gold standard methods. However, current algorithms for Raman spectra analysis 1) are unable to generalize well on limited datasets across diverse patient populations and 2) require increased complexity due to the necessity of non-trivial pre-processing steps, such as feature extraction, which are essential to mitigate the low-quality nature of Raman spectral data. In this work, we address these limitations using Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) to enhance model generalization across a diverse array of hyperparameters in clinical bacterial isolate classification tasks. We demonstrate that SAM achieves accuracy improvements of up to 10.5% on a single split, and an increase in average accuracy of 2.7% across all splits in spectral classification tasks over the traditional optimizer, Adam. These results display the capability of SAM to advance the clinical application of AI-powered Raman spectroscopy tools.

</details>


### [185] [Intact-to-Amputee Transfer in Surface-EMG Gesture Decoding: Training Source and Calibration Budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20297)
*Jethro Odeyemi,W. J. Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究评估了"蒙太奇无关"跨用户肌电解码器在11名经桡截肢者上的迁移表现，发现零样本跨人群迁移完全失败，但仅需3次标注重复即可显著超越临床常规的每用户分类器，并量化了源池构成对迁移的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肌电识别器在个体间迁移性差，通常需要新用户重新标注校准。而截肢者群体在现有研究中代表性不足（1077项研究中仅约1/6涉及截肢者），因此需要系统检验跨用户编码器在截肢人群中的迁移边界与所需标注量。

Method: 将蒙太奇无关的跨用户编码器（在健全肢体数据上训练）迁移至11名经桡截肢者，采用与训练数据相匹配的实验方案。评估指标为macro F1，对比对象为临床常用的每用户分类器。同时比较不同源池：40名健全者、10名其他截肢者及两者结合。

Result: 零样本跨人群迁移完全失败；加入新用户标注数据后，3次重复下编码器比每用户分类器高0.190 macro F1，且对队列中每位被试均成立。3次标注重复时达0.779 macro-F1，而每用户流程为0.589。用40名健全者训练对新截肢者的迁移优于用10名其他截肢者训练，两者结合效果最佳。预注册假设仅在标注重复足够且源池加入额外截肢者后成立，在单次重复及与健全肢体源匹配的所有预算下均不成立。

Conclusion: 跨人群零样本肌电迁移不可行，但少量标注（3次重复）即可带来显著收益并稳定超越每用户基线。源池多样性（结合健全者与截肢者）优于单一来源，研究同时界定了"编码器基线强度"解释的适用边界。

Abstract: A recogniser trained on one person rarely transfers to the next, and useful performance usually demands a fresh round of labelled calibration from the end user. A systematic review of 1077 studies quantifies where the evidence is thin: amputees appear in about one in six. Here a montage-agnostic cross-user encoder is carried to eleven transradial amputees on a protocol matched to its intact-limb training data. Zero-shot cross-population transfer fails outright: the encoder requires labeled data from the new user before it begins decoding, and it then exceeds the per-user classifier a clinic would fit by 0.190 macro F1 at three repetitions and for every subject in the cohort. Given three labelled repetitions it reaches 0.779 macro-F1 against 0.589 for the per-user pipeline. Training on forty intact subjects produces better transfers to a new amputee than training on ten other amputees, and combining the two produces better transfers than either individually. The prediction pre-registered for this study, which extends the encoder's baseline-strength account with the premise that amputee EMG is less separable, holds true only after a few repetitions become available and after enriching the source pool with additional amputees. At a single repetition, and at every budget under a source matched to the intact-limb comparison, it fails. Thus, it locates the boundary of the proposed account.

</details>


### [186] [Layer-wise Curriculum Learning for Efficient LLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19213)
*Donggeon Lee,Dooyeon Na,Seungmin Oh,Jongbin Ryu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出分层课程学习（layer-wise curriculum learning）用于高效LLM压缩，通过将模型切分为多层段并配合特征缓存与多线程策略，实现高效知识蒸馏，在BERT/GPT-2上将显存与训练时间降低50%以上并达到SOTA，在LLaMA与Qwen上优于其他剪枝方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM压缩中教师到学生的知识迁移计算开销大、收敛慢，且跨层特征错位影响效率，需要一种兼顾性能与计算效率的压缩方案。

Method: 将整个模型划分为由若干层构成的多段，采用分层课程学习，从易到难逐步进行知识迁移；基于对累积误差现象的理论分析来加速收敛并稳定迁移；同时引入多线程特征缓存以处理跨层特征错位并最大化GPU利用率。

Result: 在多个数据集上达到SOTA；在BERT和GPT-2上减少50%以上GPU显存占用与训练时长；在LLaMA系列和Qwen模型上，相同训练时长下性能优于其他剪枝方法，且显存占用更低。

Conclusion: 分层课程学习结合多线程特征缓存，可在降低显存与训练成本的同时取得领先的LLM压缩性能，验证了该方法在效率与效果上的双重优势。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce layer-wise curriculum learning for efficient LLM compression. The proposed method facilitates the knowledge transfer from the teacher model to the student model, utilizing a curriculum learning approach that begins with easier optimization tasks and progressively tackles harder ones. In order to adopt the layer-wise learning in LLM compression, we partition the whole model into multiple segments consisting of layers, thereby enabling more computationally efficient knowledge transfer for LLMs. Based on our theoretical analysis of cumulative error phenomenon, layer-wise curriculum learning accelerates convergence while stabilizing the knowledge transfer process. In addition, we present a feature caching method with a multi-threading strategy to efficiently address feature misalignment across layers, maximizing GPU utilization. Consequently, our method exhibits advanced model compression performance, as well as high computational efficiency in terms of minimized memory usage and short training hours. Experiments on multiple datasets show that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing GPU memory usage and training hours by more than 50\% on BERT and GPT-2. Moreover, it outperforms the other pruning methods on LLaMA-family and Qwen models under the same training hours, with a lower GPU memory footprint.

</details>


### [187] [Dynamic Generalized Gromov-Wasserstein Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20008)
*Junda Ying,Zhiwei Zeng,Peijie Zhou,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TP-DATE框架，将Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输动态化，通过路径作用量构建二次型最优传输（QOT）并证明静动态等价，进而提出travelling-pair流匹配方法，在空间转录组数据上实现更优的空间结构保持与连续3D动态重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输引入结构感知的传输代价，适合空间转录组学中需同时保持组织结构和匹配表达模式的动态重建。然而现有方法多为静态形式，缺乏用于重建连续轨迹的通用动态公式。

Method: 提出TP-DATE（Travelling Pair Dynamical Alignment and Trajectory Estimation）框架，以无仿真方式将GW-OT动态化。通过路径作用量形式化一大类静态与动态二次型最优传输（QOT），并证明其静动态等价性；进一步开发travelling-pair流匹配，允许条件路径相互作用并将其交互边缘化为单一向量场。

Result: 在合成数据和真实空间转录组数据上，TP-DATE更好地保持了空间结构，并改善了连续3D动态重建的效果。

Conclusion: TP-DATE为结构感知最优传输提供了通用的动态化理论框架与计算方法，实现了无仿真的连续轨迹重建，在空间转录组学等场景中优于静态方法。

Abstract: Gromov--Wasserstein optimal transport (GW-OT) extends classical optimal transport by introducing structure-aware transport cost. This is particularly relevant for spatial transcriptomics, where dynamical reconstruction should preserve tissue structure in addition to matching expression patterns. While static formulations have been widely used for such structure-aware alignment, a general dynamic formulation for reconstructing continuous trajectories is still missing. We introduce Travelling Pair Dynamical Alignment and Trajectory Estimation (TP-DATE), a theoretical and computational framework to generalize GW-OT dynamically in a simulation-free manner. We formulate a broad class of static and dynamic Quadratic-form OT (QOT) through path actions and prove the static dynamic equivalence. We further develop travelling-pair flow matching, which allows interacting conditional paths and marginalizes their interactions into a single vector field. On synthetic and real spatial transcriptomics data, TP-DATE better preserves spatial structure and improves continuous 3D dynamics reconstruction.

</details>


### [188] [Block Parallelism For Efficient Distributed Long-Context Diffusion Language Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19242)
*Tarun Suresh,Pranshu Chaturvedi,Hangoo Kang,Parth Shroff,Ishan S. Khare,Hermann Kumbong,Azalia Mirhoseini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出块并行（BP）与上下文分片块并行（CSBP）两种新的分布式并行维度，用于长上下文块扩散语言模型（BDLM）训练。CSBP保持损坏块K/V与梯度本地化、避免复制干净前缀，在16张H200、256K上下文下将SFT吞吐提升1.18-1.45x，512K全模型加速达1.61x。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BDLM结合了块间自回归依赖与块内并行去噪，但长上下文训练受限于分布式注意力通信与激活内存。传统上下文并行（CP）按位置切分"干净+损坏"合并序列，需通信共享的干净K/V以及块特定的损坏K/V及其梯度，通信与内存开销大。

Method: 观察到BDLM目标函数可按目标块分解，作者提出块并行（BP）：将每个损坏块的计算分配给一个rank。为扩展到长上下文，进一步提出上下文分片块并行（CSBP），在BP基础上将共享的干净序列也跨这些rank分片，从而保持损坏K/V与梯度本地化、避免复制干净前缀，同时保持BDLM训练语义不变。

Result: 在16张H200、256K上下文下，CSBP相比最优基线在监督微调上吞吐提升1.18-1.45x，在自回归模型转BDLM上提升1.27-1.33x，且峰值HBM持平或降低；512K全模型加速达1.61x。在8张H100上，CSBP使DFlash2投机解码器训练在512K加速2.48x、1M加速7.59x。在12小时对齐的DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B SFT训练中，CSBP在每个已训练检查点上的SWE-bench Verified与Terminal-Bench Lite通过率均更高。

Conclusion: CSBP作为一种面向BDLM的分布式并行方法，通过利用BDLM目标函数的块级可分性，在不改变训练语义的前提下显著提升长上下文训练吞吐并匹配或降低显存占用，同时在多个下游任务与模型规模上取得一致的收敛质量优势。

Abstract: Block diffusion language models (BDLMs) combine autoregressive dependencies across blocks with parallel denoising within blocks, but long-context training is constrained by distributed attention communication and activation memory. Conventional context parallelism (CP) shards the combined clean-plus-corrupted sequence by position, communicating shared clean K/V together with block-specific corrupted K/V and their gradients. We observe that the BDLM objective separates over target blocks. We introduce block parallelism (BP), a new distributed parallelism dimension that assigns each corrupted-block computation to one rank. To scale BP to long contexts, we introduce context-sharded block parallelism (CSBP), which also shards the shared clean sequence across those ranks. CSBP keeps corrupted K/V and gradients local, avoids replicated clean prefixes, and preserves BDLM training semantics. On 16 H200 GPUs at 256K context, CSBP improves throughput over the best baseline by 1.18-1.45x for supervised fine-tuning and 1.27-1.33x for conversion of autoregressive models to BDLMs, while matching or reducing peak HBM. Full-model speedup reaches 1.61x at 512K. On eight H100 GPUs, CSBP accelerates DFlash2 speculative-decoder training by 2.48x at 512K and 7.59x at 1M. In matched 12-hour DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B SFT runs, CSBP achieves higher pass rates at every trained checkpoint on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench Lite. Code: https://github.com/ScalingIntelligence/Turbo-dLLM

</details>


### [189] [Randomized SVD Approximations for Spectral Co-Clustering of Word-Document Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19243)
*Fateme Mazdarani,Carlos Toxtli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对归一化谱共聚类中SVD计算代价高的问题，提出随机投影与部分SVD结合元素级采样两种随机近似方法，在真实与合成数据上验证其加速效果及对矩阵稀疏性的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谱共聚类是挖掘词-文档矩阵潜在结构的有效工具，但其标准形式依赖奇异值分解（SVD），在高维数据上计算代价高昂，因此需要可扩展的随机近似方法。

Method: 提出两种面向二分文本数据归一化谱共聚类的随机近似：一是基于随机投影的随机SVD；二是将部分SVD与元素级随机采样相结合，且允许文档簇与词簇数量不同。

Result: 在真实与合成数据集上，两种方法相对于全SVD基线均降低了运行时间，但表现取决于矩阵稀疏性：随机投影方法在所测试场景中更稳定可靠；基于采样的方法在较稠密矩阵上更有效，对已稀疏的文本数据收益有限。

Conclusion: 谱共聚类的随机近似方法应根据数据底层结构进行选择，随机投影更具普适性，采样法适用于较稠密矩阵。

Abstract: Spectral co-clustering is a useful tool for discovering latent structure in word-document matrices, but its reliance on singular value decomposition (SVD) can make standard formulations expensive on high-dimensional data. This paper presents two randomized approximations for normalized spectral co-clustering of bipartite text data when the numbers of document and word clusters may differ. The first method uses randomized SVD through random projection, while the second combines partial SVD with element-wise random sampling. Across real-world and synthetic datasets, both methods reduce runtime relative to the full-SVD baseline, but their behavior depends on matrix sparsity. The random projection method is the more reliable approximation across the tested settings, whereas the sampling-based method is most useful on denser matrices and provides limited benefit on already sparse text data. These results show that randomized approximations for spectral co-clustering should be selected according to the underlying structure of the data.

</details>


### [190] [Radio-Frequency Convolutional Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19279)
*Zhihui Gao,Shi-Yuan Ma,Yiran Chen,Dirk Englund,Tingjun Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出射频卷积神经网络（RF-CNN），复用无线通信中已有的频率混频器，将多通道卷积映射到频点上，由无源混频器单次完成频域卷积；实验在无需额外数字加速器的情况下完成多达9层、2640万参数的深度CNN推理，能耗低至0.72 fJ/MAC，较专用数字处理器低两个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备（手机、可穿戴、无人机）上直接运行AI模型可带来低延迟、可扩展性与数据隐私，但这类设备算力不足；而现有边缘加速器需要额外增加计算硬件，进一步加剧尺寸、重量、功耗与成本（SWaP-C）约束。因此需要一种不增加硬件、复用设备既有资源的推理方案。

Method: 利用每台无线电台中已存在的频率混频器在时域进行信号相乘、天然等效于频域卷积这一特性，提出RF-CNN：把多通道卷积映射到频点上，使输入信号与携带权重的射频信号在无源混频器中单次前向完成卷积运算；权重通过空中传输获得，模拟硬件与通信功能共享，边缘设备仅承担数据准备与读出。

Result: 实验表明RF-CNN可运行多达9层、2640万参数的深度CNN，任务涵盖无线信号分类、图像分类以及可控图像生成，性能接近全精度模型；能效低至0.72 fJ/MAC，比在额外数字处理器上执行低约两个数量级。

Conclusion: 在已部署的无线通信基础设施上复用混频器即可为海量联网设备提供高效、接近最新水平的AI推理能力，说明通信硬件可作为边缘AI的低成本、高能效计算载体。

Abstract: Running artificial intelligence (AI) models directly on edge devices such as smartphones, wearables, and drones offers low latency, pervasive scalability, and data privacy, but these devices rarely carry the computing capability that modern neural networks demand. Edge accelerators have been developed in response, yet each adds computing hardware to devices already constrained in size, weight, power, and cost (SWaP-C). An alternative lies in what these devices already carry: the frequency mixer in every wireless radio multiplies signals in time, natively performing convolution in the frequency domain. Here we introduce radio-frequency convolutional neural networks (RF-CNNs), which repurpose existing communication hardware for CNN inference. Multi-channel convolutions are mapped onto frequency tones for a passive mixer to execute in a single pass. We experimentally demonstrate that RF-CNN runs deep CNNs up to 26.4 million parameters and nine layers from classification of wireless signals and images to controllable image generation, close to full-precision performance. Because the weights arrive over the air and the analog hardware is shared with communication, the edge device spends energy only on data preparation and readout-down to 0.72 femtojoules per multiply-accumulate, two orders of magnitude less than it would cost on an added digital processor. These results suggest that deployed wireless infrastructure can bring efficient, state-of-the-art AI inference to the billions of devices it already connects.

</details>


### [191] [Learning-Induced Dynamical Transition in Recurrent Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19288)
*Varun Vaidya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发展了非平衡动力学平均场理论(DMFT)，刻画循环神经网络在学习过程中从混沌动力学向稳定任务相关行为的转变，给出临界反馈强度与学习率相关的临界时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环神经网络的学习会重塑其底层动力学，使初始混沌活动转变为稳定的任务依赖行为，但这一转变的动力学机制缺乏理论描述，需要建立学习过程中的非平衡统计物理框架。

Method: 构建非平衡动力学平均场理论(DMFT)，通过在慢反馈驱动的学习过程中引入有效反馈强度，推导学习全过程的两时刻关联函数，并分析DMFT解的分岔来确定混沌-稳定转变。

Result: 识别出临界反馈强度以及依赖于学习率的临界时间，据此区分混沌与稳定两个区域；转变源于学习到的反馈结构不断增长，逐步形变有效动力学景观；理论预测的网络输出随训练的时间演化与数值模拟定量吻合。

Conclusion: 该非平衡DMFT为理解循环神经网络学习中的动力学转变提供了定量理论工具，揭示了临界反馈强度与学习率相关临界时间的作用，并得到数值验证。

Abstract: Learning in recurrent neural networks can fundamentally reshape their underlying dynamics, transforming initially chaotic activity into stable task-dependent behavior. We develop a non-equilibrium dynamical mean-field theory(DMFT) to describe this transition during learning. We show that a slow feedback-driven learning process generates an evolving effective feedback strength that drives the network through a transition from chaotic to stable dynamics defined by a bifurcation of the DMFT solution. By deriving the two-time correlation function throughout learning, we identify a critical feedback strength and a corresponding learning rate dependent critical time separating these regimes. The transition arises from the progressive deformation of an effective dynamical landscape by the growing learned feedback structure. Starting from the untrained state, the theory predicts the time evolution of the network output during training and shows quantitative agreement with numerical simulations.

</details>


### [192] [Personalized Federated Hierarchical Gaussian Processes for Privacy-Preserving Modeling of Heterogeneous Distributed Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19337)
*Xianjian Xie,Hao Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出个性化联邦层次高斯过程(pFedHGP),用于异构客户端下数据的概率回归与分类,通过共享全局成分、客户端偏差与局部残差的三层分解实现个性化建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦场景下数据分布在异构客户端,既要保护数据隐私不集中原始数据,又需应对客户端间的异质性,同时提供不确定性感知的预测。

Method: 将每个客户端的隐函数分解为三部分:共享全局成分、遵循全局核结构的客户端特定偏差、灵活局部残差;采用稀疏诱导变量近似与联邦变分推断,原始数据保留在本地,服务器仅同步共享成分的低维统计量;并从瞬时线性混合模型视角将层次结构与多输出高斯过程建立联系。

Result: 在压力机吨位监测中,仅用13.77%的标注周期即实现完美的故障分类;在联邦空气质量建模中恢复出地理分区,且未集中站点级时间序列。

Conclusion: pFedHGP能提供完整预测分布以支持不确定性感知决策,在保护隐私的同时有效处理客户端异构性,并在实际应用中取得良好效果。

Abstract: We present Personalized Federated Hierarchical Gaussian Processes (pFedHGP) for probabilistic regression and classification when data are distributed across heterogeneous clients. Each client's latent function decomposes into (i) a shared global component, (ii) a client-specific deviation that shares the global kernel structure, and (iii) a flexible local residual. Sparse inducing-variable approximations and federated variational inference keep raw data local while the server synchronizes only low-dimensional statistics for the shared component. Full predictive distributions support uncertainty-aware decisions. In application studies, pFedHGP attains perfect fault classification in press tonnage monitoring using 13.77% of labeled cycles and recovers geographic zones in federated air-quality modeling without centralizing station-level time series. An Instantaneous Linear Mixing Model viewpoint links the hierarchy to multi-output Gaussian processes for correlated sensors.

</details>


### [193] [How to Guide Your Language Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19356)
*Rohit Dilip,Tianrong Chen,Yuyang Wang,David Van Valen,Joshua Susskind,Miguel Angel Bautista*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"探针引导"(probe guidance)：利用冻结扩散模型的内部状态构造引导信号，无需额外前向传播，在连续扩散语言模型上取得无条件生成的新SOTA，并揭示了自引导机制依赖低熵训练区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自引导(autoguidance)需要额外的前向传播且难以保证弱模型与强模型动力学相似；同时其背后机制尚不清楚，亟需更高效、更可靠的引导方式并澄清其原理。

Method: 探针引导：使用现有扩散模型的冻结内部状态构建引导信号，原理类似自引导，但省去推理时的额外前向计算，并能确保弱、强模型共享相近动力学。在连续扩散语言模型上进行应用与基准测试，并借助探针研究以弱检查点为强模型的自引导设定。

Result: 在连续扩散语言模型的无条件生成上刷新SOTA；应用于1.7B扩散语言模型时，多项选择题基准稳定提升；探针分析发现弱模型必须来自训练的低熵区域。

Conclusion: 探针引导为改进扩散语言模型提供了实用手段，同时揭示了目前理解不足的自引导的真实机制，即弱模型的选取受限于低熵训练区域。

Abstract: We introduce a new method to guide flow matching models. Our approach, which we call probe guidance, uses the frozen internal states of an existing diffusion model to construct a guidance signal. This works using a similar principle as autoguidance, but eliminates the need for an additional forward pass at inference time and provides a reliable path to ensure that the weak and strong model share similar dynamics. We apply and benchmark this method on continuous diffusion language models, where probe guidance sets a new state-of-the-art performance on unconditional generation. When applied to a 1.7B diffusion language model, probe guidance consistently improves on multiple choice question answering benchmarks. Using our probes, we study the traditional autoguidance setting where the strong model is a weak checkpoint, and find that the weak model must come from a low-entropy region of training. These findings both provide a practical way to improve diffusion language models and shed light on the actual mechanism behind autoguidance, which is currently poorly understood.

</details>


### [194] [Smart Insole Human Activity Recognition for Continuous Monitoring in Elderly Care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19359)
*Edwin Rios,Antony Garcia,Fengpei Yuan,Xinming Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种无线智能鞋垫平台与机器学习流程，利用足底压力（每只鞋垫16个有源压力感应点）和六维IMU信号，识别坐、站、走及不稳定行走四类活动状态，并在参与者独立评估下验证了性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 老年人跌倒常先伴随移动能力、平衡和体位转换的变化，因此需要能从足底压力与惯性信号中推断活动状态的可穿戴方案，以支撑活动监测与跌倒预防。

Method: 构建集成16个有源压力感应位置和六维IMU（三轴加速度+三轴角速度）的无线智能鞋垫；对15名健康成年人以80 Hz采集数据并切分为重叠窗口。先用分层10折交叉验证筛选窗口长度与候选模型族，再以参与者独立的5折分层分组交叉验证（同一参与者所有窗口位于同一折）作为主要性能估计。对比HGB与紧凑1D-CNN。

Result: 在参与者独立协议下，Histogram-Based Gradient Boosting（HGB）左、右脚宏F1分别为0.954和0.959，双侧传感达0.980；紧凑1D-CNN在相同折下未显著优于HGB（p=0.0625）。
