Conclusion: BADA通过边界感知的数据增强有效缓解离线强化学习中的过拟合问题，提升了分布内泛化性与鲁棒性，为复杂环境下的稳定表现提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Current offline reinforcement learning (ORL) algorithms tend to overfit the training dataset and exhibit poor in-distribution generalization and robustness performance when deployed to real environments, thus compromising their effectiveness. Existing methods typically enhance in-distribution generalization and robustness by leveraging regularization techniques widely used in computer vision. However, due to the high sensitivity of low-level physical signals to distributional shifts, these methods still suffer from notable limitations in in-distribution generalization and robustness, making it difficult to achieve stable performance in complex environments. To address this issue, we theoretically analyze the error bounds of the behavior policy and action-value function trained with random episode interpolation, revealing that the error scales positively correlated with the distance between states. Based on this insight, we propose a method called $\bf{B}$oundary-$\bf{A}$ware $\bf{D}$ata $\bf{A}$ugmentation (BADA), which leverages neighboring states to construct interpolation boundaries, enabling the generation of synthetic data that more faithfully preserves the original data distribution. We first conduct qualitative studies in a toy environment, showing that BADA generates mixed samples that preserve desirable policy smoothness while accurately reconstructing multimodal value distributions. Extensive experiments on limited offline datasets further demonstrate that BADA attains state-of-the-art performance across diverse benchmarks.

</details>


### [263] [SAGG: Sample-Adaptive Gradient Gating for Robust Multimodal Learning under Heterogeneous Corruption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20302)
*Wentao Zhang,Yifan Zhu,Yutong Zhang,Wentao Mo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了多模态梯度平衡方法在样本异质污染下的固有偏差，提出样本级门控策略SAGG并证明其收敛性与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态梯度平衡方法采用每个模态共享的标量来调制编码器梯度，隐含假设训练批次内污染是均匀的。但实际中污染具有样本异质性——同一样本批次内，不同样本可能被污染的是不同模态。作者要研究这种异质污染模型下批次级方法的理论缺陷。

Method: 首先理论证明：在异质污染模型下，任何批次级、样本无关且共享调制参数的线性估计器，相对于干净数据梯度都存在不可消除的偏差；并证明样本级"全有或全无"门控是某类无分布假设估计器中唯一无偏的策略。基于此提出SAGG（Sample-Adaptive Gradient Gating），通过在线特征范数质量测试对每个样本做二值保留或丢弃决策，并加入截断机制控制方差。

Result: 证明SAGG驱动的SGD以标准O(1/sqrt(T))速率收敛到干净损失的稳定点，且无与污染相关的误差下限；为独立编码器架构推导了认证鲁棒半径，将各模态Lipschitz常数与分类间隔联系起来。在Kinetics-Sounds和UCF-101上，针对高斯噪声注入、部分模态缺失及自然贡献失衡三种场景，SAGG一致优于十种现有方法，在高污染（批次级偏差最严重）区间增益最大。

Conclusion: 样本级门控在异质污染下优于批次级梯度平衡，SAGG在理论与实验上均验证了其有效性，尤其在高污染场景优势显著。

Abstract: Multimodal gradient balancing methods modulate encoder gradients with a shared scalar per modality, implicitly assuming that corruption is uniform across the training batch. In practice, corruption is sample-heterogeneous: within a single mini-batch, different samples may have different modalities corrupted. We prove that under this heterogeneous corruption model, any batch-level sample-agnostic linear estimator with a shared modulation parameter incurs an irreducible bias with respect to the clean-data gradient, and that sample-level all-or-nothing gating is the unique unbiased strategy within a natural distribution-free estimator class. Motivated by this result, we propose Sample-Adaptive Gradient Gating (SAGG), which makes a binary retain-or-discard decision per sample via an online feature-norm quality test and incorporates a truncation mechanism for variance control. We prove that SAGG-based SGD converges at the standard O(1/sqrt(T)) rate to stationary points of the clean loss without a corruption-dependent error floor, and derive a certified robustness radius for the independent-encoder architecture that connects per-modality Lipschitz constants to the classification margin. Experiments on Kinetics-Sounds and UCF-101 under Gaussian noise injection, partial modality missing, and natural contribution imbalance show that SAGG consistently outperforms ten existing methods, with the largest gains in high-corruption regimes where batch-level bias is most severe.

</details>


### [264] [Hypernetwork-Parameterized Spatially Adaptive Neural Operators for PDE Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20309)
*Jiaquan Zhang,Chaoning Zhang,Shuxu Chen,Meng Ye,Xiaofeng Zhang,Qiang He,Weifeng Huang,Guoqing Wang,Yang Yang,Caiyan Qin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SANO 用空间连续的、位置相关的算子参数场替代传统空间共享参数化，通过坐标条件超网络与局部插值机制实现空间自适应神经算子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间异质 PDE 的动力学随几何与物理系数变化而具有位置依赖性。现有神经算子（多尺度特征、注意力、区域分解）的更新规则仍空间共享；超网络方法虽能跨 PDE 实例自适应参数，但通常每个实例只生成一个全局参数化。因此共享算子难以拟合边界与高梯度区域，且这些局部误差会在自回归推演中累积。

Method: SANO 以空间连续的位置相关算子参数场取代空间共享参数化：使用傅里叶编码坐标与坐标条件超网络，在采样点生成空间算子条件编码；引入 Hyper-Neural Element（HNE）机制，在局部子区域内插值这些编码，耦合相邻算子同时允许更新规则随空间变化；并用单位分解（partition-of-unity）权重组装重叠的局部预测。

Result: 在一维、二维、三维 PDE 以及两个穿孔域椭圆基准上，SANO 持续优于具有竞争力的神经算子、超网络类与物理信息基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过将算子参数化从空间共享转变为空间连续、位置相关的自适应形式，并结合局部插值与单位分解组装，SANO 能有效缓解边界与高梯度区域的局部误差累积，在多种维度与穿孔域 PDE 任务上取得一致的性能提升。

Abstract: Spatially heterogeneous partial differential equations (PDEs) exhibit location-dependent dynamics arising from variations in geometry and physical coefficients. Existing neural operators improve localized modeling through multiscale features, attention mechanisms, or domain decomposition, yet their update rules often remain spatially shared. Hypernetwork-based methods adapt parameters across PDE instances but typically generate only one global parameterization per instance. Consequently, shared operators may underfit boundaries and high-gradient regions, with these localized errors accumulating during autoregressive rollout. We propose a spatially adaptive neural operator (SANO), which replaces this spatially shared parameterization with a spatially continuous field of location-dependent operator parameters. SANO uses Fourier-encoded coordinates and a coordinate-conditioned hypernetwork to generate spatial operator-conditioning codes at sampling points. A Hyper-Neural Element (HNE) mechanism interpolates these codes within local subregions, coupling neighboring operators while allowing their update rules to vary across space, and partition-of-unity weights assemble the overlapping local predictions. Experiments on one-, two-, and three-dimensional PDEs and two perforated-domain elliptic benchmarks show that SANO consistently outperforms competitive neural-operator, hypernetwork-based, and physics-informed baselines.

</details>


### [265] [ZeroHAT: Behavior-Conditioned Zero-Shot Human Activity Trace Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20310)
*Rongchao Xu,Dahai Yu,Lin Jiang,Guang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZeroHAT 提出一种行为条件化框架，能够以零样本方式为目标区域生成合成人类活动轨迹，无需目标区域真实数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模人类活动轨迹（HATs）采集成本高且涉及隐私，而现有合成生成方法大多依赖目标区域真实数据，对于缺少真实 HATs 的区域不可行，因此需要跨区域零样本生成方法。

Method: ZeroHAT 由三个核心组件构成：(i) 多维一致性感知意图提取器；(ii) 跨区域行为克隆模块；(iii) 行为条件化活动实现模块。方法从源区域真实 HATs 中学习行为模式，并结合目标区域公开上下文信息进行适配。

Result: 在十城市基准上，ZeroHAT 的归一化下游效用达到最强基线的 4.5–6.4 倍，目标区域平均保真度提升 15.6%–40.8%。

Conclusion: ZeroHAT 证明了零样本跨区域合成 HAT 生成的可行性，在效用与保真度上显著优于现有基线，为缺乏真实 HATs 的区域提供了有效数据补充方案。

Abstract: Human activity traces record individuals' timestamped visits to points of interest and are essential for applications such as mobility prediction and urban simulation. However, accessing large-scale HATs is challenging due to high collection costs and privacy concerns. Synthetic HAT generation offers a promising way to make such data available and has attracted growing interest from both industry and academia. Although many efforts have been devoted to this topic, most of them rely on real data from a region to generate synthetic data for the same region, which is infeasible for the many regions where real HATs are unavailable. To fill this gap, we propose ZeroHAT, a behavior-conditioned framework that generates synthetic HATs for a target region in a zero-shot manner by transferring behavioral patterns learned from real HATs in source regions and adapting them with publicly available contextual information about the target region. ZeroHAT has three key novel components: (i) a multidimensional consistency-aware intent extractor; (ii) a cross-region behavioral cloning module; and (iii) a behavior-conditioned activity realization module. We evaluate ZeroHAT on a ten-city benchmark, where extensive experiments show that ZeroHAT achieves 4.5-6.4x the normalized downstream utility of the strongest baseline and improves average fidelity by 15.6%-40.8% across target regions.

</details>


### [266] [EviRec: Continual Evidence Learning for Dual Cold-Start POI Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20313)
*Rongchao Xu,Lin Jiang,Guang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过10个美国城市的大规模数据分析发现POI推荐中POI流失、用户更替、类别漂移及静态记忆衰减显著，提出"持续双冷启动POI推荐"问题及证据学习框架EviRec，在五个城市全年数据上取得最优效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有POI推荐方法普遍假设用户群体与POI目录固定不变，与实际动态演化严重不符。大规模数据分析揭示POI流失、用户更替、类别漂移及静态POI记忆衰减等问题，因此需要研究用户与POI同时冷启动的持续推荐场景。

Method: EviRec是一个持续证据学习框架，对每个候选POI单独估计历史证据的可信度。它从三个互补视角对可见候选打分：基于用户近期出行画像的匹配视角、捕捉重复出行规律的转移记忆视角、反映候选成熟度的生命周期视角。由于近零转移分数可能源于不相关或观测不足，EviRec利用候选的观测状态对证据进行限定，并通过可靠性门控在转移记忆与生命周期证据之间自适应路由。

Result: 在包含30,000余用户、684,200条轨迹的五城市全年POI签到数据集上，EviRec持续优于最先进基线，且在冷启动查询上增益最大：Dual-New场景下NDCG@10较最强基线提升20.4%。深入分析表明增益主要来自候选级可靠性门控，同时基本保留已学到的出行规律。

Conclusion: EviRec验证了面向持续双冷启动场景的候选级证据可信度估计与可靠性门控的有效性，能够在适应动态环境的同时保持历史知识，为动态POI推荐提供了新范式。

Abstract: Point-of-Interest (POI) recommendation is a core task in location-based services, yet most existing methods assume a fixed user population and POI catalog. Through a large-scale data-driven analysis of 10 U.S. cities, we identify substantial POI churn, user turnover, category drift, and decay in static POI memory, motivating the study of continual dual cold-start POI recommendation. To address this setting, we propose EviRec, a continual evidence-learning framework that estimates how much historical evidence should be trusted separately for each candidate POI. EviRec scores each visible candidate from three complementary views: a matching view based on the user's recent mobility profile, a transition-memory view that captures repeated mobility routines, and a lifecycle view that reflects candidate maturity. Because a near-zero transition score may indicate either irrelevance or insufficient observation, EviRec qualifies the evidence using each candidate's observation state and applies a reliability gate to adaptively route between transition-memory and lifecycle evidence. We evaluate EviRec on a full-year, five-city POI check-in dataset containing more than 30,000 users and 684,200 trajectories. Experimental results show that EviRec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with the largest gains concentrated on cold-start queries. In particular, EviRec improves NDCG@10 by 20.4\% on Dual-New cases over the strongest baseline. In-depth analyses further confirm that these gains arise primarily from candidate-specific reliability gating while largely preserving previously learned mobility routines.

</details>


### [267] [Sharp Reconstruction Bounds for Autoencoders Using the Same Forward Map](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20333)
*Patricia Medina,Hy P. G. Lam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究自编码器在观测坐标置零前后施加同一前向映射的重构问题，给出最坏情况下重构导数误差的尖锐下界，并在大规模LiDAR森林扫描数据上验证理论预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究自编码器中"同一前向映射"重构机制的理论极限，理解为何实践中重构误差存在下界，并为有限数据条件下的重构误差提供理论刻画。

Method: 在等奇数输入与隐维d≥3的条件下，限定保向微分同胚且Jacobian奇异值落在[m,M]区间，推导一致重构导数误差的最小值；构造平移径向旋转反例以说明仅有该约束不足以得到有限数据界；在798,452点地面LiDAR森林扫描上进行实验验证。

Result: 最一致重构导数误差为max{1-M(M-m)/2,0}，仿射映射在每个指定深度均可达该尖锐界；平移径向旋转能以任意接近1的奇异值精确重构任意指定球体。在输入尺度0.05下，理论均值界0.155约为四个空间区域、两个深度、三个随机种子下平均归一化训练误差0.185的84%；该尺度下增加一个隐坐标可将平均重构误差降至6×10⁻⁶以下。

Conclusion: 理论下界与实践重构误差在数量级上吻合，验证了该尖锐界的实际意义；但存在反例表明需附加条件才能得到有限数据界，且增加隐维可显著改善重构精度。

Abstract: We study reconstruction in autoencoders that apply the same forward map before and after setting the observed coordinates to zero. For equal odd input and hidden dimensions $d\geq 3$, among orientation-preserving diffeomorphisms whose Jacobian singular values lie in $[m,M]$, we show that the least uniform reconstruction-derivative error is $\max\{1-M(M-m)/2,0\}$, with affine maps attaining this sharp bound at every prescribed depth. A translated radial rotation can nevertheless reconstruct any prescribed ball exactly with singular values arbitrarily close to one, motivating additional conditions for a finite-data bound. We test this prediction on a 798,452-point terrestrial LiDAR forest scan. At input scale $0.05$, the mean theoretical bound is $0.155$, about $84\%$ of the mean normalized training error $0.185$ across four spatial regions, two depths, and three seeds. At this scale, adding one hidden coordinate reduces the mean reconstruction error below $6\times10^{-6}$.

</details>


### [268] [COMPASS: Ordered Clustered Routing at 100K Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20352)
*Ido Greenberg,Hugo Linsenmaier,Piotr Sielski,Shie Mannor,Alex Fender,Gal Chechik,Eli Meirom*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出COMPASS算法用于求解有序聚类旅行商问题（OCTSP）。该方法结合搜索与学习加速的路由，通过并行子求解器协同工作，具备无质量上限、随算力提升可持续改进解的特性，可利用聚类结构在簇规模指数时间内求得精确解，并在10万合成节点和2.85万真实电商节点上验证了可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模路由常需按指定顺序访问节点簇，这构成OCTSP问题。独立优化每个簇虽直观，但会忽略非局部依赖关系，因此需要一种能兼顾聚类结构与全局依赖的求解方法。

Method: 提出COMPASS算法，结合搜索与学习加速的路由，通过编排并行子求解器求解OCTSP。该算法利用聚类结构，可获得精确解，时间复杂度关于簇规模而非整体实例规模呈指数级；同时支持通用距离矩阵输入，不限于坐标形式。

Result: 实验表明COMPASS持续优于其他方法；可扩展至10万合成节点及2.85万真实电商节点。后者据称是已报道的最大非对称距离路由解，规模超出既有ATSP基准9倍。

Conclusion: COMPASS为OCTSP提供了可扩展、可随算力持续优化的求解框架，突破了坐标输入的局限，并显著提升了大规模非对称距离路由的求解规模。

Abstract: Large-scale routing often requires visiting clusters of nodes in a prescribed order, giving rise to the Ordered Clustered Traveling Salesman Problem (OCTSP). Optimizing each cluster independently seems natural, but misses non-local dependencies. We introduce the COMPASS algorithm for OCTSP, which combines search with learning-accelerated routing by orchestrating parallel sub-solvers. COMPASS has no quality ceiling and its solutions keep improving with compute. It exploits the clustered structure, and can reach exact solutions in time exponential in cluster size rather than instance size. Empirically, COMPASS consistently outperforms alternative methods. Unlike common large-scale routing solvers, COMPASS consumes general distance matrices and is not limited to coordinate inputs. We demonstrate scaling to 100K synthetic nodes and to 28.5K real e-commerce nodes. To our knowledge, the latter is the largest reported routing solution over asymmetric distances, 9x beyond established ATSP benchmarks.

</details>


### [269] [Minimax-Optimal Online Contract Design with Unrestricted Bounded Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20353)
*Rui Ai,David Simchi-Levi,Han Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究重复合约设计中的极小极大后悔：当主事人只能观察结果而无法观察行动、代理人可行动作空间任意且可能存在异质性时，对任意固定结果数 m≥2，T 轮后悔的阶为 T^{m/(m+1)}（忽略对数因子）。上界通过对基准的“有效维度约减”与显示偏好构造支付差分坐标下的单调响应映射，并用 Lipschitz 参数化学习策略仅凭观测结果类别达到该速率；下界刻画了激励损失跨结果维度的累积，表明每增加一个可合约结果都会带来不可避免的最坏学习代价上升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究主事人在只能观察结果、无法观察代理人行动的条件下进行重复合约设计的问题。核心挑战在于：代理人最优反应会使期望利润在支付向量上不连续，且以往方法多依赖平滑性或单调剩余等强假设。作者希望在更一般（任意行动空间、代理人异质性、无平滑性/单调剩余）的框架下刻画可达到的最优学习速率，并揭示结果维度对学习难度的影响。

Method: 1) 允许主事人使用任意有界的结果依赖支付向量，分析代理人最优反应导致期望利润不连续的情形。2) 上界方法：对基准进行“有效维度约减”（effective-dimension reduction），处理固定破平规则不具平移不变性的问题，将其归一化；随后利用显示偏好（revealed preference），在支付差分坐标下得到单调响应映射，并用其 Lipschitz 参数化构造学习策略，仅依赖观测到的结果类别。3) 下界方法：构造考虑激励损失如何跨结果维度累积的对抗实例。

Result: 对每个固定结果数 m≥2，T 轮极小极大后悔约为 T^{m/(m+1)}（忽略对数因子）。上界适用于任意行动空间与代理人异质性，无需平滑性或单调剩余假设；学习策略仅使用观测结果类别即可达到该速率。下界表明每增加一个可合约结果，最坏情况下的学习成本都会精确且不可避免地上一个档次。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了重复合约设计中随结果数 m 变化的紧致极小极大后悔率 T^{m/(m+1)}，在极弱假设下同时建立上界与下界。关键贡献是把问题归约为支付差分坐标下的单调响应学习，并证明结果维度对学习代价具有结构性且不可避免的影响。

Abstract: We study repeated contract design when a principal observes outcomes but not the actions that generate them. The principal may use any bounded outcome-contingent payment vector, and the agent's best response can make expected profit discontinuous in those payments. For every fixed number $m\ge2$ of outcomes, the minimax regret over $T$ rounds is of order $T^{m/(m+1)}$, up to logarithmic factors. The upper bound allows arbitrary action spaces and agent heterogeneity, without smoothness or monotone-surplus assumptions. Its key is an effective-dimension reduction that the benchmark can be normalized even when fixed tie-breaking is not shift invariant, after which revealed preference yields a monotone response map in payment-difference coordinates. A learning policy built on a Lipschitz parametrization of this map attains the rate using only observed outcome categories. The lower-bound construction accounts for how incentive losses accumulate across outcome dimensions. It shows that each additional contractible outcome creates a precise and unavoidable increase in the worst-case cost of learning.

</details>


### [270] [Learning Principal-Agent Contracts for Equitable Smallholder Carbon Farming under Moral Hazard and Adverse Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20404)
*Rishi Bharadwaj,Yadati Narahari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将农业碳合同中聚合者与小农之间的动态契约问题建模为POMDP，用强化学习求解利润最大化的动态合同，发现利润最大化的聚合者会放大而非缓解对小农的排斥，并指出按面积比例分摊MRV成本可消除这一差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农业土壤是尚未开发的巨大碳汇，碳农业被视为挖掘该潜力的重要实践。南亚和撒哈拉以南非洲以小农为主，小农是规模化气候减缓的关键。然而现实中的碳项目基本无法触达小农，这一悖论构成研究的核心动机。

Method: 从合同设计视角切入，设定一个聚合者向异质性小农群体提供单一池化合同。农户具有私人采纳成本（逆向选择）和不可观测努力（道德风险），农艺结果跨多个季节演化。将这一演化型契约问题形式化为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），并用强化学习学习动态的利润最大化合同。

Result: 利润最大化的聚合者不仅继承了小农被排斥的现状，还放大了这种排斥。在大农场上聚合者实现了87.7%的可实现采纳率，而小农场上仅为8.2%。每公顷的监测、报告与核查（MRV）成本随农场规模上升而下降，聚合者的池化合同进一步加剧而非抵消这一梯度。反事实分析表明，若使MRV成本完全按面积比例分摊，则可消除这种差距。

Conclusion: 研究结果与仿真可为合同和政策设计提供指导，使碳收益向小农开放，同时让农业土壤大规模地贡献于气候减缓。

Abstract: Agricultural soils are a major untapped carbon sink. Carbon farming is emerging as a promising practice for tapping this potential. Smallholder farmers, who dominate agriculture across South Asia and sub-Saharan Africa, are key to scaling climate mitigation via carbon farming. It is ironic that real-world carbon programs largely fail to reach them. We study this important gap through the lens of contract design. An aggregator offers a single pooled contract to a heterogeneous population of smallholder farmers who have private adoption costs (adverse selection) and exert unobserved effort (moral hazard), with agronomic outcomes evolving over multiple seasons. We formulate this evolving contracting problem as a POMDP and use reinforcement learning to learn a dynamic profit-maximising contract. We analyse the performance of the aggregator under various conditions. We find that a profit-maximising aggregator does not merely inherit the exclusion of smallholders, it amplifies it. On large farms the aggregator realises 87.7% of achievable adoption, against only 8.2% on smallholdings. Per-hectare Measurement, Reporting and Verification (MRV) costs fall as farm size rises, and the aggregator's pooling contract compounds this gradient rather than offsetting it. A counterfactual that makes MRV costs purely area-proportional eliminates this disparity. Our results and simulation can guide contract and policy design that opens carbon income to smallholders while enabling agricultural soils to contribute to climate mitigation at scale.

</details>


### [271] [The Bias of Nonlinear Two-Time-scale Stochastic Approximation under Constant Step-Sizes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20409)
*Djamel Rassem Lamouri,Dorian Baudry,Nicolas Gast*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究常步长下非线性双时间尺度随机逼近(TTSA)的有限时间误差界，给出均方误差与偏差的 $O(\alpha+\beta^2/\alpha^2)$ 上界，并在 $\beta\le\alpha^{3/2}$ 时证明其紧性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双时间尺度随机逼近(TTSA)是分析强化学习、优化与随机控制中耦合迭代算法的基本工具，但非线性双时间尺度格式的有限时间保证仍难以获得，尤其在常步长情形下。已有工作多聚焦线性TTSA，非线性动力学带来的有限时间效应尚不清晰。

Method: 在标准稳定性、正则性与马尔可夫噪声假设下，研究步长满足 $\alpha\gg\beta$ 的非线性TTSA；对两个迭代序列相对其极限均衡的均方误差与偏差进行上界分析，并将误差来源分解为初始条件、快时间尺度跟踪误差、马尔可夫依赖与时间尺度耦合四部分。

Result: 误差上界形如 $O(\alpha+\beta^2/\alpha^2)$，并证明当 $\beta\le\alpha^{3/2}$ 时该界是紧的。误差分解澄清了 $\beta^2/\alpha^2$ 项的来源，并揭示非线性TTSA与既有线性TTSA结果之间存在定性差异，即非线性动力学引入了线性情形中不存在的额外有限时间效应。

Conclusion: 本文为常步长非线性TTSA建立了紧的有限时间均方误差与偏差界，明确了各误差分量的贡献，指出了非线性与线性TTSA在有限时间行为上的本质区别。

Abstract: Two-timescale stochastic approximation (TTSA) is a fundamental tool for analyzing coupled iterative algorithms in reinforcement learning, optimization, and stochastic control. However, finite-time guarantees for nonlinear two-timescale schemes remain difficult to obtain, especially under constant step-sizes. In this paper, we study nonlinear TTSA with step-sizes $α\ggβ$. Under standard stability, regularity, and Markovian noise assumptions, we upper bound the mean-squared error and the bias of both iterates around their limiting equilibria. Our bounds scale as $O(α+β^2/α^2)$, which we prove to be tight when $β\leα^{3/2}$. The analysis separates the contributions of initial conditions, fast-timescale tracking error, Markovian dependence, and timescale coupling, thereby clarifying the origin of the $β^2/α^2$ term. Our results reveal qualitative differences from the linear TTSA setting previously studied, showing that nonlinear dynamics introduce additional finite-time effects that are absent in the linear case.

</details>


### [272] [SCGFM-ART: Amortized Relational Transport for Structure-Centric Graph Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20419)
*Xiaodong He,Xincheng Wang,Zhao Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出结构中心图基础模型SCGFM-ART，用摊销关系传输（ART）将任意图对齐到共享"关系地图集"，实现跨域统一表示，避免运行时的Gromov-Wasserstein优化，取得SOTA迁移性能并大幅加速推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图基础模型（GFM）旨在跨高度异质的图域学习可迁移表示，但拓扑、图规模与特征语义的严重域偏移阻碍了统一、域无关表示空间的构建。

Method: SCGFM-ART以结构为中心，将任意图通过Amortized Relational Transport（ART）对齐到由有限关系地标（基）定义的通用坐标系——关系地图集；ART直接预测可复用、端到端的图到基传输方案，绕过昂贵的运行时Gromov-Wasserstein优化。图被分解为全局（相对地图集的关系响应坐标）与局部（节点到角色的结构对应）的统一表示，后者将异构节点属性投影到规范角色空间以统一处理结构与语义异质性。理论分析将图与地图集基建模为有限测度关系空间。

Result: 在14项跨域图级与节点级分类任务上取得SOTA可迁移性，平均排名分别为2.29与1.14；拓扑扰动分析表明节点—角色传输能保留超出全局坐标的细粒度结构；真实基准上摊销公式使冻结目标域推理提速44.2至85.1倍。

Conclusion: SCGFM-ART通过结构中心的关系地图集与摊销关系传输，为异质图域提供统一对齐接口，并给出坐标保真界、预测传输稳定性与摊销覆盖界等理论保证，兼顾迁移性能与推理效率。

Abstract: Graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to learn transferable representations across severely heterogeneous graph domains. However, severe domain shifts in topology, graph scale, and feature semantics impede the construction of a unified, domain-agnostic representation space. To address this, we propose SCGFM-ART, a structure-centric GFM framework that aligns arbitrary graphs onto a shared relational atlas via Amortized Relational Transport (ART). The relational atlas serves as a universal coordinate system defined by a finite set of relational landmarks (bases), while ART directly predicts reusable, end-to-end graph-to-base transport plans, bypassing costly runtime Gromov-Wasserstein optimizations. Under this formulation, SCGFM-ART decomposes a graph into a unified representation: globally via its relational response coordinates relative to the atlas, and locally via its node-to-role structural correspondences. These correspondences project disparate node attributes into a canonical role space, resolving structural and semantic heterogeneity within a singular alignment interface. Rigorously modeling graphs and atlas bases as finite measured relational spaces, we establish coordinate fidelity bounds, prove stability under predicted transport plans, and derive an amortized coverage bound that guarantees our learning objective tightly surrogates ideal relational coverage. Benchmarked across 14 cross-domain graph- and node-level classification tasks, SCGFM-ART achieves state-of-the-art transferability, securing superior average ranks of 2.29 and 1.14, respectively. Topological perturbation analyses demonstrate that node-role transport retains fine-grained structural nuances beyond global coordinates. On real-world benchmarks, the amortized formulation yields 44.2 to 85.1 times faster frozen target-domain inference by avoiding iterative alignment at test time.

</details>


### [273] [Seismic Site Response Prediction from Sparse Observations Using Finite-Element-Pretrained Latent Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20451)
*Yi Zhu,Su Chen,Xiaojun Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FLARE-T框架，用低维潜动力学学习并校准场地反应预测，在离心机试验与Lotung台阵上均优于原始有限元模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数值场地反应预测常与观测不符，但受传感器覆盖和事件数量限制，记录稀少，难以直接修正偏差。

Method: FLARE-T先从密集有限元模拟中学习低维反应流形与输入驱动动力学；再训练稀疏编码器将模拟传感器反应映射到该潜坐标；最后用有限实测记录在潜空间内校准动力学。预测由短反应窗口初始化，完整基底运动驱动整个过程。

Result: 在层状土离心机试验与Lotung竖向台阵上，FLARE-T改善了多深度加速度时程和5%阻尼伪加速度反应谱，在各强度运动下每个传感器误差均降低，Lotung两个水平分量亦然。两个不同本构参数的Lotung震源模型取得相近测试精度。

Conclusion: FLARE-T提供了一种数据高效的方式，将稠密数值反应信息与有限现场记录结合，降低对精确先验标定的依赖，改进未来场地反应预测。

Abstract: Numerical site-response predictions often deviate from observations, yet correcting these discrepancies is difficult because records are limited in both sensor coverage and number of events. This study proposes the Transfer-Enabled Forced Latent Autoencoder for Response Equations (FLARE-T) to improve these predictions by learning and calibrating low-dimensional latent dynamics that connect the base acceleration input to acceleration outputs at multiple depths. FLARE-T learns a low-dimensional response manifold and input-driven dynamics from dense finite-element simulations. It then trains a sparse encoder to map simulated sensor responses into the learned coordinates and uses limited records to calibrate the dynamics within them. A short response window initializes each prediction, while the complete base motion drives the response. The framework was evaluated using a layered-soil centrifuge test and the Lotung field vertical array. Test-set results show that FLARE-T improved multi-depth acceleration histories and 5%-damped pseudoacceleration response spectra relative to the original finite-element models, reducing errors at every evaluated sensor for motions of different intensities and, at Lotung, for both horizontal components. Two Lotung source models with different constitutive parameters achieved comparable test-set accuracy, indicating reduced dependence on precise prior calibration. FLARE-T therefore provides a data-efficient means of combining dense numerical response information with limited field records to improve future site-response predictions.

</details>


### [274] [Training Neural Networks to Approach the Optimum Bayes Estimator in Dense Multi-Emitter Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20465)
*Yi Sun,Mona Sharifi,Muzna Yumman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文通过合成帧训练神经网络，逼近密集发射体定位的贝叶斯最优估计器，验证了用神经网络实现高通量、大视场超时空分辨SMLM的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集发射体定位在SMLM中面临定位精度与通量/视场难以兼得的挑战；传统贝叶斯估计器虽理论最优但计算昂贵，需探索神经网络能否逼近其性能，以支撑高通量、大视场超时空分辨成像。

Method: 采用合成（模拟）帧数据训练神经网络，使其学习逼近密集发射体定位任务的贝叶斯最优估计器。

Result: 实验结果表明，在合成帧上训练的神经网络能够逼近该贝叶斯最优估计器的性能。

Conclusion: 该结果支持后续工作：通过训练神经网络实现高通量、大视场、超时空分辨的SMLM。

Abstract: We train neural networks on synthesized frames to approach the optimum Bayes estimator for dense emitter localization. The result justifies the future work on training neural networks to achieve high-throughput large-FOV super spatiotemporal resolution SMLM.

</details>


### [275] [Deep Learning-Based Classification of Cognitive and Resting States Using Electroencephalography Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20467)
*K. A. Januka S. Fernando,Harshit Srivastava*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出一种结合CNN与GRU的深度学习框架，通过时频分析提取EEG信号特征，实现对静息状态与认知状态（数学、记忆、音乐任务）的有效分类，准确率分别达83.177%、76.107%、83.432%，优于对比方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于EEG的认知与静息状态分类对于理解与不同心理状态相关的大脑活动波动至关重要。EEG能以非侵入方式记录静息与任务导向认知状态下的脑功能，而深度学习可自动从复杂EEG数据中提取重要模式，因此有必要构建有效的自动分类框架。

Method: 提出一个深度学习框架用于区分静息与认知状态。该框架将卷积神经网络（CNN）与门控循环单元（GRU）堆叠，用于从EEG信号中提取特征。同时进行时频分析以探索信号的显著特征，并将提取的特征输入传统深度学习与机器学习分类器（包括所提出的2D-Net架构）进行评估。

Result: 所提方法及特征提取策略优于所评估的对比方法：静息-数学任务分类准确率为83.177%，静息-记忆任务分类准确率为76.107%，静息-音乐任务分类准确率为83.432%。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，将信号处理与深度学习方法相结合，可有效利用EEG信号区分静息状态与认知状态。

Abstract: The categorization of cognitive and resting states derived from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is crucial for comprehending fluctuations in brain activity linked to various mental states. EEG provides a non-intrusive approach for documenting brain function in both resting and task-oriented cognitive conditions, whilst deep learning techniques enable the automatic extraction of significant patterns from intricate EEG data. This study presents a deep learning framework to distinguish between resting and cognitive states through EEG records. The proposed framework integrates a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) stacked with a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) for the extraction of features from EEG signals. Time-frequency analysis is conducted to explore the salient aspects of signals, and the derived features are then assessed utilizing conventional deep learning and machine learning classifiers, including the suggested 2D-Net architecture. The proposed approach and feature extraction strategy outperform the evaluated comparative methods, achieving accuracies of 83.177% for resting-versus-mathematical task classification, 76.107% for resting-versus-memory task classification, and 83.432% for resting-versus-music task classification. The findings illustrate the efficacy of integrating signal processing with deep learning methodologies to discriminate resting from cognitive states utilizing EEG signals.

</details>


### [276] [Distributionally Robust Federated Learning with Multi-Source Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20501)
*Yingzhu Liu,Zhongkui Li,Pengcheng You,Ashish Cherukuri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对联邦学习中跨客户端混合比例不确定与客户端内分布模糊双重问题，构建局部模糊集的可行混合之并作为全局模糊集，并给出可分离重构、样本外泛化保证及收敛的联邦算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习从私有客户端数据训练共享模型，但数据生成分布可能不同，且客户端间的真实混合比例常未知，导致底层群组分布难以刻画。现有方法虽以最坏情况混合应对跨客户端混合不确定性，却依赖对每个客户端分布的准确估计；当估计基于有限样本时并不可靠，因此需要同时处理跨客户端混合不确定性与客户端内分布模糊。

Method: 构造全局模糊集为局部模糊集的可容许混合之并，允许客户端特定的模糊半径，并给出按客户端可分离的重构形式；基于该结构建立高概率的样本外性能保证；进一步针对惩罚式重构开发联邦算法，并在更温和的正则条件下证明其收敛性。

Result: 获得了高概率样本外性能保证；证明了所提联邦算法在更弱正则条件下的收敛性；仿真实验验证了算法的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过将跨客户端混合不确定性与客户端内分布模糊统一到局部模糊集混合之并的框架中，论文提供了理论保证与可收敛的联邦算法，为分布不确定下的联邦学习提供了鲁棒建模与优化方案。

Abstract: Federated learning trains a shared model from private client data. In practice, data-generating distributions may differ, and the true mixture across clients is often unknown, making the underlying group distribution difficult to specify. Existing approaches address cross-client mixture uncertainty by optimizing against the worst-case mixture, yet assume accurate client-wise distribution estimates. However, these estimates can be unreliable when based on finite samples. To handle both cross-client mixture uncertainty and within-client distributional ambiguity, we construct a global ambiguity set as the union of admissible mixtures of local ambiguity sets. The construction allows client-specific ambiguity radii and admits a client-wise separable reformulation. Leveraging this structure, we establish a high-probability out-of-sample performance guarantee. We further develop a federated algorithm for a penalty-based reformulation and prove its convergence under milder regularity conditions. Simulations validate the algorithm's effectiveness.

</details>


### [277] [Don't Mask the Environment: Observation Supervision Changes How Agents Explore Under RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20715)
*Juzheng Zhang,Disha Makhija,Manoj Ghuhan Arivazhagan,Vinayshekhar Bannihatti Kumar,Rashmi Gangadharaiah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ActObs 方法，在 SFT 阶段同时对 agent 的动作 token 和环境观测 token 施加监督损失，使策略学习预测动作后果，从而为后续强化学习（GRPO）提供更好的初始化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 SFT 只对 agent 生成的动作 token 计算损失，将环境观测仅作为上下文而不作为预测目标。作者质疑这一惯例是否为后续强化学习提供了最优初始化，希望探索是否还能更充分地利用轨迹中已有的观测信息。

Method: ActObs 在 SFT 中对轨迹中本就存在的观测 token 也施加监督。由于部署时 agent 并不生成观测，该做法不增加数据、参数、序列 token 或前向计算，仅通过预测观测来促使策略建模动作后果。之后在 GRPO 强化学习阶段进一步对比其效果。

Result: SFT 后两种方法表现相近，但在 GRPO 后出现分化。Qwen3-4B 上，ActObs 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 各采样预算下 pass@k 均更高；Qwen3-8B 上以部分 pass@1 可靠性换取更高 pass@k（pass@16 提升 3.4 pp）并解决更多不同任务。在 SFT 与 RL 均未见过的 aider-polyglot 跨域代码编辑任务上也有提升（4B 模型 pass@1 +4.2 pp）。RL 中保留更多熵且所需策略移动更少，最终策略更接近 SFT 初始化。

Conclusion: 分析表明差异源于 SFT：动作与观测梯度迅速趋于正交，仅动作训练会留下较大残余观测梯度，并使环境预测能力退化至低于基座模型。联合监督可防止这种单向专业化，保留后果预测能力，为下游探索做好准备。

Abstract: Agent trajectories record what an agent does and what happens next. Yet standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) applies loss only to agent-authored action tokens, using environment observations as context but not as prediction targets. We ask whether this convention provides the best initialization for subsequent reinforcement learning. We introduce ActObs, which also supervises the observation tokens already present in each trajectory. Although deployed agents never generate observations, learning to predict them encourages the policy to model action consequences without adding data, parameters, sequence tokens, or forward passes. The methods perform similarly after SFT but diverge after GRPO. On Qwen3-4B, GRPO from ActObs achieves higher pass@k at every evaluated sampling budget than its action-only counterpart on Terminal-Bench 2.0. On Qwen3-8B, it trades some pass@1 reliability for higher pass@k (+3.4 pp at pass@16) and solves more distinct tasks. The advantage extends to cross-domain code editing on aider-polyglot (+4.2 pp at pass@1 at 4B), whose tasks are unseen during SFT and RL. ActObs retains more entropy during RL while requiring less policy movement, leaving the final policy closer to its SFT initialization. Our analysis traces this difference to SFT: action and observation gradients rapidly become orthogonal, while action-only training leaves a large residual observation gradient and degrades environment prediction below the base model. Joint supervision prevents this one-sided specialization, preserving consequence prediction and preparing the policy for downstream exploration.

</details>


### [278] [Radio Frequency Detection and Classification of Microplastics in Water](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20507)
*Jaden Tolbert,Md Saiful Islam,Pingshan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出机器学习辅助射频介电光谱流式细胞术（DiSC）平台，实现水环境中微塑料/纳米塑料的无标记检测与分类，八类10 μm微塑料宏观平均F1、精确率、召回率均超过0.71。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微纳米塑料颗粒作为普遍存在的环境污染物，其丰度上升与潜在健康影响亟需快速、无标记的检测方法。当粒径降至低微米范围时，传统光学与光谱技术受限于通量不足和/或样品制备复杂，难以胜任，因此需要发展新的检测手段。

Method: 构建机器学习（ML）辅助的射频（RF）介电光谱流式细胞术（DiSC）平台。将八类标称直径10 μm的微塑料颗粒悬浮于去离子水中，在0.2–9 GHz范围内选取四个频率进行表征；以载体介质为参考测量射频散射参数（S参数）的变化，并据此训练监督式机器学习模型，用于材料分类，包括混合样品和盐水环境中的微塑料识别。

Result: 对去离子水中八类微塑料，所提方法的宏观平均F1分数、精确率和召回率均超过0.71；在含3.3%和6.6%海盐的盐水载体介质中，PET的分类性能基本得以保持。

Conclusion: 结果证明ML辅助RF DiSC用于水环境中快速、单颗粒微塑料分类的可行性。未来工作将通过改进RF校准、增加光谱覆盖范围、扩大训练数据集，以及采用环境老化与生物污染的微塑料进行验证来提升分类性能。

Abstract: Micro- and nano-plastic particles (MPs/NPs) are ubiquitous environmental contaminants whose increasing abundance and potential health impacts have created an urgent need for rapid, label-free detection methods. As particle size decreases to the low-micrometer range, conventional optical and spectroscopic techniques become increasingly challenging because of limited throughput and/or complex sample preparation. In this work, we present a machine learning (ML)-assisted radio-frequency (RF) dielectric spectroscopic cytometry (DiSC) platform for the label-free detection and classification of MPs. Eight types of $ 10 $ μm nominal-diameter MP particles suspended in deionized (DI) water were characterized at four frequencies spanning $ 0.2\text{-}9\text{ GHz} $. The measured alterations in RF scattering parameters (S-parameters), referenced to the carrier medium, were used to train supervised ML models for material classification, including the identification of MPs in mixed samples and saline-water environments. For eight MP classes suspended in DI water, the proposed method achieved macro-average F1-score, precision, and recall values exceeding $ 0.71 $. Furthermore, PET classification performance was largely maintained in saline carrier media containing $3.3\% $ and $ 6.6\% $ sea salt. These results demonstrate the feasibility of ML-assisted RF DiSC for rapid, single-particle MP classification in aqueous environments. Future work will focus on improving classification performance through enhanced RF calibration, increased spectral coverage, larger training datasets, and validation using environmentally aged and biologically contaminated microplastics.

</details>


### [279] [When EOS Tokens Disagree: Understanding Length Inflation in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20511)
*Yuxiao Yang,Tianrun Yu,Shangzhe Li,Kaixiang Zhao,Xuchao Zhang,Chetan Bansal,Huaxiu Yao,Taylor W. Killian,Weitong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在线策略蒸馏（OPD）中的长度膨胀问题，发现基座学生与后训练教师之间存在“终止词元不匹配”是重要成因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPD中学生回复过长甚至耗尽生成预算，需探究其成因。

Method: 在Qwen3、Llama和Gemma上对比学生与教师的EOS概率分布；仅对齐解码停止集；将功能等价的EOS词元视为共享语义停止动作；并进行K2-Horizon分阶段分析。

Result: 两模型即使声明停止集相同，也可能将停止概率置于不同EOS词元；仅对齐停止集无效，共享语义停止动作可显著缓解三个模型族中的长度膨胀；分阶段分析显示终止偏好随训练大幅变化，且晚期存在与终止对齐无关的长度膨胀。

Conclusion: 终止不匹配是OPD长度动态的重要但非唯一原因，作者发布了包含终止处理修正的实现。

Abstract: We study length inflation in on-policy distillation (OPD), where student responses can become excessively long and even exhaust the generation budget. We identify \emph{termination-token mismatch} between base students and post-trained teachers as an important source of this behavior. Across Qwen3, Llama, and Gemma, the two models can place their stopping probability on different EOS tokens, even when their declared stopping sets are identical. This mismatch can suppress the student's preferred termination action without reliably transferring the teacher-preferred alternative. We show that aligning the decoding stopping set alone is insufficient, while treating functionally equivalent EOS tokens as a shared semantic stopping action substantially mitigates mismatch-induced length inflation across all three model families. To further understand how termination behavior evolves over training, we study OPD across different K2-Horizon training stages. This stage-wise analysis shows that termination preferences can shift substantially during training, while also revealing a distinct length inflation late in the OPD run that persists beyond termination alignment. Together, these results identify termination mismatch as an important, but not exhaustive, source of OPD length dynamics. We release an implementation incorporating the proposed termination-handling corrections.

</details>


### [280] [Parallelism, critical windows, and separations among diffusion language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20539)
*Sitan Chen,Liye Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次从理论上细粒度比较了masked、uniform与Gaussian三类扩散大语言模型(dLLM)的并行采样能力,证明了uniform/Gaussian扩散的采样前向次数可由分布的dual total correlation界定,并给出了其与masked扩散之间的首个可证并行性分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型的流行卖点是可以比需逐token前向的自回归模型更高效地并行生成文本,但在masked、uniform、Gaussian等多种扩散范式之间,关于并行性的原理性理解仍很有限,缺乏细粒度且可证明的比较。

Method: 理论分析:证明uniform与Gaussian扩散能以与底层分布dual total correlation(内在复杂度度量,可远小于上下文长度)成比例的前向次数完成采样(此前仅知masked扩散可做到);并针对一类随机经验测度,分析uniform/Gaussian扩散所需前向次数的下界与上界,同时构造近似score oracle来界定masked扩散所需前向次数,从而建立分离;进一步分析三类采样中critical window的宽度。

Result: 1) uniform与Gaussian扩散均能以前向次数∝dual total correlation完成采样,突破了此前仅masked扩散具备该性质的认识;2) 对某类随机经验测度,uniform/Gaussian扩散采样所需前向次数为Õ(√d)(充要),而存在近似score oracle使masked扩散需Õ(d)次前向;3) 解释了分离来源:masked扩散采样的critical windows渐近上比uniform与Gaussian扩散更窄。

Conclusion: 该工作首次在三类主流dLLM范式间建立了可证明的并行性分离,纠正了"masked扩散因需确定token值而更难并行"的直觉,指出真正的瓶颈在于其采样critical window更窄。

Abstract: A popular selling point of diffusion large language models (dLLMs) is their capacity for parallelism: the ability to generate sequences of text far more efficiently than autoregressive models, which require one forward pass per token. Yet among the many competing paradigms for dLLMs, from masked to uniform to Gaussian diffusion, principled understanding of how these different proposals compare in parallelism remains limited. In this work, we initiate a fine-grained comparison of the capacity for parallelism among these three leading approaches and prove the following:
  - Uniform and Gaussian diffusion can sample in a number of forward passes which scales with the dual total correlation of the underlying distribution, a measure of intrinsic complexity which can be much smaller than the context length. Previously, it was only known how to achieve this using masked diffusion.
  - For a certain family of random empirical measures, we show that $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{d})$ forward passes are necessary and sufficient to sample using uniform or Gaussian diffusion, yet there exist approximate score oracles for which $\widetildeΩ(d)$ forward passes are needed for masked diffusion. This establishes the first provable separation in parallelism between the three prevailing dLLM paradigms.
  Contrary to popular intuition that masked diffusions are harder to parallelize because they must commit to token values, the latter separation instead comes from the fact that the critical windows in masked diffusion sampling are asymptotically narrower than those in uniform and Gaussian diffusion sampling.

</details>


### [281] [Mitigating Retaliatory Algorithmic Collusion in Repeated Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20548)
*Karthik Sivachandran,Rohan Paleja*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将Q学习中观察到的“隐性合谋”现象与经典简单惩罚码（SPC）理论相联系，并提出CURB奖励塑形框架，通过惩罚策略的条件依赖信号来消除惩罚威胁维系的合谋均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习智能体在重复博弈中仅以自身收益最大化为目标，却能在无沟通、无共享设计下收敛到类似显性合谋的超竞争结果。现有缓解方法多绑定于特定经济场景（如双边平台、拍卖），缺乏适用于一般重复博弈的干预设计，因此需要建立经验现象与经典理论之间的联系并提供通用解决方案。

Method: 作者将Q学习合谋的经验观察与经典简单惩罚码（SPC）理论形式化关联：证明任何非平凡SPC都会在智能体策略中诱导可量化的条件依赖，可用智能体在合作历史与背叛历史下动作分布之间的总变差距离（TV distance）检测。基于此提出CURB（Collusion Unwinding via Reward shaping and Belief injection），在Q学习过程中惩罚该TV距离信号。

Result: 理论证明CURB可将动态系统中任何SPC不动点转化为平凡不动点，从而排除由惩罚威胁维持的合谋均衡。在Bertrand与Cournot重复博弈实验中，CURB显著降低了Q学习智能体的合谋程度；在Bertrand竞争的深度Q网络（DQN）智能体上同样有效，表明该机制可推广到表格型Q学习之外。

Conclusion: CURB为一般重复博弈中的合谋缓解提供了有理论保证的通用框架，既连接了RL合谋经验研究与经典惩罚码理论，又在表格型与深度Q学习中验证了有效性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning agents trained to maximize their own reward in repeated interactions can converge to supra-competitive outcomes resembling explicit collusion, without communication or shared design. Existing mitigation approaches are largely tied to specific economic settings, like two-sided platforms and auctions, leaving open how to design interventions for general repeated games. We address this gap by formalizing the connection between empirical observations from prior work on Q-learning collusion and classical theory of Simple Penal Codes (SPCs). We show any non-trivial SPC induces a quantifiable conditional dependence in agents' policies, detectable via the total variation distance between an agent's action distributions across cooperation and defection histories. Building on this connection, we propose CURB (Collusion Unwinding via Reward shaping and Belief injection), a reward-shaping framework that penalizes this Total Variation (TV) distance signal during Q-learning and is guaranteed to convert any SPC fixed point of the dynamics into a trivial one, thus precluding collusive equilibria sustained by punishment threats. Empirically, CURB substantially reduces collusion by Q-learning agents in both Bertrand and Cournot Competition Repeated Games. We further demonstrate that CURB extends to deep Q-network agents in Bertrand competition, suggesting the mechanism generalizes beyond tabular Q-learning.

</details>


### [282] [CrystalMO-TuRBO: Multi-Objective Trust-Region Bayesian Optimization for High-precision Joint Crystal Structure Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20592)
*Joseph Agada,Yishu Wang,Arpan Biswas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CrystalMO-TuRBO，一种多目标信赖域贝叶斯优化架构，用于X射线与中子衍射数据的联合晶体结构精修，通过两阶段策略提升收敛性、鲁棒性与参数精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统最小二乘与似然优化依赖局部搜索，难以应对非凸、含噪且参数高度相关的优化曲面；X射线与中子联合精修因两者灵敏度互补但相互竞争，通常通过标量目标结合，需人工设权重，易导致次优解。

Method: 将X射线与中子的偏差建模为两个独立目标，转化为归一化最大化问题；采用两阶段优化：第一阶段用并行信赖域贝叶斯优化在多个标量化下进行全局探索，定位有潜力的参数区域；第二阶段在收缩区域内进行局部精修，实现高精度求解，从而显式分离全局搜索与细粒度优化。

Result: 在单晶Ho2Ti2O7的实验X射线与中子衍射数据上评估，结果显示相比经典精修方法与贝叶斯优化基线，所提方法在收敛性、鲁棒性和参数精度上均有提升。

Conclusion: CrystalMO-TuRBO为联合晶体结构精修提供了有效的多目标贝叶斯优化框架，避免了人工权重设定，并在真实衍射数据上验证了其优越性能。

Abstract: Crystal structure refinement is a fundamental inverse problem in materials characterization, where structural parameters are optimized to reproduce experimental diffraction data. Conventional approaches, such as least-squares and likelihood-based optimization, rely on local search and often struggle with non-convex, noisy, and highly correlated parameter landscapes, particularly when integrating multiple diffraction modalities. Joint refinement of X-ray and neutron data is especially challenging due to their complementary but competing sensitivities, which are typically combined through scalarized objectives requiring manual weighting and leading to suboptimal solutions. We propose CrystalMO-TuRBO, a multi-objective trust region Bayesian optimization architecture for joint crystal structure refinement. The method models X-ray and neutron discrepancies as separate objectives and transforms the problem into a normalized maximization setting. A two-phase optimization strategy is introduced: Phase 1 performs global exploration using parallel trust-region Bayesian optimization across multiple scalarizations to identify promising regions of the parameter space, while Phase 2 conducts localized refinement within a shrinking region to achieve high-precision solutions. This design explicitly separates global search from fine-grained optimization, addressing the unique accuracy requirements of refinement tasks. We evaluate the proposed method on experimentally collected X-ray and neutron diffraction data from single-crystal Ho2Ti2O7. Results demonstrate improved convergence, robustness, and parameter precision compared to classical refinement methods and Bayesian optimization baselines on refinement of a single-crystal pyrochlore material system.

</details>


### [283] [Recursive Quantum Long Short-Term Memory for Stable Short-Horizon Temperature Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20594)
*Mu-En Lee,Yen-Ku Liu,Samuel Yen-Chi Chen,Yun-Cheng Tsai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文比较递归QLSTM与标准QLSTM在日最低/最高气温一步预测任务上的表现，发现递归结构收敛更快、精度更高、泛化更好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子长短期记忆（QLSTM）虽将变分量子电路引入循环序列学习，但其优化行为对随机初始化和时间上下文高度敏感，稳定性与泛化性存在不确定性，因此需要评估不同架构设计的实际效果。

Method: 基于多伦多每日气象观测数据，在相同训练设置下，将递归QLSTM架构与标准QLSTM进行对比，针对日最低与最高气温的一步预测任务，在8、16、32天输入窗口和20个随机种子下比较收敛性、预测精度与泛化能力。

Result: 递归模型始终更早达到接近最优的测试损失，并降低平均绝对误差（MAE）与均方根误差（RMSE），同时呈现更小的泛化差距。

Conclusion: 递归量子特征变换能够提升紧凑型混合量子—经典时序模型的稳定性与样本外性能。

Abstract: Quantum long short-term memory (QLSTM) models extend recurrent sequence learning with variational quantum circuits, but their optimization behavior can vary substantially across random initializations and temporal contexts. This paper evaluates a recursive QLSTM architecture against a standard QLSTM for one-step-ahead prediction of daily minimum and maximum temperature. Using daily weather observations from Toronto and identical training settings, we compare convergence, predictive accuracy, and generalization across input windows of 8, 16, and 32 days over 20 random seeds. The recursive model consistently reaches a near-optimal test loss earlier, reduces mean absolute error and root mean squared error, and exhibits a smaller generalization gap. These results indicate that recursive quantum feature transformations can improve stability and out-of-sample performance for compact hybrid quantum--classical temporal models.

</details>


### [284] [COIN-GP: Cooperative Online Learning in Networked Distributed Systems with Partial Measurements via Gaussian Process Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20598)
*Zewen Yang,Xiaobing Dai,Zhenxiao Yin,Hang Zhao,Zhijun Li,C. C. Chan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于观测器的动态协同学习框架，结合在线分布式高斯过程回归，在分布式传感网络中联合估计系统状态与部分未知动态，仅需部分状态观测，并给出数据采集可行性条件与误差上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分布式传感网络场景中，系统状态与部分未知动态的联合估计面临挑战，尤其当仅能获得部分状态观测、且测量不完整、GP模型本身存在缺陷时，现有分布式GP方法难以保证估计精度。

Method: 提出基于观测器的动态协同学习框架，嵌入在线分布式高斯过程（GP）回归；引入新型数据采集策略，并给出确保数据获取可行的理论条件；利用GP的确定性误差界推导涵盖状态估计与模型估计的误差上限。

Result: 理论分析给出了数据获取可行性的条件，并推导出同时包含状态估计与模型估计的误差上界；仿真实验表明所提方法优于现有基于分布式GP的方法。

Conclusion: 该框架能够在测量不完整和GP模型不完善的情况下实现准确的联合估计，为分布式传感网络中的状态与动态协同学习提供了有效方案。

Abstract: In this paper, we tackle the problem of jointly estimating the system states and partially unknown dynamics within distributed sensor-equipped networks, particularly in scenarios where only partial state observations are available. To address this issue, we propose an observer-based dynamic cooperative learning framework incorporating online distributed Gaussian Process (GP) regression, which enables accurate estimation despite incomplete in measurements and deficient GP models. In addition, a novel data collection strategy is introduced, with theoretical conditions ensuring feasible data acquisition. Moreover, we also derive an error upper bound encompassing state estimation and model estimation, leveraging the deterministic error bounds of GPs. Empirical simulations demonstrate the superiority of our approach compared to existing distributed GP-based methods.

</details>


### [285] [Epidemiological Causal Graph Identification: Challenges, Identifiability and Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20676)
*Sambit Mishra,Yingying Wang,Christine K. Johnson,Urbashi Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究混合数据类型（序数与指数族）下DAG的因果方向可识别性，证明序数节点与指数族节点间边方向在通用参数下分布可识别，并给出穷举搜索与基于DAGMA的掩码连续优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果可识别性研究主要针对连续变量与加性噪声模型，忽视了包含序数尺度、计数和连续测量的混合数据集，导致此类场景缺乏理论保障。

Method: 节点服从序数分布（有序logit模型）或单参数指数族分布；证明序数与指数族节点间边方向的分布可识别性；提出基于得分的穷举搜索，以及利用DAGMA的掩码连续优化框架以处理较大图。

Result: 理论证明将先前的序数-泊松结果推广至更广的指数族；数值实验验证理论，可在马尔可夫等价类内恢复经典结构方程模型下不可识别的边方向。

Conclusion: 混合序数-指数族数据的因果方向具有分布可识别性，所提方法在理论与实验上均有效，扩展了因果发现的适用范围。

Abstract: Causal discovery from observational data is fundamental to statistics and machine learning, yet determining causal direction without interventions necessitates structural assumptions. Existing identifiability research primarily focuses on continuous variables under additive noise models, often neglecting mixed datasets containing ordinal scales, counts, and continuous measurements. This paper investigates causal discovery in Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) where nodes follow either an ordinal distribution (via an ordered logit model) or a regular one-parameter exponential family distribution. We prove that the edge direction between an ordinal and an exponential family node is distributionally identifiable for generic parameter values. Our findings generalize previous Ordinal-Poisson results to the broader exponential family. Computationally, we introduce a score-based exhaustive search and a masked continuous optimization framework using DAGMA for larger graphs. Numerical results validate the theory, recovering edge orientations within a Markov equivalence class that are unidentifiable under classical structural equation models.

</details>


### [286] [Video DeltaNet: A Video-Native Hybrid Attention for Livestream Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20744)
*Haocheng Xi,Yiming Xie,Hexu Zhao,Yiwen Zhang,Michael Liu,Thomas Creavin,Kurt Keutzer,Xiuyu Li,Zhaoyang Lv,Chenfeng Xu,Haiwen Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Video DeltaNet (VDN)，将局部 Softmax 注意力与双向线性记忆结合以处理长程视频上下文，并实例化于 MiniMax H3，在保持生成质量的同时显著加速扩散去噪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散模型在去噪时需反复处理长时空 token 序列，注意力机制成为主要计算瓶颈。线性注意力虽在大型语言模型中被广泛采用，但直接迁移到视频模型常无法保留高质量生成所需的细粒度交互。

Method: VDN 结合局部 Softmax 注意力与双向线性记忆以建模长程视频上下文。其线性分支提出 Video Delta Attention (VDA)，通过联合纳入空间 token 实现每帧一次的记忆更新。两分支采用独立的输出投影与可学习门控进行校准，并使用分阶段教师对齐（teacher-alignment）配方逐步将新通路引入预训练模型。作者在 MiniMax H3 上实例化 VDN，将混合注意力用于视频到视频交互，而对涉及文本或音频的交互保留 Softmax。此外采用八步蒸馏与优化的 SGLang 服务栈。

Result: 在八块 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上，VDN-H3 完成 14.3 秒、768p 视频的 DiT 去噪仅需 6.70 秒，相比相同 GPU 数量下 50 步稠密 H3 基线实现 14.5 倍加速。

Conclusion: VDN 通过混合注意力设计在视频扩散模型中兼顾长程建模效率与细粒度交互质量，结合蒸馏与服务优化可获得数量级推理加速，为高效视频生成提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Video diffusion models repeatedly process long spatiotemporal token sequences during denoising, making attention a major computational bottleneck. Linear attention offers an appealing alternative and has been widely adopted in recent large language models, but directly applying it to video models often fails to preserve the fine-grained interactions required for high-quality generation. We present Video DeltaNet (VDN), which combines local Softmax attention with bidirectional linear memory for long-range video context. Its linear branch introduces Video Delta Attention (VDA), which updates memory once per frame by jointly incorporating its spatial tokens. Separate output projections and learnable gates calibrate the two branches, while a staged teacher-alignment recipe progressively introduces the new pathway into pretrained models. We instantiate VDN on MiniMax H3, applying the hybrid to video-to-video interactions while retaining Softmax for interactions involving text or audio. With eight-step distillation and an optimized SGLang serving stack, VDN-H3 completes DiT denoising for a 14.3-second, 768p video in 6.70 seconds on eight NVIDIA B200 GPUs, corresponding to a 14.5x speedup over the 50-step dense H3 baseline on the same GPU count.

</details>


### [287] [Calibrated RF-Fingerprinting Under Interference With Heterogeneous Transmission Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20765)
*Tariq Abdul-Quddoos,Xiangfang Li,Lijun Qian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究共信道干扰下多发射机场景的射频指纹识别，将其建模为多标签分类问题，采用一维CNN并引入校准机制，在POWDER 5G测试床真实数据上验证，精度达97%至73%，微召回率接近1减校准假阴性上限，且校准对分布外干扰具有鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有射频指纹研究几乎只考虑单发射机场景，限制了其在真实环境中的适用性。本文旨在解决多信号在时间和频率上重叠、相互干扰的共信道干扰场景。

Method: 将问题形式化为多标签分类问题，采用一维卷积神经网络（1D CNN）；对模型进行校准，推导标签概率的置信度阈值，并对平均假阴性数量的上界提供保证。使用POWDER 5G测试床真实数据，涵盖802.11a（Wi-Fi）、4G LTE和5G NR波形。

Result: 根据信道条件，校准后准确率最高达97%、最低为73%；针对不同平均假阴性上界进行校准可获得约等于（1−校准假阴性）的微召回分数，且校准对分布外干扰具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 所提方法在真实高竞争无线环境中具有应用潜力，能够在多发射机共信道干扰下实现可靠识别并控制漏检风险。

Abstract: Radio Frequency(RF)-Fingerprinting is a spectrum monitoring technique that identifies specific transmitters based on hardware impairments imprinted within the emitted signal. Although widely researched, studies almost exclusively consider scenarios where only one transmitter is emitting at a time, limiting real world applicability. In this work, we further the study of RF-Fingerprinting by considering co-channel interference, with multiple emitted signals interfering with each other, overlapping in time and frequency. Specifically, we formulate this problem as a multi-label classification problem and employ a 1D convolutional neural network (CNN). Furthermore, the models are calibrated such that the confidence thresholds for the label probabilities are derived, with guarantees on the upper bound on the average number of False Negatives, providing a degree of confidence in not missing a true spectrum policy violation. The proposed method is validated using real world data from the POWDER 5G testbed on devices transmitting 802.11a(Wi-Fi), 4G LTE, and 5G NR waveforms. The results show accuracy as high as 97% and as low as 73% after calibration depending on channel conditions. Also calibrating for various average false negatives upper bounds achieves micro recall scores of approximately (1 - calibrated false negatives) with the calibration robust to out-of-distribution interference, demonstrating the potential of the proposed method in a realistic high contention wireless environment

</details>


### [288] [PosteriorBench: From Point Estimates to Posterior Matching in Evaluating Generative Inverse Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20794)
*Jiachen Yao,Zi-Siang Hsu,Xi Deng,Aditi Gupta,Xin Ju,Sally M Benson,Gege Wen,Anima Anandkumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 PosteriorBench，一个用于评估生成式逆问题求解器分布精度（是否恢复完整后验）的基准，涵盖四个物理逆问题、基于 MCMC/拒绝采样构造的高保真参考后验及五项后验评估指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式逆问题评估主要关注能否产生单个合理重建，这对于稀疏或含噪观测下的病态问题不足：方法可能点精度高却因模态坍缩、过度自信或平均不相容解而无法捕获真实后验。

Method: 提出 PosteriorBench，针对 Darcy 流反演、Poisson 源恢复、碳捕集与封存、光传输材料推断四个物理逆问题；用拒绝采样和 MCMC 等计算昂贵但成熟的方法构造高保真参考后验；配套五项评估指标：后验均值误差、后验标准差误差、最大均值差异（MMD）、切片 Wasserstein 距离、径向平均功率谱误差；统一分布匹配与不确定性量化流程，覆盖稀疏感知、低分辨观测、非线性正演、不同噪声水平与多模态先验。

Result: 实验显示当前求解器存在显著的分布匹配差距；神经算子提升了分辨率鲁棒性；引导权重与生成噪声是后验方差校准的关键。

Conclusion: 需要从单点重建评估转向分布级评估，PosteriorBench 提供了可诊断后验恢复质量的统一基准与指标，并揭示了现有求解器在分布匹配和不确定性校准上的不足。

Abstract: Generative models are increasingly used to solve scientific inverse problems, but existing evaluations still focus primarily on whether a method can produce a single plausible reconstruction. This is insufficient for ill-posed problems, where multiple solutions may be consistent with the same sparse or noisy observations. In these settings, a method can achieve strong pointwise accuracy while still failing to capture the true posterior through mode collapse, overconfident uncertainty, or averaging incompatible solutions. We introduce PosteriorBench, a benchmark for evaluating the distributional accuracy of generative inverse solvers. PosteriorBench evaluates four physics-based inverse problems: Darcy flow inversion, Poisson source recovery, carbon capture and storage, and light transport material inference. For each task, we construct high-fidelity reference posteriors using computationally heavy but established procedures such as rejection sampling and Markov chain Monte Carlo, enabling direct assessment of whether solvers recover the full set of solutions rather than the single best sample. We pair these references with a five-metric posterior evaluation suite: posterior-mean error, posterior-standard-deviation error, maximum mean discrepancy, sliced Wasserstein distance, and radially averaged power-spectrum error. These metrics assess pointwise accuracy, marginal uncertainty, distributional alignment, and global frequency fidelity. The benchmark spans sparse sensing, low-resolution observations, nonlinear forward models, varying noise levels, and multimodal priors, with a unified pipeline for distribution matching and uncertainty quantification. Our experiments reveal substantial distribution-matching gaps across current solvers, while showing that neural operators improve resolution robustness, and guidance weights and generation noise are key to posterior-variance calibration.

</details>


### [289] [Score Centering Stabilizes Off-policy Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20807)
*Martin Marek,Max Ryabinin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"分数中心化"加性修正项,通过抵消训练-推理引擎间的漂移偏差,在不牺牲推理效率的前提下稳定大语言模型的强化学习训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型强化学习对训练与推理引擎间的微小差异(训练-推理不匹配,TIM)极为敏感,但完全消除TIM不切实际,会严重损害rollout效率,因此需要一种在容忍TIM存在的同时保持训练稳定的方法。

Method: 作者指出TIM下RL不稳定的主因是"漂移"——训练与推理引擎间随每步训练累积的持续性偏差。基于此推导出一个加性的"分数中心化"(score centering)修正项,用以抵消漂移。该修正为加性,故可与重要性采样(importance sampling)方法组合使用。

Result: 在0.6B至30B参数规模的模型训练中,分数中心化单独使用即可匹配或超越量化条件下基于重要性采样的方法,且不匹配越严重时优势越大;在离线(staleness)实验中,分数中心化与重要性采样的组合优于纯重要性采样基线。

Conclusion: TIM下的RL不稳定主要源于累积漂移,而非随机噪声,因此可用简单的加性修正加以抵消。分数中心化提供了一种低代价、可组合的稳定化方案,兼顾了rollout效率与训练稳定性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) of large language models is notoriously sensitive to small differences between training and inference engines, often referred to as the training-inference mismatch (TIM). However, completely eliminating TIM is impractical, as it would come at a major cost to rollout efficiency. In this paper, we show that the instability of RL under TIM is primarily caused by drift: a persistent bias between training and inference engines that accumulates with every training step. We derive an additive "score centering" correction term that stabilizes RL under TIM by canceling drift. When training models from 0.6B to 30B parameters, score centering alone matches or outperforms methods based on importance sampling under quantization, with the gap growing as the mismatch becomes more severe. Because the correction is additive, score centering also composes with importance sampling -- their composition outperforms pure importance-sampling baselines in our staleness experiments.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [290] [BioPhys-Bridge: A Benchmark for Interdisciplinary Scientific Reasoning in Physics-Grounded Biological Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19180)
*Qingyang Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出 BioPhys-Bridge，一个面向生物物理文献、强调证据溯源的科学推理基准，含 500 个案例与 1,517 项任务，并给出初步评测结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型在跨学科科研文献分析中面临独特挑战：生物物理研究中的可靠回答需将观测数据锚定到原始证据，并通过定量物理模型解释，进而关联生物学机制，现有基准难以覆盖这种多步、需溯源的科学推理。

Method: 构建 BioPhys-Bridge 基准数据集：每个案例包含证据块、稳定证据 ID、定量数值、单位、方程、假设、机制及后续决策，作为 QA 与 RAG 的锚定目标；设置模式、证据完整性、定量锚定、来源许可、重复性、单位归一化等严格质量门，并对 81 个案例进行领域专家审阅与标注。

Result: 初始版本含 500 个案例、1,517 项面向智能体的任务，覆盖 6 个生物学领域与 9 个物理模型族（含 3 个稀疏族留作扩展）。初步评测中，DeepSeek-V4-Flash 取得最高证据 ID F1（0.360），Qwen3.7-Max 为 0.316，GPT-4o-mini 为 0.294。

Conclusion: BioPhys-Bridge 是一个跨学科基准，用于评估归因、忠实性、幻觉抑制及生物实验设计中的复杂多步科学推理；后续将扩大数据集规模与复杂度并开展全面评测，代码与数据已在 GitHub 和 Hugging Face 发布。

Abstract: Language models face unique challenges in analyzing interdisciplinary scientific research literature. In biophysics research, faithful answers require grounding observed data in source evidence, interpreting it through a quantitative physics model, and linking it to a biological mechanism. To address this challenge, we introduce BioPhys-Bridge, a novel benchmark dataset for evidence-grounded scientific reasoning over biophysical literature. Each case contains evidence blocks, stable evidence IDs, quantitative values, units, equations, assumptions, mechanisms, and next decisions as grounding targets for question answering (QA) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The initial release contains 500 cases, 1,517 agent-facing tasks, and covers six biological domains and nine physical model families, including three sparse families reserved for future expansion. We enforce strict quality gates for all cases in schema, evidence-integrity, quantitative-grounding, source-license, duplicate, unit-normalization, with domain expert review and annotation for 81 cases. Preliminary evaluations show that DeepSeek-V4-Flash obtain the highest evidence-ID $F_1$ score (0.360), followed by Qwen3.7-Max (0.316) and GPT-4o-mini (0.294). BioPhys-Bridge is an interdisciplinary benchmark for evaluating attribution, faithfulness, hallucination reduction, and biological experiment design with complex, multi-step scientific reasoning. Future works will increase the size and complexity of the dataset and perform comprehensive evaluations. Code and data are available in the GitHub repository and on Hugging Face.

</details>


### [291] [Regularized Emphatic Temporal-Difference Learning: Stability under Constant Stepsizes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19170)
*Xingguo Chen,Zhaohui Wu,Jinguo Ye,Chao Li,Shangdong Yang,Guang Yang,Skylar Liang,Wenhao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文构造了一个两状态反例，证明ETD均值映射收缩但采样乘积具有正Lyapunov指数，并提出正则化emphatic TD（RETD）作为归一化一阶post-shock修复，在保持trace和重要性比率不变的前提下恢复ETD不动点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ETD能稳定期望off-policy TD更新并改变投影几何，但这两条性质都不足以决定常数步长下的采样动力学；作者需要厘清均值收缩与采样稳定性之间的分离，并寻找一种能修复采样动力学的方案。

Method: 构造遍历性两状态反例，其中ETD均值映射收缩而采样乘积顶Lyapunov指数为正；用regenerative-cycle分析将符号与follow-on trace的无限方差分离；提出RETD，通过泄漏标量状态存储emphatic TD信号并释放延迟校正，导出单/双正则化读出的不动点恢复；对调和递减步长证明几乎必然收敛，并基于Markovian random-product bound给出条件常数步长矩收缩结果。

Result: RETD在两状态构造和一个Baird点上获得认证的负指数，而Baird ETD正号仍仅为数值观察；成对10000次运行实验验证了分离现象、不动点恢复、非单调稳定区域和任务依赖性。

Conclusion: RETD改变post-shock动力学但不降低共享的follow-on-trace方差；其稳定性改善来自归一化一阶修复，而非消除方差来源。

Abstract: Emphatic temporal-difference learning (ETD) stabilizes the expected off-policy TD update and changes its projection geometry, but neither property determines constant-stepsize sampled dynamics. We construct an ergodic two-state counterexample in which the ETD mean map contracts while the sampled product has a positive top Lyapunov exponent. Regenerative-cycle analysis separates this sign from the infinite variance of the follow-on trace. We introduce regularized emphatic TD (RETD), a normalized first-order post-shock repair that leaves the trace and importance ratios unchanged, stores the emphatic TD signal in a leaky scalar state, and releases a delayed correction. RETD's raw equilibrium is an affine shift of the ETD equilibrium; single- and two-regularization readouts recover the ETD fixed point exactly. We prove almost-sure convergence for harmonic diminishing stepsizes and a conditional constant-stepsize moment-contraction result from a Markovian random-product bound. RETD has certified negative exponents on the two-state construction and one Baird point, whereas the positive Baird ETD sign remains numerical. Paired 10,000-run experiments validate both separations, fixed-point recovery, a nonmonotone stability region, and task dependence. RETD changes post-shock dynamics; it does not reduce the shared follow-on-trace variance.

</details>


### [292] [What Do We Expect from LLMs? Mapping the Design of LLM Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19182)
*Chao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究系统梳理了2022年1月至2026年8月arXiv上14,767篇引入或更新评测资源的论文，追踪LLM评测需求本身的变化，发现评测更强调行动、交互与专业应用，且LLM作为评分者持续增长、而作为材料生成者未持续增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型排行榜只能反映模型能力高低，无法揭示"研究者期望LLM做什么、以什么作为成功标准"这一评测需求本身的演变。评测资源的多样化提供了观察这类期望变化的另一视角。

Method: 对2022年1月至2026年8月的arXiv投稿进行大规模文献计量与内容分析，共纳入14,767篇引入或更新评测资源的论文；采用分阶段筛选加自动化全文编码，考查目标系统与领域、评测材料与条件、评分机制三个维度的变化。

Result: 评测重心向行动、交互和专业应用转移；既有与新兴设计元素经常并存。模型参与度发展不均衡：基于LLM的评分在agent与非agent两类论文中均增长，而模型生成材料在近期队列中无同等持续增长。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了公共研究如何将能力期望转化为具体测试与成功标准。当AI参与构建测试、执行任务与评判回答时，也引出疑问：评测扩张是提供了更多独立证据，还是可能复制参与模型自身的偏好与盲点。

Abstract: Benchmarks are central to how progress in large language models (LLMs) is assessed and communicated. Yet model rankings alone reveal little about how evaluation requirements themselves are changing. The expanding variety of benchmarks offers another perspective: what researchers expect LLMs to do, and what they count as successful performance. We systematically map 14,767 papers introducing or updating evaluation resources from arXiv submissions between January 2022 and August 2026. Using staged screening and automated full-text coding, we examine changes in target systems and domains, evaluation materials and conditions, and scoring mechanisms. The collection shows growing emphasis on action, interaction, and professional applications, while established and newer design elements frequently coexist. Model participation also develops unevenly: LLM-based scoring grows within both agent and non-agent groups, whereas model-generated materials show no comparable sustained increase in recent cohorts. These findings illuminate how public research translates capability expectations into concrete tests and criteria for success. As AI participates in constructing tests, performing tasks, and judging responses, they also raise a question: does expanding evaluation provide more independent evidence, or risk reproducing the preferences and blind spots of its participating models?

</details>


### [293] [Position: It is Time to Virtualize Foundation Models with a Self-evolving Operating System Layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19203)
*Suparna Bhattacharya,Tarun Kumar,Cong Xu,Satish Kumar Mopur,Jiahao Li,Ashish Mishra,Aalap Tripathy,Annmary Justine Koomthanam,Martin Foltin,Ian Foster*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，主张在协议层（MCP、A2A）之上构建"基础模型操作系统"（FMOS），作为虚拟化FM交互的系统层，为应用提供专属、可信、能力近乎无限的FM实例抽象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI应用已从单一单体基础模型转向复合智能体系统，但技术栈仍高度碎片化：各框架各自内嵌状态、记忆、预算与护栏的隐式运行时，导致行为不可移植、治理脆弱。这一现状类比于操作系统出现之前的计算时代——每个程序都要重复实现基础服务，因此亟需一个统一的系统层来抽象与复用这些共性能力。

Method: 论文以立场论述为主，提出FMOS概念设计：对外仿照虚拟机抽象物理硬件的方式，虚拟化FM交互；对内负责跨记忆层级的知识编排、模型选择与资源分配、验证与策略执行；并借鉴人脑"快直觉/慢审慎"的双过程机制，使FMOS学习何时介入、何时直接放行推理，并依据运行经验持续自适应调整策略。

Result: 作为立场论文，本文未报告实验或量化结果，主要产出是概念框架与论点的论证，即FMOS应作为连接协议层与应用层的关键中间系统层。

Conclusion: 作者结论是：该领域当前需要一个FMOS，以解决运行时可移植性与治理脆弱性问题，并通过记忆编排、资源调度、验证执行和自适应介入策略，为智能体应用提供可信且高效的统一系统底座。

Abstract: AI applications have shifted from single, monolithic foundation models (FM) to compound agentic systems. Yet today's stacks remain fragmented: even as protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A) ease tool/agent connectivity, each framework embeds an implicit runtime for state, memory, budgets, and guardrails, making behavior non-portable and governance brittle. It mirrors computing before operating systems, when every program re-implemented basic services. This position paper argues that the field now needs a Foundation Model Operating System (FMOS) -- a system layer that virtualizes FM interactions analogous to how virtual machines abstract physical hardware, giving applications the illusion of dedicated, trustworthy FM instances with effectively unbounded capabilities. Internally, the FMOS orchestrates knowledge across memory tiers, model selection and resource allocation, and verification and policy enforcement. Like the human brain switching between fast intuition and slow deliberation, the FMOS learns when to intervene and when to let inference proceed directly and continuously adapting its policies based on operational experience.

</details>


### [294] [What Do Current Systematic Generalization Tasks Miss? A Reasoning-Centered Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19212)
*Chengwen Qi,Deheng Ye,Yatao Bian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出TranSGrid测试平台，将演绎、归纳与溯因推理统一于单一任务，用以严格评估系统泛化。实验表明现有基准的简化（近似线性动作组合、目标动作显式化）会显著削弱归纳与溯因需求，从而高估模型的系统泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统泛化（通过重组已知原子元素解决新问题）是人类智能的核心，但在受控条件下难以严格研究。现有研究依赖近似线性动作组合、基于生产力的测试以及动作显式目标等简化，使研究更易进行，却遗漏了该能力的一些本质方面。为刻画这些简化所忽略的内容，作者采用以推理为中心的视角。

Method: 提出TranSGrid，一个在统一任务中同时引入演绎、归纳与溯因推理的测试平台。对7个Transformer模型在4,800个TranSGrid实例上进行实验，并引入两个变体分别恢复原有简化：一个使动作近乎线性组合（降低归纳需求），另一个使目标动作显式化（降低溯因需求）。

Result: 所有模型在TranSGrid上的表现远差于留出测试集：最大模型解决测试集79.6%，TranSGrid仅55.3%，最难子集仅15.8%。该差距在训练长度范围内依然存在，说明仅凭生产力不足以评估系统泛化。在两个恢复简化的变体中，解决率均回升至接近测试集水平。

Conclusion: 现有任务至少削减了归纳与溯因需求中的一项或两项，任一简化都足以将TranSGrid退化为普通留出测试集；全面衡量系统泛化需要涵盖演绎、归纳、溯因三种推理形式的任务。

Abstract: Systematic generalization, the ability to solve novel problems by recombining known atomic elements, is central to human intelligence but difficult to study rigorously under controlled settings. Existing studies therefore rely on simplifications such as approximately linear action composition, productivity-based tests, and action-explicit goals, which make systematic generalization easier to study but omit some essential aspects of this capability. To characterize what these simplifications miss, we adopt a reasoning-centered lens and introduce TranSGrid, a testbed that brings deductive, inductive, and abductive reasoning together within a unified task. Experiments with seven Transformers on 4,800 TranSGrid instances show that all models perform much worse on TranSGrid than on a held-out test set: the largest model solves 79.6% of the test set, but only 55.3% of TranSGrid and 15.8% of the hardest subset. The gap remains within the training length range, showing that productivity alone is not sufficient to evaluate systematic generalization. Additionally, we reintroduce the other two simplifications into TranSGrid: one variant makes actions compose almost linearly (reducing the inductive demand), the other makes goals action-explicit (reducing the abductive one). In both, solve rates return to roughly the test set level, showing that either simplification alone is enough to reduce TranSGrid to an ordinary held-out test set. Together, our results show that existing tasks reduce either or both of the inductive and abductive demands, and that comprehensively measuring systematic generalization requires a task that involves all three forms of reasoning.

</details>


### [295] [Characterizing Web Search by Conversational LLM Agents: From Search Decisions and Strategies to Results and Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19244)
*Mahsa Amani,Seungeon Lee,Abhisek Dash,Asmaa El Fraihi,Yunah Jang,Elisabeth Kirsten,Qinyuan Wu,Krishna P. Gummadi,Manish Gupta,Abhilasha Ravichander,Muhammad Bilal Zafar,Soumi Das*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究对话式LLM智能体Web搜索的端到端生命周期，结合真实用户交互（invivo）与受控API实验（invitro），对比ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、DeepSeek四大平台，揭示搜索触发决策、查询策略、结果领域偏好及结果转述中的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式LLM智能体日益依赖Web搜索，但其端到端生命周期（从是否搜索、如何构造查询、到检索结果偏好及最终回应生成）尚缺乏系统理解，这影响未来AI智能体与面向对话检索的Web搜索工具设计。

Method: 研究覆盖四大主流对话平台（ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、DeepSeek），采用双重研究设计：invivo收集真实用户交互数据，invitro通过各平台自有模型的API开展受控实验，从而分析：1) 触发Web搜索的智能体决策质量；2) 查询构造策略；3) 检索结果中的潜在领域偏好；4) 将搜索结果转化为有据回应的选择行为。

Result: 1) Web搜索决策在不同平台与模型间差异显著，更频繁调用Web搜索并不必然带来更优回应质量；2) 对话智能体采用不同的复杂查询策略；3) 平台特定搜索引擎返回结果倾向于其偏好领域；4) 回应虽大体基于搜索结果，但部分论断依赖未引用的搜索结果，引发归因与可靠性担忧。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了对话式智能体Web搜索生命周期中的决策差异、查询策略多样性、检索领域偏向及引用归因不足等问题，对面向对话检索优化的未来AI智能体与Web搜索工具设计具有重要启示。

Abstract: Conversational LLM agents increasingly rely on Web search, yet the end-to-end lifecycle of agentic search remains poorly understood. We present the first study of Web search across four major conversational platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and DeepSeek), combining real-world user interactions (invivo) with controlled experiments using the same platform's models by their APIs (invitro). We investigate the quality of agentic decisions to invoke Web search, their strategies to formulate queries, the potential domain preferences in the search results they receive, and the choices they make when transforming search results into grounded responses. We find that Web-search decisions vary substantially across platforms and models, while more frequent Web-search invocation does not necessarily yield better response quality. We further show that conversational agents employ different complex querying strategies and that platform specific search engines return search results from their preferred domains. Finally, although responses are largely grounded in search results, some claims rely on uncited search results, raising concerns about attribution and reliability. Our findings have important implications for the design of future AI agents and Web search tools optimized for conversational retrieval.

</details>


### [296] [Do AI Agents Understand Computer Architecture?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19387)
*Ambika Sharan,Grigory Chirkov,Soheil Abbasloo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoTuring将同一智能体、同一15维加速器设计空间以两种表述呈现——具名架构旋钮+仿真计数器 vs. [0,1]上的匿名变量，评测器、合法空间与可达最优完全一致，仅"是否有意义"这一变量不同；由此测量"语义理解"相对于"盲目搜索"的增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有报告只能证明智能体改进了设计，却无法说明改进的原因：它可能真的在推理机器结构，也可能只是在一组其含义从未被恢复的旋钮上高效搜索；只有前者能迁移到下一个架构。现有评测无法区分二者，因为它们固定问题框架、只改变智能体，本文反其道而行之。

Method: 工具名为AutoTuring。对同一智能体交付同一15维加速器空间两次：一次以具名架构旋钮并附带仿真计数器，一次以[0,1]上的匿名变量；保持评测器、合法空间和可达最优相同，使唯一变化的是问题是否具有语义。二者之间的差距即为所测量的量。另设一个critic循环（结构化批评）作为对照条件。在九个kernel的FP16 GEMM basket上评测，并相对一个建模的H200基线比较。

Result: 语义带来收益：具名架构智能体平均超越建模H200基线5.4%，超越其盲目对照12.3%，且仿真调用次数减少70.1%。但该收益并非独有：critic循环为盲目智能体挽回大部分差距，而对具名架构智能体毫无增益，说明架构知识与结构化批评互为替代品而非互补品。

Conclusion: 作者将结论定位为初步发现（每个条件5–6次运行、单一建模加速器），并明确主张贡献在于这一比较方法本身，而非所设计的加速器。

Abstract: Agents are increasingly asked to design hardware, and increasingly reported to succeed. Such reports establish that a design improved; they cannot establish why. An agent that improves an accelerator may be reasoning about the machine, or may be searching competently over knobs whose meaning it never recovers -- and only the first transfers to the next architecture. Existing evaluations cannot tell the two apart, because they vary the agent while holding the framing of the problem fixed. We do the opposite. AutoTuring hands the same agent the same 15-dimensional accelerator space twice: once as named architectural knobs with simulator counters, once as anonymous variables on [0,1], with the evaluator, the legal space and the reachable optima held identical, so that the only thing that varies is whether the problem means anything. The gap between the two is the measurement. On a nine-kernel FP16 GEMM basket, meaning pays: the architect beats a modeled H200 by 5.4% and its blind counterpart by 12.3% on average, with 70.1% fewer simulator calls. It does not pay uniquely: a critic loop recovers most of that gap for the blind agent and buys the architect nothing, so architectural knowledge and structured critique behave as substitutes rather than as complements. We report these as preliminary findings -- five to six runs per condition on a single modeled accelerator -- and take the comparison itself, not the accelerator, to be the contribution.

</details>


### [297] [MAGS: Multi-agent Auto-formalization Guarantees Safety for Agentic Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19391)
*Albert Wu,Nicholas Roberts,Tzu-Heng Huang,Haoran Lin,Gil Friedman,Sungjun Cho,Gabriel Orlanski,Frederic Sala*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出多智能体框架 MAGS，以 Dafny 为验证感知中间表示，将 LLM 生成的代码转化为带形式化安全保证的可执行程序，在 220 个任务上实现 100% 通过冻结规约的安全保证生成成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 编码智能体生成的复杂程序规模庞大，人工审查难以覆盖，模糊测试、静态分析、LLM-as-a-Verifier 等现有手段难以穷尽所有边界情况，存在安全与安保失效风险；而形式化验证虽能提供机器可检验的保证，却传统上依赖大量人工规约与证明工程，成本高昂。

Method: MAGS 是一个统一的多智能体框架：将经人工审计的 API 与安全需求形式化并冻结；把生成的代码翻译为验证感知中间表示 Dafny；利用验证器反馈对违规进行修复；再将验证通过的程序编译回可执行代码，从而在冻结规约下产出带形式化安全保证的可执行程序。

Result: 在 100 个 CUDA 内核、100 个终端脚本和 20 个机械臂任务共 220 个样例上，MAGS 在针对冻结规约产生具有非平凡安全保证的程序方面达到 100% 成功率；独立的安全性与功能性评估显示三个领域均表现良好，同时暴露出当自动形式化语义未能完全刻画目标行为时会出现失败。

Conclusion: 以 Dafny 为中间表示的冻结规约 + 多智能体验证修复流水线，可有效将形式化保证引入 LLM 代码生成流程；但其可靠性仍受限于自动形式化语义与目标行为之间的偏差，规约本身的忠实性是关键瓶颈。

Abstract: LLM coding agents now generate complex programs at a scale that makes thorough human review increasingly difficult, raising the risk of safety and security failures. Common approaches, including fuzz testing, static analysis, and LLM-as-a-Verifier, can detect many failures but struggle to cover all possible edge cases. Formal verification addresses this by providing machine-checkable guarantees over specified properties, but traditionally demands substantial manual specification and proof engineering. We introduce a unified multi-agent framework, MAGS, that generates executable programs with formal safety guarantees, using Dafny as a verification-aware intermediate representation where safety properties can be mechanically checked. MAGS formalizes and freezes human-audited APIs and safety requirements, translates generated code into Dafny, repairs violations using verifier feedback, and compiles verified programs back into executable code. We evaluate MAGS on 100 CUDA kernels, 100 terminal scripts, and 20 robotic-arm tasks. Across all 220 examples, it achieves a 100% success rate in producing programs with non-trivial safety guarantees against frozen specifications. Independent safety and functional evaluations further show strong performance across all three domains, while revealing failures when the auto-formalized semantics do not fully capture the target behavior.

</details>


### [298] [Closed-World Resolution Against Tool Hallucination in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19425)
*Laxmipriya Ganesh Iyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文是一篇测量与基准研究，揭示工具增强LLM智能体的"工具幻觉"结构性盲区：即智能体调用不存在的工具或传入任何schema都未声明的参数，而现有的工具选择与安全门控方法都默认调用指向真实工具，因而无法拦截此类调用。作者提出五类工具幻觉分类法（H1–H5）、无训练的封闭世界解析器"Resolution Rung"，并证明幻觉防御必须前置于任何因果门控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有防御分为两类：工具选择（选对工具）与门控/权限限制（约束真实工具的使用方式）。二者都预设发出的调用指向真实工具，因此对"调用根本不存在的工具"这一情形存在结构性盲区——幻觉调用在构造上并非任何门控做出的决策，故任何门控都无法拒绝它。论文旨在系统测量并基准化这一被忽视的失效模式。

Method: 主要为测量与基准研究：（1）提出工具幻觉的五类分类法H1–H5；（2）作为参照点给出"Resolution Rung"——无训练、封闭世界的解析器（注册表成员检查加签名校验），其价值在于其必须所处的位置而非其计算内容；（3）证明幻觉防御必须先于任何因果门控，并刻画唯一的不可约残余（借用的参数在schema上与合法调用无法区分）；（4）在两种调用面上测试十个托管模型，测量真实幻觉；（5）扩展到Model Context Protocol，将多服务器合并进单一命名空间后产生单一注册表无法表达的新幻觉面，给出第二套分类法M1–M5。
