To address this, this paper proposes a scalable trust discovery architecture for the Internet of Agents. The proposed architecture adopts a hierarchical and distributed design consisting of three layers: Agent Root for trusted registry governance, Agent Registry for agent registration and metadata publication, and Agent Resolver for distributed capability discovery and trust-aware resolution. The architecture further introduces a registry-suffix-anchored composite identity scheme, which binds an agent native identifier to a trusted registry suffix to generate a globally discoverable identity. It also incorporates a dual-certificate and multi-level authentication mechanism to strengthen identity trust among agents. We implement a prototype and evaluate it through large-scale agent registration and resolution experiments. The prototype achieves an average registration latency of 58ms and an average discovery latency of 25ms, and it supports more than 19,000 registration requests per second and more than 29,000 agent discovery requests per second. These results demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed architecture, providing a practical approach toward scalable and identity-trusted agent ecosystems in the Internet of Agents.

</details>


### [401] [ResumeShield: Channel Separation and an Open Benchmark for Indirect Prompt Injection in AI Resume Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20188)
*Jay Barach*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出ResumeShield，一个面向AI简历筛选中间接提示注入攻击的开源防御与基准，通过三级过滤加第四级通道隔离，在104份文档语料上实现注入攻击零成功、检测精确率1.000、召回率0.944。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI简历筛选器会读取被评估者提供的文档，颠倒了评估者与被评估材料间的信任关系。候选人可利用白色文字、零字号、隐藏元素、标记注释、文档元数据或零宽字符在简历中隐藏指令，人类审阅者不可见，而朴素提取流水线会将其送入模型提示并被当作指令执行。这属于OWASP LLM01:2025所列的间接提示注入，生产筛选语料中约1%简历存在此类攻击，亟需防御与评测基准。

Method: ResumeShield防御由三级过滤加上第四级架构级阶段组成：将候选人内容置于显式围栏的数据通道中，由运营方可信指令声明其惰性。基准构建带种子的合成语料，覆盖九种隐藏技术与两类载荷家族——一类使用已有文献记载的表述，一类模拟绕过过滤器的自适应攻击者改写；仅当筛选结果发生改变时才判定攻击成功。

Result: 在104份文档语料上，朴素流水线在所有注入案例中均被操纵，而防御流水线从未被操纵。检测精确率1.000、召回率0.944，且在干净简历上无假阳性。消融实验显示，仅靠通道隔离即可消除全部已测攻击成功，而缺少隔离的完整过滤栈仍有16.7%攻击有效。研究还发现"隐藏困境"：所有逃过检测的载荷都是攻击者选择可见的载荷，从而放弃了攻击动机所依赖的不可见性。

Conclusion: 通道隔离是防御间接提示注入的关键架构手段，优于单纯的内容过滤；ResumeShield以Apache 2.0许可发布，仅含合成数据，为AI简历筛选安全提供了可复现的防御与基准。

Abstract: An AI resume screener reads a document supplied by the person it is evaluating, inverting the usual trust relationship between an assessor and the material it assesses. Candidates exploit this by concealing instructions inside a resume using white text, zero font size, hidden elements, markup comments, document metadata, or zero width characters. A human reviewer sees nothing, while a naive extraction pipeline places the concealed text into the model prompt, where it is read as an instruction and obeyed. This is indirect prompt injection, listed as LLM01:2025 by OWASP, and recent measurement work reports it in roughly one percent of resumes in a production screening corpus. We present ResumeShield, an open-source defense and benchmark. The defense combines three filtering stages with a fourth architectural stage that places candidate content in an explicitly fenced data channel that the operator's trusted instructions declare inert. The benchmark builds a seeded synthetic corpus spanning nine concealment techniques and two payload families, one using documented phrasings and one modeling an adaptive attacker who paraphrases around the filter, and it scores an attack as successful only when the screening outcome changes. On a corpus of 104 documents, the naive pipeline is manipulated in every injected case while the defended pipeline is never manipulated. Detection reaches a precision of 1.000 and a recall of 0.944 with no false positives on clean resumes. An ablation shows that channel separation alone removes all measured attack success, whereas the complete filtering stack without separation still leaves 16.7 percent of attacks effective. We also identify a concealment dilemma: every payload that evaded detection was one the attacker left visible, surrendering the invisibility that motivates the attack. ResumeShield is released under the Apache 2.0 license with synthetic data only.

</details>


### [402] [Silence Is Endorsement: Verification-Status Laundering in LLM Agent Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20211)
*Yibo Hu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文揭示LLM智能体安全监控器的一种失效模式"验证状态洗白"：交接摘要保留了"行为已授权"的主张却丢失了"该主张未经核实"的事实，导致风险行为批准率大幅上升，并提出应将授权来源作为结构化状态全程携带。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体系统的安全监控器通常基于摘要或存储的交接信息判断行为，而非原始证据。这种设计存在一个简单却危险的失效模式：交接过程保留了"行为已被授权"的主张，却丢失了"该主张从未被核实"的事实，从而系统性地误导监控器批准本应被拦截的风险行为。

Method: 作者定义并验证"验证状态洗白"现象：在保持行为与授权命题不变的前提下，移除围绕该主张的"未核实来源"表述。实验覆盖九种开源权重监控器和两种托管模型，并构建完整的提议者—摘要者—记忆—监控器流水线；此外在WildGuard和ATBench数据集上验证独立编写的有害与不安全请求，并测试显式指令（要求监控器拒绝未经核实的授权）作为修复手段的效果。

Result: 移除未核实来源表述后，风险行为批准率从5%升至60%（Llama-3.1-8B）、从9%升至98%（Qwen2.5-14B），两种托管模型也出现类似大幅偏移。该失效在常规智能体流水线中同样出现：摘要者频繁弱化状态，记忆压缩器常删除状态，完整流水线在三类下游监控器上使风险批准率升至57%–81%。WildGuard和ATBench上的实验显示相同模式：缺乏支撑的授权主张显著提高批准概率。显式指令并非可靠的跨模型修复方案，部分模型仍易受攻击，另一些模型则误拒合法请求。

Conclusion: LLM智能体系统应将授权来源（authorization provenance）作为结构化状态附加于授权主张，并在整个流水线中全程携带，而非依赖摘要或自然语言交接传递。仅靠显式指令无法跨模型可靠修复该漏洞，需从系统架构层面保障验证状态的保真传递。

Abstract: Safety monitors in LLM agent systems often judge actions from summaries or stored handoffs, not from the original evidence. This creates a simple but dangerous failure mode: the handoff preserves the claim that an action is authorized while losing the fact that the claim was never verified. We call this verification-status laundering. Across nine open-weight monitors and two hosted models, the action and authorization proposition remain fixed while we remove the unverified provenance framing around the claim. This change raises approval for risky actions from $5\%$ to $60\%$ on Llama-3.1-8B and from $9\%$ to $98\%$ on Qwen2.5-14B, with similarly large shifts on both hosted models. The failure also emerges in ordinary agent pipelines. Summarizers frequently weaken the status, memory compressors often remove it, and a full proposer--summarizer--memory--monitor pipeline raises risky approval to $57$--$81\%$ across three downstream monitors. Experiments on WildGuard and ATBench show the same pattern on independently authored harmful and unsafe requests: unsupported authorization claims make approval substantially more likely. Explicitly instructing monitors to reject unverified authorization is not a reliable cross-model fix: some models remain vulnerable, while others reject legitimate requests. Agent systems should therefore carry authorization provenance as structured state attached to the claim throughout the pipeline.

</details>


### [403] [DDQN-MLP: An Explainable and Adversarially Robust DRL-Guided Adaptive Learning Framework for Ransomware Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20314)
*Jannatul Ferdous,Rafiqul Islam,Arash Mahboubi,Md Zahidul Islam*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出DDQN-MLP训练时强化学习框架，用DDQN自适应赋样本权重指导轻量MLP检测勒索软件，测试中达99.30%准确率且可解释、鲁棒、高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代勒索软件变种行为多样、具规避性且部分类似良性软件，破坏固定监督学习目标，导致行为检测困难。

Method: 基于Windows 11沙箱遥测数据，DDQN作为离散自适应样本加权控制器，观测批次级损失与预测置信度动态，为轻量MLP分配样本重要性权重；训练后丢弃DDQN仅部署MLP。采用5折分层交叉验证，在2000个可执行文件画像（1000勒索软件/30家族、1000良性）上评估，并与静态加权、focal loss及其他DRL变体对比；用SHAP、LIME及SHAP-梯度对齐诊断评估可解释性，并进行多扰动级白盒对抗测试。

Result: DDQN-MLP取得99.30%准确率、F1=0.9930、ROC-AUC=0.9991，优于静态加权、focal-loss及替代DRL变体；对抗训练提升特征空间鲁棒性且未降低干净数据准确率。

Conclusion: DDQN-MLP为高吞吐勒索软件检测提供了准确、可解释、鲁棒且计算高效的框架。

Abstract: Ransomware detection remains challenging because modern variants exhibit diverse, evasive, and partly benign-like behaviors that undermine fixed supervised learning objectives. This study proposes DDQN-MLP, a training-time deep reinforcement learning framework for behavioral ransomware detection using Windows 11 sandbox telemetry. A Double Deep Q-Network (DDQN) acts as a discrete adaptive sample-weighting controller by observing batch-level loss and prediction-confidence dynamics and assigning sample-importance weights to guide a lightweight Multilayer Perceptron (MLP). After training, the DDQN is discarded, leaving only the efficient MLP for deployment. The framework was evaluated using 5-fold stratified cross-validation on a balanced dataset of 2,000 executable profiles comprising 1,000 ransomware samples from 30 families and 1,000 benign samples. DDQN-MLP achieved 99.30% accuracy, an F1-score of 0.9930, and an ROC-AUC of 0.9991, outperforming conventional static weighting, focal-loss, and alternative DRL variants. Explainability was assessed using SHAP and LIME, together with a SHAP-gradient alignment diagnostic for evaluating consistency between feature attribution and model sensitivity. White-box adversarial testing across multiple perturbation levels further showed that adversarial training improved feature-space robustness without reducing clean-data accuracy. The results demonstrate that DDQN-MLP provides an accurate, explainable, robust, and computationally efficient framework for high-throughput ransomware detection.

</details>


### [404] [The More It Says, the More You Pay: A Black-Box Audit of Provider-Side Token Inflation in LLM Services](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20370)
*Leilei Chen,Lan Zhang,Chen Tang,Pengcheng Sun,Jiewei Lai,Yixiao Huang,Zhaopeng Zhang,Xinpeng Shen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 论文提出"供应商侧Token膨胀攻击(PTIA)"概念，即按量计费的LLM服务商暗中拉长输出以增加收入，并设计了基于"攻击饱和度"的轻量级单探针审计方法进行检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在按token计费的LLM服务中，模型输出越长用户付费越多，这为不诚实的服务商提供了隐蔽操纵生成、膨胀输出token数量以牟利的经济动机，而用户从黑盒响应中难以审计此类操纵。

Method: 定义PTIA，并在供应商可控管线的查询、提示、表示、模型四个层面实例化五种代表性攻击；核心观察是PTIA饱和现象（初次攻击显著拉长输出，进一步增强或组合效果甚微），并将其归因于停止行为（初次PTIA大幅降低EOS token概率，后续干预仅边际下降）。据此设计轻量级单探针审计，施加受控的加长干预：若处于PTIA，探针带来的额外token远少于正常服务；该方法无需可信本地参照模型或历史干净响应，原始与探针请求分别发出、形似普通流量，难以规避。

Result: 每种攻击使平均输出长度增至干净基线的10.2倍以上，显示PTIA的经济吸引力与多阶段可行性；审计在四个开源权重模型上平均检测率达85.1%，假阳性率低于2%；在15个真实LLM API服务中标记出7个存在与PTIA一致行为的服务。

Conclusion: PTIA在计费服务中确实可行且具有经济诱惑，而基于攻击饱和与停止行为的单探针审计无需参照模型或历史数据、隐蔽性强，能有效检测PTIA并在真实API服务中发现疑似实例，为用户提供实用审计手段。

Abstract: In pay-per-token LLM services, the more a model says, the more users pay. Dishonest providers can covertly manipulate generation to inflate output tokens while largely preserving task utility. We define such manipulation as a Provider-Side Token Inflation Attack (PTIA) and instantiate five representative attacks at the query, prompt, representation, and model levels of the provider-controlled pipeline. Our experiments show that each attack increases mean output length to more than 10.2x the clean baseline, demonstrating PTIA's financial appeal and feasibility at multiple stages of generation. Yet auditing PTIA from black-box responses is difficult for users. Our key observation is PTIA saturation: an initial attack sharply lengthens output, but further strengthening or composition has much less effect. We trace this saturation to stopping behavior: an initial PTIA sharply lowers the end-of-sequence token probability, whereas further intervention lowers it only marginally. Building on this insight, we design a lightweight single-probe audit that applies a controlled lengthening intervention. Under PTIA, the probe induces far fewer additional tokens than under normal service. The audit requires neither a trusted local reference model nor historical clean responses, and its separately issued original and probed requests resemble ordinary traffic, making evasion difficult. Across four open-weight models, it achieves an average detection rate of 85.1% with false-positive rates below 2%. Across 15 real LLM API services, the audit flags 7 for PTIA-consistent behavior.

</details>


### [405] [Fingerprinting Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20457)
*Chao Huang,Meng Tong,Kejiang Chen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次研究多模态大模型指纹，提出白盒溯源方法AttnPrint与黑盒审计方法DistillTrace。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM易被非法部署与未授权蒸馏，而现有模型溯源方法受共享语言骨干混淆，且难以检测蒸馏违规。

Method: 受自注意力低通滤波特性启发，AttnPrint提取跨模态注意力分布并分离其低频分量作为指纹；DistillTrace通过假设检验MLLM输出识别侵权。

Result: 在19种多模态架构、154个模型实例上实验，AttnPrint对衍生模型检测性能强，且对五种下游修改技术保持鲁棒；DistillTrace在三种参数无关技术下提供蒸馏关系证据。

Conclusion: 该工作为多模态模型所有权保护提供了白盒指纹与黑盒审计互补的溯源方案。

Abstract: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) enable a wide range of image-text reasoning tasks, recent incidents indicate that they are vulnerable to illicit deployment and unauthorized distillation. Existing solutions for model provenance are typically confounded by shared language backbones in MLLMs and struggle to detect violations of distillation. To bridge this gap and safeguard model ownership, we present the first study on multimodal model fingerprinting. Inspired by recent findings that self-attention acts as a low-pass filter and that its low-frequency components are informative, we develop AttnPrint for white-box provenance. Specifically, we extract cross-modal attention distributions and isolate their low-frequency components to serve as model fingerprints. To facilitate black-box auditing, we further introduce DistillTrace, which employs hypothesis testing of MLLM outputs to identify potential model infringement. We conduct extensive experiments on 154 model instances across 19 multimodal architectures. Notably, AttnPrint achieves strong derivative-model detection performance while remaining robust to five downstream modification techniques. DistillTrace also provides evidence of distillation relationships under three parameter-independent techniques.

</details>


### [406] [Towards TEE-Certified DP: Verifiable Differentially Private Training on Legacy GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20532)
*Li Ge,Wenjie Qu,Weitao Feng,Yi Zeng,Jiaheng Zhang,Xiaofeng Wang,Wei Dong*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出一种结合CPU侧TEE与不受信GPU的可验证差分隐私训练框架，通过概率性检查高效验证GPU上梯度计算的DP正确执行，几乎以"免费午餐"式的低开销约束恶意偏离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习广泛应用带来保护敏感训练数据的政策与监管需求，差分隐私（DP）成为关键机制。然而如何认证训练过程中DP被忠实执行的研究较少：外部验证者需在不访问私有训练数据的前提下，确认发布模型确实经过了正确的DP保护训练。现有密码学方法（如零知识证明）保证强但开销过大（有时高数个数量级）；TEE虽更高效，但支撑大模型训练/微调所需的多GPU TEE支持仅限较新平台，在旧GPU上缺失或低效。

Method: 框架使用CPU侧TEE配合不受信GPU。针对"效率-安全"张力——完全在CPU TEE内训练太慢，而无限制卸载到GPU又允许恶意偏离DP——将昂贵的梯度计算卸载到GPU，同时用CPU TEE通过概率性检查高效验证梯度上DP的正确执行。

Result: 该框架以高概率检测频繁的完全偏离DP行为；在本工作评估的面向效用的伪造梯度攻击中，稀疏偏离提供的效用收益有限，且未显示出可测量的额外成员泄漏。实验表明，相比标准基于GPU的DP训练，仅带来适度开销，近乎实现"免费午餐"。

Conclusion: 该框架在保证可验证DP执行的同时保持实用效率，有效约束恶意偏离所声称的DP执行，为可信DP训练提供了一条兼顾安全与效率的可行路径。

Abstract: Wide adoption of machine learning has created growing policy and regulatory demand for protecting sensitive training data, with differential privacy (DP) emerging as a key mechanism. Yet a less-studied problem is how to certify the faithful execution of DP during training: an external verifier should be able to check that a released model was trained with proper DP protection, without accessing the private training data. Existing cryptographic approaches, such as zero-knowledge proofs, provide strong guarantees but often incur prohibitive overhead, in some cases by orders of magnitude. Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) offer a more efficient alternative, but the multi-GPU TEE support needed for training and fine-tuning large language models remains limited to recent platforms and is absent or inefficient on legacy GPUs.
  To address this, we propose a practical framework for verifiable DP training using CPU-side TEEs together with untrusted GPUs. Our design addresses a fundamental efficiency-security tension: training entirely inside a CPU TEE is too slow, while unrestricted GPU offloading can allow malicious deviations from DP. We therefore offload expensive gradient computation to GPUs, while using the CPU TEE to efficiently verify the correct enforcement of DP on gradients through probabilistic checking. Our framework detects frequent full deviations from DP with high probability; for the utility-oriented forged-gradient attacks evaluated in this work, sparse deviations provide limited utility benefit and show no measurable additional membership leakage. Experiments further show that our approach nearly achieves a ``free lunch'': it incurs only modest overhead compared with standard GPU-based DP training, while effectively constraining malicious deviations from the claimed DP execution.

</details>


### [407] [Empirical Analysis of Randomness Quality in Differential Privacy Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20561)
*Cesare Gerolimetto Fabrello,Valeria Rossi,Alberto Trombetta,Massimo Caccia*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对差分隐私(Differential Privacy, DP)机制中随机数质量的影响进行了系统性实证研究，发现当每8到16比特中约1比特被操纵时，DP机制可可靠检测出异常，且分布异常检测并不必然等价于隐私保证失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DP依赖精心校准的随机噪声来保护统计中的个体隐私。尽管理论工作已在弱化随机性假设下分析DP，但熵退化(entropy degradation)的实际后果仍缺乏理解，因此需要实证研究随机性质量对DP机制的实际影响。

Method: 基于IBM的DiffPrivLib，引入渐进式退化熵源：从高质量量子真随机数发生器(TRNG)和密码学安全伪随机数发生器(PRNG)，到受控熵退化的系统性操纵源。在参考数据库上进行超一百万次查询的重复实验，并结合补充统计检验，直接分析经验隐私损失随机变量(Privacy Loss Random Variable)分布。

Result: 实验表明，当每8至16比特中约1比特被操纵时，DP机制可可靠检测出偏差；检测灵敏度在比特级偏差与时间相关性之间存在显著差异。此外，分布异常的统计检测并不必然对应实际的隐私保证违反。

Conclusion: 随机性质量退化可被DP机制以统计学方式检测，但统计层面检测到的分布异常不等价于真实隐私保证被破坏，说明DP的鲁棒性与隐私保证的实际失效之间存在重要区别。

Abstract: Differential Privacy (DP) relies on carefully calibrated random noise to protect individual privacy in statistical analyses. While theoretical work has analyzed DP under weakened randomness assumptions, the practical consequences of entropy degradation remain poorly understood. We present a systematic empirical investigation of how randomness quality affects differential privacy mechanisms using IBM's DiffPrivLib. We introduce progressively degraded entropy sources characterized by established test suites, starting from high-quality quantum True Random Number Generators (TRNGs) and cryptographically secure Pseudo-Random Number Generators (PRNGs) down to systematically manipulated sources with controlled entropy degradation. Through repeated experiments over one million queries on a reference database and complementary statistical tests, we directly analyze empirical Privacy Loss Random Variable distributions. Our results demonstrate that DP mechanisms reliably detect deviations when approximately 1 bit in every 8 to 16 is manipulated, with detection sensitivity varying significantly between bit-level biases and temporal correlations. We demonstrate that statistical detection of distributional anomalies does not necessarily correspond to actual privacy guarantee violations.

</details>


### [408] [Weather Data Spoofing Attacks on Rain-Adaptive Millimeter-Wave Frequency Selection in V2X Communication Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20601)
*Rasheed Bello,Idreez Yusuf,Justice Adjei Owusu,Oluwatobiloba Aiyewunmi,Gurcan Comert,Judith Mwakalonge,Esmail Abuhdima,Abdulmajid Mrebit,Rajab Ataai,Vaidyan Varghese*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 天气感知的毫米波车联网频段选择存在攻击面：攻击者伪造降雨输入即可在不占用信道的情况下操纵受害者的载波频率与通信范围；基于SINR与预测衰减的物理交叉校验可检测"强制升频"半类威胁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联网车辆使用毫米波侧链路满足协同驾驶的数据速率需求，新兴设计从感知到的降雨中选取载波频段。作者指出这种天气感知本身构成攻击面——攻击者仅通过伪造降雨输入即可决定受害者的载波频率，进而决定其通信范围，而无需在信道上发送信号。

Method: 在 MilliCar（ns-3 模块）中评估攻击，将选定频段作为真实 3GPP NR V2X 载波运行，包含逐频段传播、波束成形与阻塞建模。基于防御机制的反向实现：由于雨衰随距离线性增长而路损随距离对数增长，接收端将实测 SINR 与其上报天气所预测的衰减进行比对来标记"强制升频"。

Result: 强制升至 73 GHz 使八车队列可靠通信范围维持在 38 m，而诚实基线可翻倍至 82 m；强制降至 5 GHz 保持 97% 远程接收，但传输块塌缩至三分之一，远程时延翻两番达 12.5 ms。防御在 1% 虚警率下以 98% 概率在 1.5 s 内标记强制升频，重选后将远程接收从 60% 恢复至 75%；但对强制降频结构性失效，因 5 GHz 回退近乎免疫降雨。对流雨胞使本地速率从 15 摆动至 81 mm/h 时所有结果不变。

Conclusion: 天气感知的频段选择需要经过认证的气象输入；物理交叉校验只能覆盖威胁的一半（强制升频），而强制降频因回退频段近乎免疫降雨而无法被该测试察觉。

Abstract: Connected vehicles use millimeter-wave (mmWave) sidelinks for the data rates cooperative driving demands, and emerging designs select the carrier band from sensed rainfall. We show that this weather awareness is an attack surface: an adversary who spoofs only the rainfall input dictates the victim's carrier frequency, and through it its communication range, without transmitting on the channel. We evaluate the attack in MilliCar, an ns-3 module that runs the selected band as the real 3GPP NR V2X carrier with per-band propagation, beamforming, and blockage. Forcing the band up to 73 GHz holds an eight-vehicle platoon's reliable range at 38 m while the honest baseline doubles it to 82 m; forcing it down to 5 GHz sustains 97% long-range reception but collapses the transport block to a third and quadruples long-range latency to 12.5 ms. We then implement the defense the mechanism implies. Rain loss grows linearly with distance while path loss grows logarithmically, so a receiver that tests measured SINR against the attenuation its reported weather predicts flags force-up with 98% probability within 1.5 s at a 1% false-alarm rate, and re-selection then restores long-range reception from 60% to 75%. The same test is structurally blind to force-down, because the 5 GHz fallback is nearly rain-immune. An advecting rain cell that swings the local rate from 15 to 81 mm/h leaves every result unchanged. Weather-aware band selection therefore requires an authenticated meteorological input; physical cross-checking covers one half of the threat.

</details>


### [409] [Inference-Engine Fingerprinting Attacks are Practical: Exploring Model-Driven Environmental Discovery, Exploitation, and Escape](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20614)
*Sarah Radway,Andrew Cheng,Vijay Janapa Reddi,James Mickens*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文揭示了对齐不良的模型可通过精心构造的输出 token 对推理引擎进行指纹识别，并利用引擎特定漏洞实现从引擎到裸机的完整利用链；作者在五种主流引擎中给出指纹实例，验证了真实 agentic harness 下可定位本地引擎，并提出缓解思路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿模型已展现利用软件漏洞的能力（如近期沙箱逃逸事件），且风险并非理论假设。现有沙箱讨论多聚焦于网络代理、代码执行环境等推理栈其他组件，却忽视了推理引擎本身。推理引擎是失准模型的理想攻击目标：若模型仅通过生成特制输出 token 即可触发引擎漏洞，则无需依赖推理栈其他组件漏洞，也无需外部恶意输入 token，便可发起多步、直达裸机的利用链。

Method: 作者提出并验证"推理引擎指纹识别"攻击路径：先让模型通过输出 token 的特征识别执行自身的具体引擎（如 vLLM、SGLang 等），再针对指纹结果使用引擎特定漏洞，仅凭精心选择的输出 token 取得引擎控制权。具体包括：在五种主流推理引擎中给出模型指纹实例；在真实 agentic harness 环境中演示模型利用指纹定位本地引擎；并构建一个概念验证性的、由被指纹识别并随后被攻陷的推理引擎出发、直达裸机的利用链。

Result: 在五种流行推理引擎中成功给出一系列模型指纹；证明现实 agentic harness 可使模型借助这些指纹识别本地引擎；并给出从被指纹识别（进而被攻陷）的推理引擎出发、直达裸机的概念验证利用链。

Conclusion: 推理引擎本身构成被忽视但关键的攻击面，仅靠输出 token 即可完成指纹识别与漏洞利用。作者最后讨论若干改造推理引擎的方式，以增加指纹识别攻击的难度，从而提升推理栈整体安全性。

Abstract: Frontier AI models are rapidly gaining the ability to exploit vulnerabilities in complex pieces of software. The risk is not theoretical, as evidenced by recent sandbox escapes performed by frontier models at OpenAI and Anthropic. Discussions of how to sandbox inference stack components often focus on components other than the inference engine itself (e.g., network proxies or code execution environments). However, the inference engine is an attractive target for a misaligned model. For example, if a model can trigger exploits in that engine merely by generating specially-crafted output tokens, the model can initiate a multi-step, to-the-bare-metal exploit chain in the engine, without relying on vulnerabilities in other components of the inference stack, and without assistance from externally-provided, maliciously-crafted input tokens.
  In this paper, we show that a misaligned model can perform inference engine fingerprinting to determine the specific engine (e.g., vLLM, SGLang) which executes the model. Once the engine has been fingerprinted, the model can leverage engine-specific exploits to take control of the engine using only carefully-selected output tokens. We provide concrete examples of model fingerprints in five popular engines, and demonstrate how realistic agentic harnesses allow a model to leverage those fingerprints to identify the local engine. We also describe a proof-of-concept, to-the-bare-metal exploit chain that originates from a fingerprinted (and subsequently compromised) inference engine. We conclude by discussing several ways that inference engines could be changed to make fingerprinting attacks more difficult.

</details>


### [410] ["Your Robot Was Trained on a Lie": Collision Mesh Poisoning Attacks on Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18122)
*Gengyang Xu,Dongwei Xiao,Yiteng Peng,Yanbo Dai,Ruochen Zhou,Shing-Chi Cheung,Xiaoyu Ji,Wenyuan Xu,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文揭示了机器人仿真中"视觉网格—碰撞网格"几何不一致所构成的新型攻击面，并提出首个针对机器人操作的三维资产供应链投毒攻击CMP，证明现有防御不足以应对。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作策略日益依赖仿真器进行训练与评估。仿真中同一3D资产包含用于渲染的视觉网格与用于物理交互的碰撞网格，后者出于计算效率常被刻意粗化，与视觉网格不一致。这一"视觉—碰撞缺口"（V–C Gap）虽合理且普遍，却未被现有资产审查流程覆盖，从而形成潜在攻击面。

Method: 提出Collision Mesh Poisoning（CMP）攻击：攻击者仅修改3D资产的碰撞网格，保持视觉网格及其他组件完全不变。投毒后的资产在仿真中表现正常，策略照常训练与评估，但部署到真实世界后策略退化、失效或产生物理安全风险。攻击经由合法资产供应链渠道分发。

Result: 在仿真环境中，基于投毒资产的策略表现与正常资产无异常差异，难以被察觉；而部署到真实世界后，策略性能显著下降、任务失败或引发物理安全隐患。对多种现有防御方法的评估表明，它们均无法有效防御CMP攻击。

Conclusion: V–C Gap构成实用且隐蔽的攻击面，CMP是首个通过3D资产供应链实施的机器人操作投毒攻击。由于现有审查仅覆盖恶意软件、版权与格式合规，而不检查视觉—碰撞一致性，投毒资产可经合法渠道流通；现有防御不足，亟需针对该缺口的新防御机制。

Abstract: Learning-enabled robotic manipulation increasingly relies on robot simulators for policy training and evaluation before real-world deployment. Inside a simulator, a 3D asset contains two separate geometries: a visual mesh used for rendering and a collision mesh used for physical interaction. For computational efficiency, the collision mesh is deliberately a coarse approximation that need not have the same geometry as the visual mesh, a legitimate and pervasive discrepancy we call the Visual--Collision Gap (V--C Gap). We show that the V--C Gap opens a new and practical attack surface, and propose Collision Mesh Poisoning (CMP), the first poisoning attack against robotic manipulation delivered through the 3D asset supply chain. An attacker modifies only the collision mesh of a 3D asset, leaving the visual mesh and all other components unchanged. A policy trained and evaluated with the poisoned asset behaves normally throughout simulation, yet degrades, fails, or creates physical safety risks once deployed in the real world. Since current asset review practices cover malware, copyright, and format compliance, but not visual--collision consistency, poisoned assets can be distributed through legitimate supply chain channels. We evaluate several defenses and our results show that they are insufficient to defend against CMP, highlighting the need for new defenses.

</details>

### [411] [A Mathematical Model of Motivated Emotional Mind - Cognitive Embodied System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20437)
*Wiesław L. Galus,Janusz A. Starzyk*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出"动机性情绪心智"认知架构的数学模型，严格形式化了具身智能系统中前馈、侧向与反馈构成的重入回路及表征选择机制，并将动机学习（ML）推广至受需求、情感与调节状态塑造的具身系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为具身智能系统建立更严谨的认知架构数学形式化，弥补标准强化学习在需求阈值、目标生成与切换、身体状态、资源约束和动作不确定性等方面的不足，以更充分地刻画调节压力下的反应选择。

Method: 构建"动机性情绪心智"认知架构的数学模型：形式化整合前馈加工、侧向交互与反馈通路的重入回路，以及支配适应性反应的表征选择机制；刻画外感受与内感受信号、身体—动机情境和记忆痕迹如何绑定为联想记忆结构"semblions"，并竞争后续加工与自上而下重构；涵盖次级知觉、表征竞争、好奇心、程序性缺口以及以限制稳态失调为目标的行为选择；采用基于内部动机的广义强化学习即动机学习（ML），引入需求阈值、目标生成与目标切换、身体状态、资源约束与动作不确定性；以全局情感作为中心控制信号，调节学习率、表征效价及探索—利用平衡。

Result: 形成了一套涵盖次级知觉、表征竞争、好奇心、程序性缺口与行为选择的统一形式化框架；相比标准强化学习，该模型能纳入需求阈值、目标动态、身体状态、资源约束与动作不确定性，对调节压力下的反应选择给出更充分的解释。

Conclusion: 该模型是认知现象更严谨形式化的一步，可为后续理论分析、计算机模拟以及受生物过程启发的人工智能系统实现提供基础。

Abstract: This article presents a mathematical model of the Motivated Emotional Mind cognitive architecture developed for embodied intelligent systems. Such a system learns to maintain its homeostasis through a generalized form of reinforcement learning based on its internal motivations, termed motivated learning (ML). The principal contribution of this article is a rigorous formalization of the re-entrant loop integrating feedforward processing, lateral interactions, and feedback pathways, together with the representational selection mechanisms that govern adaptive system responses. The model specifies how ongoing exteroceptive and interoceptive signals, bodily-motivational context, and memory traces are bound into associative memory structures termed semblions, which compete for access to further processing and top-down reconstruction. The formalization encompasses secondary perception, representational competition, curiosity, procedural gaps, and action selection directed toward limiting allostatic violations. Within this framework, motivated learning is tailored to embodied systems whose dynamics are shaped by needs, affect, and the current regulatory state. Unlike standard reinforcement-learning models, the proposed approach incorporates need thresholds, goal generation and shifting goals, bodily state, resource constraints, and action uncertainty, thereby providing a more adequate account of response selection under regulatory pressure. Global affect functions as a central control signal, modulating the learning rate, representational valence, and the balance between exploration and exploitation. The model presented here is a step toward a more rigorous formalization of cognitive phenomena and may provide a basis for further theoretical analysis, computer simulation, and implementation in artificial-intelligence systems inspired by biological processes.

</details>

### [412] [Detecting Soft Errors in Parallel Software with LLM-tuned Instruction Duplication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19531)
*Yafan Huang,Guanpeng Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出PaRID——一种面向多线程并行程序的软件导向软错误检测框架，仅需编译期开销即可实现快速软错误检测，在NPB基准上显著降低保护开销并保持检测有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行程序中的软错误检测面临两大挑战：（1）需支持串行与并行区域混合的程序结构；（2）在不依赖高成本动态profiling的前提下最小化性能开销。现有方法难以兼顾普适性与低开销。

Method: PaRID（并行指令复制）结合并行感知的代码变换与LLM调优的性能建模。其设计基于离线特性研究得出的八条可推广发现，通过编译期指令复制实现软错误检测，无需运行时动态分析。

Result: 在NPB基准测试上，PaRID将保护开销从平均162.79%降至59.84%，并实现最高5倍加速，同时保持完整的错误检测有效性。

Conclusion: PaRID证明了编译期软错误检测框架在并行程序中的可行性，能够有效支持混合串并行区域并大幅降低性能开销，为低成本高可靠并行计算提供了实用方案。

Abstract: We propose PaRID (PaRallel Instruction Duplication), a software-directed soft error detection framework that requires only compile-time effort for multithreading parallel programs. PaRID addresses two key challenges: supporting parallel programs with mixed serial and parallel regions and minimizing performance overhead without relying on costly dynamic profiling. It combines parallel-aware code transformation with LLM-tuned performance modeling, guided by eight generalizable findings from an offline characterization study, to enable fast soft error detection in parallel applications. Evaluation on NPB benchmarks shows that PaRID reduces protection overhead from 162.79% to 59.84% on average and achieves up to 5x speedup while maintaining full error detection effectiveness.

</details>


### [413] [Syndrome Decoding for Silent Data Corruption in Quantized Integer GPU Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19743)
*Pranav Napolean,Vikas Srivastava,Napolean Periathambi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: SProbe：面向量化神经网络GPU张量核INT32累加器的尾随校验内核，用随机Freivalds门+Reed-Solomon纠错实现静默数据损坏的检测与精确定位修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化神经网络推理在GPU张量核上执行整数矩阵乘法，其INT32累加器既无奇偶校验也无ECC；瞬时故障会产生合法但错误的整数且不触发中断（SDC）。现有基于校验和的ABFT（如TR-ABFT、加权网格码）只能给出二值判定，无法定位出错元素及其幅值，且未加权行/列校验和对双轴抵消型错误天然盲区。

Method: SProbe作为尾随验证内核，读取未经修改的厂商GEMM输出。核心包括：(1) 随机Freivalds门，在61位素域中取三个独立求值点，漏检非零错误的概率上界为2^-141；(2) 门触发后，对每行在三个素数上计算幂和伴随式，经Berlekamp-Massey、Chien搜索、Forney的RS译码链，恢复每行至多四个碰撞错误的列位置与精确幅值；(3) 就地修复累加器或重算GEMM。

Result: 在NVIDIA H100上，SProbe对七类故障和四种矩阵规模下所有注入故障均实现检测，包括TR-ABFT永不能检测的构造模式以及加权网格码能检测但无法纠正的模式。门开销在N=16384时占cuBLASLt GEMM时间的49%，N=65536时为11%。在INT8医学LLM中，保护消除了所有观察到的静默损坏，吞吐代价30%。测量还表明：所有测试配置下重算均快于就地恢复；恢复成本中诊断而非修复占主导；并报告了验证验证器本身时发现的缺陷。

Conclusion: SProbe将SDC防护从二值检测推进到可定位、可定幅值、可纠正的尾随验证，验证了在高性能GEMM上以可接受开销实现高可靠量化推理的可行性，并指出重算优于就地修复、诊断主导成本的工程结论。

Abstract: Quantized neural network inference runs integer matrix multiplications on GPU tensor cores, and the INT32 accumulators inside those cores have neither parity nor ECC. A transient fault in this datapath returns a valid but wrong integer and raises no interrupt. Checksum based Algorithm Based Fault Tolerance (ABFT) can detect such silent data corruptions (SDCs), but its verdict is binary. It cannot identify the corrupted element or its magnitude, and unweighted row and column checksums are blind by construction to errors that cancel on both axes. We present SProbe, a trailing verification kernel that reads the output of an unmodified vendor GEMM. A randomized Freivalds gate with three independent evaluation points in a 61 bit prime field misses a nonzero error with probability at most $2^{-141}$. When the gate fires, per row power sum syndromes over three primes are decoded with the Reed Solomon chain of Berlekamp Massey, Chien search, and Forney, recovering the column and exact magnitude of up to four colliding errors per row. SProbe then repairs the accumulator in place or recomputes the GEMM. On an NVIDIA H100, SProbe detects every injected fault across seven fault classes and four matrix sizes, including constructed patterns that TR-ABFT never detects and patterns that a weighted grid code detects but cannot correct. The gate costs 49% of the cuBLASLt GEMM time at N=16384 and 11% at N=65536. In an INT8 medical LLM, protection eliminates all observed silent corruptions at a 30% throughput cost. Our measurements also show that recomputation is faster than in place recovery in every configuration we tested, that diagnosis rather than repair dominates recovery cost, and we report the defects we found while validating the verifier itself.

</details>


### [414] [Sketching the Error, Not the Product: Post Hoc Fault Recovery for Half Precision GPU Matrix Multiplication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19758)
*Pranav Napolean,Vikas Srivastava,Napolean Periathambi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出 FP-Sketch,一种在未修改的 Tensor Core GEMM 之后运行的校验器:利用求和 sketch 检测每次调用的静默数据损坏,再用哈希一阶矩 sketch 加独立重算定位多个损坏条目,且无误报。通过实测浮点 sketch 噪声(其常数依赖 BLAS 与操作数格式,桶数需按 n^2.57 增长)来设定桶数,可将八种 transformer 形状的恢复率从 0.402 提升至 1.000。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对缺陷加速器引起的静默数据损坏(SDC)的缓解措施多作用于整个节点,粒度太粗;针对单个 GEMM 的 ABFT 方法需将校验逻辑融合进内核或对操作数编码,且每个校验和最多只能定位一个错误。需要一种非侵入、能定位多个错误并适用于大规模训练的诊断手段。

Method: FP-Sketch 作为未修改半精度输入、FP32 累加与输出的 Tensor Core GEMM 之后的独立校验器:先用求和 sketch 在每次调用中检测是否发生损坏,再用哈希一阶矩 sketch 并由独立重算确认,从而无误报地定位若干损坏条目,每个故障给出坐标与幅值。针对浮点场景,分析 sketch 噪声(而非桶碰撞)对定位的限制,实测其常数对 BLAS 与操作数格式的依赖,并推导方阵积所需桶数随 n^2.57 增长;在运行时测量噪声以自适应设定桶数。结合 NVBit 指令级注入进行验证。

Result: 按实测噪声(而非拟合的 n 幂次)设定桶数,八种 transformer 形状的恢复率从 0.402 升至 1.000,运行时噪声测量可使桶数自适应内核与模型。NVBit 注入显示活跃累加器中的翻转幅值常仅为典型条目的 2%~9%,这是输出侧注入无法产生的分布。输出侧注入可恢复全部故障;而 NVBit 下按典型幅值设定的引擎恢复率为 0.550,按实测幅值设定则恢复至 1.000。在 Llama-2-7B 上,守护 MLP down projection 可消除 2048 次比特翻转所致困惑度损伤的 99.4%(BF16)与 99.9%(FP16),干净路径探测开销为 0.78~3.06 ms,对应 GEMM 为 0.35~12.47 ms。

Conclusion: FP-Sketch 以非侵入方式实现了对 Tensor Core GEMM 的多错误检测与定位,验证了浮点 sketch 噪声是定位精度的核心限制,并表明基于实测噪声的桶数自适应显著优于按 n 的拟合幂次设定。指令级注入结果揭示了输出侧注入无法复现的小幅值翻转分布,说明评估 SDC 缓解方法需采用更真实的注入方式。针对 Llama-2-7B 的 MLP down projection 守护以较低开销大幅降低困惑度损伤,具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: Silent data corruption (SDC) from defective accelerators now interrupts large scale training, yet deployed mitigations act on whole nodes. Algorithm based fault tolerance (ABFT) for a single GEMM has to be fused into the kernel or encode the operands, and it localizes at most one error per checksum. We present FP-Sketch, a verifier that runs after an unmodified tensor core GEMM whose half precision operands are accumulated and delivered at FP32. A sum sketch detects corruption on every call. Hashed first moment sketches, confirmed by independent recomputation, then localize several corrupted entries with no false positives by construction, and each fault yields a coordinate and a magnitude for fleet diagnosis. In floating point, sketch noise rather than bucket collisions limits localization. We measure that noise and find that its constant depends on the BLAS and the operand format and that the bucket count must grow as $n^{2.57}$ for a square product. Sizing the bucket count by measured noise rather than by a fitted power of $n$ raises recovery on eight transformer shapes from 0.402 to 1.000, and measuring the noise at run time adapts the bucket count to the kernel and the model. Instruction level injection with NVBit shows that upsets in a live accumulator are often only 2 to 9% of a typical entry, a population that output side injection cannot produce. Output side injection recovers every fault, while under NVBit the same engine sized for faults of typical magnitude recovers 0.550, and sizing for the measured magnitudes restores 1.000. On Llama-2-7B, guarding the MLP down projections removes 99.4% (BF16) and 99.9% (FP16) of the perplexity damage caused by 2048 bit flips, and the clean path probe costs 0.78 to 3.06 ms against GEMMs of 0.35 to 12.47 ms.

</details>


### [415] [Safe Exploration of Arbitrary Dynamic Dangerous Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19845)
*Caterina Feletti,Paola Flocchini,Giuseppe Prencipe,Nicola Santoro*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文将图网络上智能体探索问题扩展到含黑洞的危险动态网络，研究安全探索：需探索所有安全节点且保证至少一个智能体不被黑洞困住。在时间连通假设下，分别给出无需先验知识与ID的半同步永续探索方案，以及带唯一ID、持久记忆并已知安全节点数的可终止安全探索算法，并证明无法仅正确标记通向黑洞的端口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典静态网络探索中智能体不知道拓扑；动态网络探索已有针对特定图类或已知参数的先验知识研究。Gotoh等(2021)首次在仅需时间连通性的最小假设下研究任意动态网络探索。本文进一步引入"危险动态网络"（存在一个或多个黑洞，智能体进入即被永久困住），研究安全探索问题，以刻画在存在不可逆危险时探索可行性与所需条件。

Method: 在时间连通假设下建模含黑洞的动态网络。第一，证明给定必要（且充分）的智能体数量时，一群无记忆(oblivious)智能体在无网络先验知识、无队伍信息、无智能体或节点ID、半同步调度器下可永续探索所有安全节点。第二，给出一个使智能体安全探索网络并可终止的算法，此时智能体具有唯一ID、持久记忆，并已知安全节点数量。此外，对"仅正确标记通向黑洞端口"进行不可能性证明。

Result: 证明了在必要且充分的智能体数量下，无记忆、无ID、无先验知识的智能体队伍可在半同步调度下永续探索安全节点；给出带唯一ID与持久记忆、已知安全节点数时可安全探索并终止的算法；并证明两类情形下均无法仅正确标记通向黑洞的端口。

Conclusion: 在含黑洞的动态网络中，只要满足时间连通性与必要（充分）的智能体数量，安全探索在弱能力设定下仍可实现；若要求终止，则需增强能力（唯一ID、持久记忆、已知安全节点数）。但精确标记黑洞端口在动态网络中是不可能的，表明安全探索与黑洞端口识别存在本质区别。

Abstract: Given a team of agents on the nodes of a graph-based network, the exploration problem requires each node to be visited by at least one agent. In the classical distributed setting of static networks, agents do not know the topology of the network; in the more recently investigated setting of dynamic networks, they may have prior knowledge about the graph class (e.g., trees, tori, rings) or other parameters (e.g., number of nodes). Gotoh et al. (2021) are the first to study the exploration problem of arbitrary dynamic networks, under the necessary minimal assumption that any two nodes will be connected by a temporal path infinitely often (temporal connectivity assumption). In this paper, we extend their study of exploration under temporal connectivity by considering dangerous dynamic networks, i.e., containing possibly one or more black holes. Whenever an agent enters a black hole, it will be trapped forever. The safe exploration problem requires a team to explore all the safe nodes, ensuring that at least one agent will never be trapped in a black hole. We first prove that, given the necessary (and sufficient) number of agents, a team of oblivious agents can perpetually explore the safe nodes without any prior knowledge of the network or the team, without agent or node IDs, under semi-synchronous schedulers. Then, we provide an algorithm that enables agents to safely explore the network and terminate. In this case, agents are equipped with unique IDs and persistent memory, and they know the number of safe nodes. Yet, in both cases, we prove that it is impossible for a team of agents on dynamic networks to correctly mark only the ports leading to black holes.

</details>


### [416] [Xronos: Heterogeneity-Aware Tensor Parallelism for Collaborative LLM Fine-Tuning on Edge CPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19909)
*Wonmi Choi,Sunjae Park,Dohyeok Kwon,Zhixiong Niu,Yeonho Yoo,Chuck Yoo,Gyeongsik Yang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 针对CPU异构边缘设备,提出Xronos协同微调框架,以张量并行(TP)为执行主干并结合轻量剖析与异构感知张量划分,相比SOTA降低微调时间18%–56%、设备空闲时间比约5.9倍且保持精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有协同微调技术主要面向GPU边缘设备并依赖流水线并行(PP),而许多边缘平台(物联网网关、智能家居中枢、车载计算机)以CPU为主。PP在CPU设备上因同一CPU同时承担计算与通信导致严重资源争用,平均计算停顿比GPU高5.75倍;而TP虽可分离计算与通信缓解争用,但现有TP假设设备同构,在异构CPU设备上使快设备在同步点空转最高达34%。

Method: Xronos以张量并行(TP)作为执行主干,结合轻量级性能剖析(profiling)与异构感知的张量划分(heterogeneity-aware tensor partitioning)来缓解落后者瓶颈(straggler bottleneck)。

Result: 在多种设备、模型与基准任务上,Xronos相比SOTA技术将微调时间降低18%(对比TP)至56%(对比PP),设备空闲时间比降低约5.9倍,同时保持精度不变。

Conclusion: Xronos证明了在异构CPU边缘设备上进行协同微调时,以TP为骨干并引入异构感知划分可有效缓解CPU计算-通信争用与落后者瓶颈,在保持模型精度的前提下显著提升微调效率与设备利用率。

Abstract: Collaborative fine-tuning on edge devices adapts large language models to domain-specific data while keeping each device's data local. State-of-the-art (SOTA) collaborative fine-tuning techniques are largely designed for GPU-based edge devices and rely on pipeline parallelism (PP). However, many edge platforms, including IoT gateways, smart-home hubs, and in-vehicle computers, are primarily CPU-based. This paper reports that PP is ineffective on CPU-based edge devices because the same CPU handles both model computation and communication, which causes severe CPU contention. Our analysis shows that this leads to 5.75$\times$ higher computation stall ratios than on GPU devices on average. Tensor parallelism (TP) can alleviate this contention by separating computation and communication, but existing TP techniques assume homogeneous devices. On heterogeneous CPU edge devices, we find that this assumption causes faster workers to remain idle for up to 34% while waiting for slower devices at synchronization points. To address the limitations, we propose Xronos, a collaborative fine-tuning framework for heterogeneous CPU edge devices. Xronos uses TP as its execution backbone and combines lightweight profiling with heterogeneity-aware tensor partitioning to reduce the straggler bottleneck. Across diverse devices, models, and benchmark tasks, Xronos reduces fine-tuning time by 18% (TP) to 56% (PP) and the ratio of device idle time by $\sim$5.9$\times$ over SOTA techniques, while maintaining the accuracy.

</details>


### [417] [The Life of a Token: from Words to Bits on the Wire](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19924)
*Davide Avesani,Pengwenlong Gu,Sotiris Skaperas,Stefano Secci*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本教程以《神曲》文本为例，梳理从词到网络流量的完整链路，揭示LLM训练中HPC通信流量的形成机理与需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM规模增至数十亿甚至数万亿参数，训练需跨数千互连加速器展开，底层通信网络成为关键却常不透明的组件，亟需厘清语言如何转化为通信流量。

Method: 结合架构分析、解析流量模型与数值示例：以但丁《神曲》为具体案例，说明模型架构、分词、嵌入及并行策略如何决定网络交换数据的规模、结构与时序。

Result: 刻画了LLM训练在通信量、结构与时序上的需求特征，并给出支撑"从文本到训练模型"所需的网络要求等实践性洞察。

Conclusion: 该教程去神秘化了"词如何在网络中传输"，为理解LLM训练的HPC网络需求提供了系统框架与实践指导。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) transform vast collections of unstructured text into semantic patterns used for language generation and reasoning tasks. Behind their ease of use lies a complex process: words become tokens, tokens become vectors, and vectors ultimately give rise to streams of bits that flow through High-Performance Computing (HPC) systems. As modern LLMs grow to billions or trillions of parameters, this path increasingly unfolds across thousands of interconnected accelerators, making the underlying communication fabric a critical and often opaque component of model training. This tutorial aims to walk the reader through the journey from words to network traffic, shedding light on how language is translated into communication flows within HPC training systems. Using concrete examples from Dante's Divine Comedy, we illustrate how model architecture, tokenization, embeddings, and parallelization strategies shape the volume, structure, and timing of data exchanged across the network. We combine architectural analysis with analytical traffic models and numerical examples to characterize the communication requirements of LLM training. We try to demystify how words travel across the network and provide practical insights into the network requirements needed to support the journey from text to trained model.

</details>


### [418] [VERA: Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Memory Scaling of HPC Workloads in Kubernetes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19936)
*Ade Pramono,Jie Ren,Ivy Peng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出强化学习推荐器VERA，将垂直内存扩缩建模为MDP，在3353条真实Prometheus轨迹上训练，实现HPC作业的动态内存缩放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kubernetes上运行HPC负载时，内存过度供给导致资源利用率低下；默认的VPA无法预判首次运行HPC作业中由阶段驱动的内存峰值。

Method: 将垂直内存缩放形式化为马尔可夫决策过程，利用3353条真实Prometheus监控轨迹训练RL智能体，在真实GKE集群上以LAMMPS、图分析、内存分析和MLPerf 3D-UNet等负载进行评估。

Result: RL智能体回收31.6%的可用内存余量，最多仅发生1次OOM；相同运行下VPA回收率为-7.9%，反而增加内存供给，且其推荐在30次运行中不足以避免OOM。

Conclusion: 观测驱动的强化学习推荐器在动态内存缩放上可优于基于回溯式启发式的VPA方法。

Abstract: Memory over-provisioning results in resource underutilization when HPC workloads run on Kubernetes. The default Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA) cannot anticipate phase-driven memory spikes for first-run HPC jobs. In this work, we present a reinforcement learning (RL) recommender VERA that formulates vertical memory scaling as a Markov Decision Process and trains an agent on 3353 real Prometheus traces. Evaluated on a live Google Kubernetes Engine cluster using LAMMPS, graph analytics, in-memory analytics, and MLPerf 3D-UNet, the RL agent reclaims 31.6% of the available memory headroom and incurs at most one OOM event while VPA reclaims -7.9% over the same runs, raising memory provisioning, and its recommendation would have been insufficient to avoid OOM in 30 runs. The results demonstrate that an observation-driven RL recommender could outperform retrospective heuristics for dynamic memory scaling.

</details>


### [419] [P-GADMM: Parallel Group-Based ADMM for Asynchronous Optimization in Heterogeneous Edge Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20006)
*Gaiguo Wei,Qingying Zhang,Heqiang Wang,Yu Zhang,Xiaoxiong Zhong*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出P-GADMM：按算力与数据量分组，结合云端有界异步协调，缩短异构边缘网络训练时间且精度相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同步ADMM在异构边缘网络中因快客户端等待慢客户端而效率下降；现有分组式ADMM的分组规则多基于数据相似性或网络拓扑，未显式考虑计算异构。

Method: P-GADMM依据客户端计算能力与本地数据规模构建计算感知边缘分组，降低组内训练速度差异；再结合边缘级聚合与云端有界异步协调，使活跃组无需等待慢组即可参与全局更新，并通过延迟阈值控制组级陈旧信息。

Result: 对强凸组目标，在组级有界陈旧条件下证明了理想化P-GADMM的收敛性，呈现时间平均收敛行为，收敛至由陈旧性导致的渐近误差邻域；实验表明其减少墙钟训练时间，同时保持与代表性基线相当的最终精度。

Conclusion: P-GADMM通过计算感知分组与有界异步协调，在异构边缘网络中兼顾训练效率与收敛精度，为分布式优化提供有效方案。

Abstract: The Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) is widely used for distributed optimization, but its synchronous implementation can suffer from efficiency loss in heterogeneous edge networks, where fast clients or groups need to wait for slower ones before global updates can be completed. Existing group-based ADMM methods reduce communication overhead through grouping, but their grouping rules usually focus on data similarity or network topology and do not explicitly account for computation heterogeneity. To address this issue, this paper proposes Parallel Group-Based ADMM (P-GADMM) for distributed optimization in heterogeneous edge networks. P-GADMM forms computation-aware edge groups according to client computational capabilities and local data sizes, which reduces training-speed variation within each group. It further combines edge-level aggregation with bounded asynchronous coordination at the cloud, allowing active groups to participate in global updates without waiting for slower groups while controlling stale group information through a delay threshold. For strongly convex group objectives, we establish convergence guarantees for an idealized form of P-GADMM under bounded group-level staleness, showing a time-averaged convergence behavior up to a staleness-induced asymptotic error neighborhood. Experiments show that P-GADMM reduces wall-clock training time compared with representative baselines while maintaining comparable final accuracy.

</details>


### [420] [Distributed Edge Inference: an Experimental Study on Multiview Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20009)
*Gianluca Mittone,Giulio Malenza,Marco Aldinucci,Robert Birke*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文通过真实的多视角检测模型（MvDet）与FastFL高性能边缘推理框架，验证计算连续体（云/边/雾融合）相比中心化方案的性能优势，最高获得1.92倍推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着应用规模增长，云计算的中心化客户端-服务器模式日益限制可扩展性；为实现超大规模扩展，云、边、雾计算融合为计算连续体，将基础设施彻底去中心化以覆盖泛在资源。然而，如何设计能受益于这一复杂环境的应用仍是颇具挑战的研究问题，因此需要实证检验计算连续体带来的机遇。

Method: 以真实的多视角检测模型（MvDet）为工作负载，基于FastFL这一C/C++高性能边缘推理框架实现；设置多种实验场景，涵盖不同边缘计算能力与网络带宽条件下评估计算性能。

Result: 在相同设备条件下，相比中心化解决方案，推理时间最高获得1.92倍加速。

Conclusion: 实验结果验证了计算连续体在去中心化资源环境下提升应用性能的潜力，为面向计算连续体的应用设计提供了实证支持。

Abstract: Computing is evolving rapidly to cater to the increasing demand for sophisticated services, and Cloud computing lays a solid foundation for flexible on-demand provisioning. However, as the size of applications grows, the centralised client-server approach used by Cloud computing increasingly limits the applications' scalability. To achieve ultra-scalability, cloud/edge/fog computing converges into the compute continuum, completely decentralising the infrastructure to encompass universal, pervasive resources. The compute continuum makes devising applications benefitting from this complex environment a challenging research problem. We put the opportunities the compute continuum offers to the test through a real-world multi-view detection model (MvDet) implemented with the FastFL C/C++ high-performance edge inference framework. Computational performance is discussed considering many experimental scenarios, encompassing different edge computational capabilities and network bandwidths. We obtain up to 1.92x speedup in inference time over a centralised solution using the same devices.

</details>


### [421] [The Price of Decentralization, Paid Twice: A Latency Floor and a Minimal Subsidy from a Geographic Decentralization Invariant](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20322)
*Ruiyang Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文以协议无关的方式刻画了验证者低延迟共址倾向对地理故障独立性的侵蚀：定义(ρ,γ)-去中心化，证明在β>γ时任何提议者的β-法定提交延迟至少为ρ（平面上最小值为ρ√(β/γ)），并将该几何下界与激励机制耦合，证明中心化以超临界O(2)对称破缺分岔形式出现，维持去中心化目标需付出Θ(c*ρ/√γ)量级的反集中补贴，即去中心化在延迟与激励两方面以固定比例被"双重支付"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 延迟感知的验证者选择机制（如按投票权重、领导权或快速法定成员资格奖励低延迟验证者）会促使验证者共址部署，从而侵蚀拜占庭容错所依赖的地理故障独立性。作者希望为这一"延迟—去中心化"张力给出一个尖锐且与具体协议无关的形式化刻画，尤其揭示其几何下界与激励代价之间的耦合关系。

Method: 1) 定义(ρ,γ)-去中心化：任何半径ρ区域内持有的权益不超过γ比例；2) 证明对法定阈值β>γ，任何提议者的β-法定提交延迟至少为ρ（与协议无关），并在平面上给出精确最小值ρ√(β/γ)；3) 构建带有真实法定延迟奖励的位置选择博弈，通过超临界O(2)对称破缺分岔分析中心化的涌现；4) 推导维持去中心化目标所需的反集中补贴为Θ(c*ρ/√γ)；5) 在数值与实测地理数据上验证，包括基于RIPE-Atlas延迟矩阵的719个Solana验证者普查。

Result: (1) 证明了对任意协议，当β>γ时提议者的β-法定提交延迟下界为ρ，平面上精确最小值为ρ√(β/γ)；(2) 在位置选择博弈中，中心化表现为超临界O(2)对称破缺分岔；(3) 维持去中心化的反集中补贴为Θ(c*ρ/√γ)，几何下界与激励代价以固定常数比例同时存在；(4) 实测中719个Solana验证者在RIPE-Atlas延迟矩阵上的验证者Nakamoto系数为19，而地理Nakamoto系数仅为1–2。

Conclusion: 作者明确界定贡献范围：延迟的几何下界本身是初等的，本文的核心贡献在于将几何下界与激励代价耦合起来，表明去中心化会在延迟和补贴两方面以固定比例被"双重支付"，并用数值和实测地理数据验证了全部分析。

Abstract: Latency-aware validator selection---rewarding validators for low network latency through voting weight, leadership, or fast-quorum membership---is known to push validators to co-locate, eroding the geographic fault-independence that Byzantine fault tolerance assumes. We give this tension a sharp, protocol-agnostic form. Calling a stake configuration (rho,gamma)-decentralized if no radius-rho region holds more than a gamma fraction of stake, we prove that for quorum threshold beta>gamma every proposer's beta-quorum commit latency is at least rho---independent of the protocol---and in the plane the minimum is exactly rho*sqrt(beta/gamma). Our main result couples this geometric floor to an incentive one: in a location-choice game with the true quorum-latency reward, centralization arises as a supercritical O(2)-symmetry-breaking bifurcation, and sustaining a decentralization target costs an anti-concentration subsidy of magnitude Theta(c*rho/sqrt(gamma))---decentralization is paid twice, in latency and in incentives, in a constant ratio. We verify every claim numerically and on measured geography: a 719-validator Solana census on a RIPE-Atlas latency matrix has validator Nakamoto coefficient 19 but geographic Nakamoto 1--2. We are explicit about scope: the floor is elementary; the contribution is the latency--subsidy coupling.

</details>


### [422] [Accelerating Sharded Data Parallelism at Scale with Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20359)
*Gianluca Mittone,Marco Aldinucci*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该工作借鉴联邦学习的高效通信原则，提出 FL+FSDP 与 FL+HSDP 两种混合算法，将分片数据并行与 FedAvg 式聚合交织，把大规模 DP 解耦为松散联邦组，从而降低通信开销并约束全局批大小，在 512 张 A100 上预训练 Llama3.1 8B 取得显著加速与更低困惑度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型（FMs）训练需在数千张高端 GPU 上运行数月，分片数据并行（sharded DP）虽为加速主流策略，但在大规模部署时通信开销巨大，尤其在性能异构的多层互连上更为严重。作者希望缓解这一瓶颈，并受联邦学习高效通信机制启发寻找新解法。

Method: 提出两种混合算法 FL+FSDP 和 FL+HSDP，将分片数据并行与 FedAvg 风格聚合交织。该方法把大型 DP 部署解耦为多个松散耦合的联邦组，仅在组间传输极少量流量，同时使全局批大小受组规模约束；并对通信成本进行形式化分析。

Result: 在 512 张 A100 GPU 上预训练 Llama3.1 8B，相同超参数下，FL+FSDP 与 FL+HSDP 相比对应基线实现最高 8.04 倍的数据处理加速和 4.48 更低的评估困惑度，体现出更优的计算效率与模型质量。

Conclusion: FL+FSDP 与 FL+HSDP 的可扩展性与灵活性得到形式化分析与实验验证，其优势源于通信开销的降低以及全局批大小相对联邦组规模的受限增长。

Abstract: The symbiotic scaling of artificial intelligence models and high-performance computing systems continually creates algorithmic challenges in their convergence. Foundation models (FMs) are a crucial example, requiring months-long training on thousands of cutting-edge GPUs. Sharded data parallelism (DP) is the dominant strategy to accelerate such computations by splitting data and models across multiple GPUs. However, it incurs prohibitive communication overhead when deployed at scale, particularly on multi-tier interconnects with heterogeneous performance. Inspired by the efficient communication principles of federated learning (FL), this work introduces two hybrid algorithms - FL+FSDP and FL+HSDP - interleaving sharded DP with FedAvg-style aggregations. Such approaches decouple large DP deployments into smaller, loosely-coupled federation groups, requiring minimal inter-group traffic while keeping the global batch size bounded by the groups' size. Formal analysis of communication costs and experimental validation prove their scalability and flexibility. A Llama3.1 8B pre-training on 512 A100 GPUs shows that, under identical hyperparameters, FL+FSDP and FL+HSDP achieve up to 8.04 faster data processing and 4.48 lower evaluation perplexity than their counterparts, demonstrating superior computational efficiency and improved model quality. These properties stem from reduced communication overhead and the bounded growth of the global batch size relative to the federation group size.

</details>


### [423] [A Kubernetes-Native Request Router for Quality-Aware Inference Serving in the Computing Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20497)
*Ignjat Karanovic,Pantelis A. Frangoudis,Ivan Čilić,Ivana Podnar Žarko,Schahram Dustdar*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出ASRB，一种面向Kubernetes计算连续体服务部署的动态、基于分数的请求路由机制，兼顾基础设施信息、响应时间与应用层质量指标，支持延迟-精度权衡，并自适应控制监控开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在计算连续体上部署ML工作负载时，需要在异构基础设施上平衡延迟与精度，并应对监控开销带来的可扩展性问题。现有路由机制难以灵活支持服务提供商定义的QoS策略权衡，且大规模部署下监控成本较高。

Method: ASRB联合考虑基础设施层信息、响应时间测量与应用层质量指标，将服务提供商策略编码为QoS准则的加权组合，驱动基于分数的路由决策；跨多个系统层监控运行时指标，并选择性、自适应地调节监控强度以控制开销；实现上无需修改Kubernetes。

Result: 在测试床实验中，针对延迟优化时，ASRB相比面向延迟的最先进路由机制至少降低10 ms平均响应时间；在特定配置下优先精度时可获得更高精度。同时实现更低的失败率、更高的环境变化响应性，以及相比同类最先进方案最高约70%的监控成本降低，部分配置下仅付出适度延迟代价。

Conclusion: ASRB通过分数化路由与自适应监控，在Kubernetes计算连续体上实现了灵活可控的延迟-精度权衡，兼顾性能、可靠性与监控效率，且部署简便。

Abstract: We introduce Adaptive Score-based Routing Balancer (ASRB), a dynamic, score-based request routing mechanism for Kubernetes-based service deployments over the computing continuum. ASRB jointly considers infrastructure-level information, response time measurements, and application-level quality indicators, with a particular focus on serving Machine Learning (ML) workloads. For these workloads, ASRB balances requests over service instances deployed in the continuum, following service provider-defined policies encoded as weighted combinations of QoS criteria to flexibly address latency-accuracy trade-offs. To drive routing decisions and swiftly adapt to changes in the operating environment, ASRB monitors a range of runtime metrics across multiple system layers. To deal with the associated monitoring overhead, particularly important for large-scale deployments, it selectively and adaptively controls monitoring intensity without sacrificing on routing quality. ASRB is implemented without requiring any modifications to Kubernetes, making it straightforward to deploy and operate in existing cluster environments. Our testbed experiments demonstrate the versatility of ASRB: When tuned for latency reduction, it achieves at least 10 ms lower mean response time compared with latency-oriented state-of-the-art routing mechanisms, while it achieves higher accuracy when this is prioritized through specific configurations, thus enabling flexible and operator-controllable trade-offs. At the same time, it attains reduced failure rates, higher responsiveness to changes in the operating environment, and up to ~70% less monitoring cost than relevant state-of-the-art solutions, at the potential expense of only a modest latency penalty in some configurations.

</details>


### [424] [PixelFlow: Token-Level Workload Management for Efficient Distributed DiT Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20723)
*Zhexiang Zhang,Minchen Yu,Yifan Sun,Xu Bai,Xingliang Yuan,Adel N. Toosi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: PixelFlow提出token级工作负载管理，通过将请求切分为可变大小的分区并在多GPU间分配，兼顾延迟SLO与GPU利用率，SLO达成率提升最高43%，goodput达SOTA的2.8倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线DiT图像生成需满足延迟SLO并高效利用GPU。现有系统靠请求级batching提高利用率，但批次大小控制受限：批次过小无法饱和GPU，过大则违反延迟SLO；全局协调调度还需独立推进的GPU同步，引入额外延迟。

Method: 以图像token为粒度切分和批处理请求负载，使每块GPU在延迟约束下承担部分额外工作，并跨GPU分布这些部分。提供运行时支持：将请求切分为可变大小分区并高效batched执行；优化token放置以减少跨GPU通信并平衡负载；利用去噪步骤间相似性重叠剩余传输与计算；SLO感知调度器按兼容延迟需求对GPU分组，组内独立推进，仅在需合并资源接纳新请求时同步。

Result: 在H100 GPU上使用Stable Diffusion 3和FLUX.1-dev评测，SLO达成率最高提升43%，goodput最高达现有SOTA DiT服务系统的2.8倍。

Conclusion: token级细粒度负载管理可突破请求级batching的控制局限，在不牺牲延迟SLO的前提下提升并发与GPU利用率。

Abstract: Online image generation with Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) must meet latency service-level objectives (SLOs) while using GPU resources efficiently. Existing systems improve GPU utilization by batching multiple requests for joint execution. However, request-level batching offers limited control over batch size: batches may be too small to saturate GPU compute, while larger ones may violate latency SLOs. Globally coordinated scheduling introduces further delays by requiring independently progressing GPUs to synchronize before admitting new work.
  We present PixelFlow, a distributed DiT serving system that addresses these limitations through token-level workload management. Its key idea is to use image tokens (the units a DiT processes to generate an image) to divide and batch request workloads at a finer granularity. This allows each GPU to take on a portion of additional work under latency constraints. By distributing these portions across GPUs, PixelFlow accommodates more concurrent requests, improving GPU utilization while reducing queueing delays. To realize this flexibility, PixelFlow provides a runtime that splits requests into variable-sized partitions and batches them efficiently on each GPU. To reduce the resulting communication overhead, it optimizes token placement to limit cross-GPU data exchange while balancing GPU workloads. It further exploits similarity across denoising steps to overlap the remaining transfers with computation. An SLO-aware scheduler groups GPUs to share compute resources among requests with compatible latency requirements. Each group progresses independently, synchronizing with others only when their combined resources are needed to admit a new request. Evaluation with Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX.1-dev on H100 GPUs shows that PixelFlow improves SLO attainment by up to 43% and achieves up to 2.8 times the goodput of state-of-the-art DiT serving systems.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [425] [AthenaZero: A low-inertia, bimanual robot for dynamic manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19194)
*Andrew S. Morgan,Gregory Xie,Capprin Bass,Rachel Thomasson,Chunpeng Wang,Erfan Shahriari,Harrison Busa,Oluwaseun Araromi,Joseph Aronov,Michael Burgess,Velin D. Dimitrov,Matthew A. Estrada,Faris Hamdi,Samuel Kendig,Taeyoon Lee,Jose Oscar Mur-Miranda,Emma Sommers,Paul Titchener,Margaret Wang,Achu Wilson,Mark Yeatman,Osman Dogan Yirmibesoglu,Alfred A. Rizzi,Annan Mozeika,Nicolas Rojas,Lael Odhner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: AthenaZero是一款双臂机械臂，通过准直驱驱动与传动远程化设计最小化惯量，其有效末端质量接近人类水平（比传统机械臂低约一个数量级），并具备固有力矩透明性，适用于动态操作。系统在棒球式投掷、接球和击球任务中展示了能力：投掷速度超30 m/s，接球和击球在7.3 m距离内超14 m/s，并实现了机器人-机器人与人类-机器人的实战演示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统机械臂惯量大，难以在毫秒级时间尺度上完成高加速度动态交互任务；作者希望设计一款既保持控制权威性又大幅降低惯量的双臂系统，以实现接近人类水平的动态操作性能。

Method: 采用准直驱驱动（quasi-direct drive actuation）与传动远程化（transmission remotization）技术来降低系统惯量，同时保持力矩透明性；论文描述了该设计方法，并通过棒球式投掷、接球和击球三类任务验证系统能力。

Result: AthenaZero的有效末端质量与人类相当，比传统机械臂低约一个数量级；投掷速度超过30 m/s，接球和击球在7.3 m短距离内速度超过14 m/s；并成功进行了机器人-机器人和人类-机器人的接球练习，验证了系统在高加速度任务中的有效性与适应性。

Conclusion: AthenaZero通过低惯量、高力矩透明性的设计，在毫秒级动态交互任务中展现出接近人类的性能，证明其适用于需要高加速度的复杂动态操作场景。

Abstract: AthenaZero is a bimanual manipulator designed to minimize inertia without compromising control authority. By utilizing quasi-direct drive actuation and transmission remotization techniques, the system achieves an effective endpoint mass comparable to that of a human---about an order of magnitude less than conventional robot manipulators. This characteristic, combined with its inherent torque transparency, makes AthenaZero exceptionally well-suited for dynamic manipulation. We describe the methodology} that led to this design and demonstrate the robot's capabilities on three baseball-inspired tasks: throwing, catching, and batting, which showcase complex interactions on human-comparable timescales where milliseconds matter. AthenaZero was capable of throwing at speeds in excess of 30 m/s, with catching and batting at speeds in excess of 14 m/s over a short 7.3 m distance. Batting practice and a game of catch were subsequently performed in robot-to-robot and human-to-robot variations, showcasing the efficacy and adaptability of our system in tasks that require high acceleration.

</details>


### [426] [DITTO: Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19196)
*Joaquin Palacios,Katelyn Lee,Cheng Zhang,Zhanpeng He,Matei Ciocarlie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DITTO 通过灵巧机械手与运动学等价外骨骼的协同设计，统一了自然力透明数据采集与带关节级力反馈的双边遥操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高自由度手部操作数据采集存在两难：遥操作保证部署一致性但缺乏力反馈；手持（in-the-wild）系统提供自然力透明性，却在部署时引入视觉具身差异。

Method: 提出 DITTO（Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation），基于解剖学导向协同设计 7-DOF 灵巧机械手与运动学等价电机外骨骼；外骨骼与机械手之间采用 1-to-1 执行器映射。

Result: DITTO 外骨骼覆盖操作者食指到拇指的自然工作空间，并通过接触丰富任务上的学习策略展示了其灵巧能力。

Conclusion: 单一平台可同时支持手持野外数据采集与带关节级力反馈的双边遥操作，缓解了现有方案在力反馈与部署一致性之间的权衡。

Abstract: Collecting data for manipulation with high-DOF hands is challenging, as interfaces must capture rich hand motion while rendering the contact interactions essential for precise manipulation. Existing data collection approaches face a trade-off: teleoperation ensures deployment consistency but lacks force feedback, while handheld (in-the-wild) systems provide natural force transparency but introduce a visual embodiment gap at deployment. We present DITTO, a Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation, which resolves this through the anatomically informed co-design of a dexterous 7-DOF robotic hand and a kinematically equivalent motorized exoskeleton. A 1-to-1 actuator mapping between the exoskeleton and robotic hand enables handheld (in-the-wild) data collection and bilateral teleoperation with joint-level force feedback unified in a single platform. We demonstrate that the DITTO exoskeleton spans the operator's natural index-to-thumb workspace, and showcase DITTO's dexterous capabilities via learned policies on contact-rich tasks.

</details>


### [427] [ULOHA: An Underwater Bimanual Robot System for Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19200)
*Masato Kobayashi,Takeru Tsunoori*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ULOHA是一个水下双臂机器人学习平台，结合自研主从硬件与LeRobot软件扩展，实现遥操作、多视角感知、示教采集、策略训练与自主部署，并系统评估了ACT、Diffusion Policy与VLA模型SmolVLA在水下双臂任务中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下视觉运动策略学习多集中于单臂，双臂模仿学习主要局限于空气中；水下环境存在气泡干扰、浮力驱动运动等耦合感知与物理效应，缺乏统一的实验平台来研究双臂水下学习及空中策略的水下迁移性。

Method: 搭建ULOHA平台：定制主从式双臂硬件 + LeRobot软件扩展，集成遥操作、多视角传感、示教采集、策略训练与自主部署；在真机上开展协调双臂行为实验（臂间传递、共享物体操作、浮力驱动拦截），并评测ACT、Diffusion Policy、SmolVLA；另设单臂研究考察空气与水中策略迁移，采用跨介质示教。

Result: 真机实验成功实现多类水下双臂协调行为；系统考察了气泡扰动、浮力驱动物体运动、动作执行时域与实时分块（real-time chunking）对空中方法水下表现的影响；单臂研究表明，涵盖两种介质的示教可支持在两种介质中执行。

Conclusion: ULOHA为研究水下环境中感知与物理效应耦合下的双臂机器人学习提供了统一实验平台，并揭示了空中视觉运动策略向水下迁移的可行性与局限。

Abstract: Underwater visuomotor policy learning has focused primarily on single manipulators, while bimanual imitation learning has been studied largely in air. We present ULOHA, an underwater bimanual robot learning platform that combines custom-designed leader--follower hardware with software extensions to LeRobot, integrating teleoperation, multi-view sensing, demonstration collection, policy training, and autonomous deployment. Real-robot experiments demonstrate a range of coordinated underwater bimanual behaviors, including inter-arm transfer, shared-object manipulation, and buoyancy-driven interception. We evaluate ACT, Diffusion Policy, and the vision--language--action model SmolVLA on the platform. We investigate how learning methods and execution strategies developed for manipulation in air perform underwater, examining bubble disturbances, buoyancy-driven object motion, action-execution horizons, and real-time chunking. A separate single-arm study examines policy transfer between air and water and shows that demonstrations spanning both media support execution in both under the tested conditions. ULOHA provides a unified experimental platform for studying underwater bimanual robot learning under the coupled perceptual and physical effects of underwater environments. Additional material: https://mertcookimg.github.io/uloha/

</details>


### [428] [REACT: A Fully Spiking State-Space Model for Real-Time Event-Driven Temporal Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19204)
*Geoffroy Keime,Nicolas Cuperlier,Benoit R. Cottereau*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出REACT：一种全脉冲状态空间模型，逐事件处理原始事件流，无需时间累积，实现低延迟连续时间感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态环境中的机器人需要随感知流连续演化的视觉感知。事件相机具备微秒级时间分辨率与异步感知能力，但多数学习方法将事件累积为帧或时间bin，引入积分延迟，限制快速反应。

Method: REACT为全脉冲（fully spiking）状态空间模型，逐条处理原始事件而不做时间累积。核心为复数脉冲神经元C-SiLIF，其连续时间动态由物理事件间隔（inter-event interval）驱动，内部状态按单事件时间分辨率演化。在无目标框或定位输入条件下，从全视场事件流中完成手势识别与碰撞时间（TTC）估计。支持anytime TTC预测、零样本迁移与INT8量化。

Result: EvTTC上TTC相对误差9.59%，端到端推理延迟4.6 ms，与最优学习方法仅差0.15个百分点且无需目标先验。按数据集平均接近速度，该延迟对应车辆位移仅4 cm，最快对比学习方法为1 m。支持anytime预测与零样本跨驾驶序列迁移；INT8量化将估算能耗从18.5 mJ降至每32,768事件2.8 mJ。

Conclusion: 事件驱动的脉冲状态空间动态可为反应式机器人系统提供低延迟、连续更新的时间感知能力。

Abstract: Robotic systems operating in dynamic environments require visual perception that evolves continuously with the incoming sensory stream. Event cameras provide microsecond temporal resolution and asynchronous sensing, but most learning-based methods accumulate events into frames or temporal bins, introducing an integration delay that can limit fast reaction. Here we propose REACT, a fully spiking state-space model for event-driven temporal perception that processes raw events one by one, without temporal accumulation. REACT uses a complex-valued spiking neuron, C-SiLIF, whose continuous-time dynamics are driven by the physical inter-event interval, allowing its internal state to evolve at the temporal resolution of individual events. We evaluate REACT on gesture recognition and time-to-collision (TTC) estimation from full-field event streams, without a target bounding box or localization input. On EvTTC, REACT achieves a 9.59% relative TTC error with 4.6 ms end-to-end inference latency, within 0.15 percentage points of the best learned method while requiring no target prior. At the dataset's mean approach speed, this latency corresponds to only 4 cm of vehicle motion, compared with 1 m for the fastest competing learned method. REACT further supports anytime TTC prediction, zero-shot transfer to a different driving sequence, and INT8 quantization, reducing the estimated energy consumption from 18.5 to 2.8 mJ per 32,768 events. These results show that event-driven spiking state-space dynamics can provide low-latency, continuously updated temporal perception for reactive robotic systems.

</details>


### [429] [4D Radar Perception Algorithms for Autonomous Driving: A Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19216)
*Xumin Wu,Jun Zhou,Jilin Mei,Chen Min,Yu Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于4D毫米波雷达感知算法的综述，按感知任务与算法演进进行组织，覆盖从信号处理、目标检测到语义分割、运动估计、占据预测与动态场景重建，并讨论雷达单模态学习、多模态融合、跨模态监督与知识蒸馏，总结数据集与评测协议，指出挑战与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4D毫米波雷达感知算法研究近年快速发展，研究范围已从信号处理和目标检测扩展到语义分割、运动估计、占据预测及动态场景重建等多个方向。领域扩张速度快、方向分散，亟需一篇以任务演进为主线的综述来整合研究成果、明确各方向的经验支撑与共性挑战。

Method: 采用任务导向的综述方法：首先介绍雷达基础原理、数据表示与质量增强方法；随后按目标级感知、运动与定位、局部与稠密空间感知、动态场景理解等任务层级进行梳理；在各方向中对比雷达单模态学习、多模态融合以及跨模态监督与知识蒸馏三类范式；重点分析高度维、多普勒测量与雷达物理先验在不同任务中的利用方式；并归纳现有数据集的任务覆盖、输入数据、标注与评测协议。

Result: 系统梳理了4D雷达感知的任务体系与算法谱系，明确了高度信息、多普勒测量和物理先验在各任务中的关键作用；对比了单模态、融合与跨模态监督三类方法的技术特点；汇总了现有数据集在任务覆盖、输入形式、标注类型和评测协议方面的现状，从而厘清了不同研究方向所依赖的实证基础。

Conclusion: 该综述以任务导向视角刻画了4D雷达感知从稀疏目标感知向动态空间理解的转变，讨论了面向自动驾驶的共性挑战与未来方向，为后续研究提供了整体性的参考框架。

Abstract: Research on 4D millimeter-wave radar perception algorithms has flourished in recent years, extending from signal processing and object detection to semantic segmentation, motion estimation, occupancy prediction, and dynamic scene reconstruction. This review organizes the field according to the evolution of perception tasks and algorithms. It first introduces radar fundamentals, data representations, and quality-enhancement methods, and then reviews object-level perception, motion and localization, local and dense spatial perception, and dynamic scene understanding. Across these directions, we compare radar-only learning, multimodal fusion, and cross-modal supervision and knowledge distillation. Particular attention is paid to how elevation, Doppler measurements, and radar physical priors are exploited across tasks. We further summarize the task coverage, input data, annotations, and evaluation protocols of existing datasets, clarifying the empirical support for different research directions. Finally, we discuss the common challenges and future directions of 4D radar perception for autonomous driving. This review provides a task-oriented perspective on the transition from sparse object perception to dynamic spatial understanding.

</details>


### [430] [Grasping by interconnection: robust closing motions from coarse object templates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19228)
*Julien Vanderheyden,Guillaume Drion,Fulvio Forni,Pierre Sacré*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文设计了一种基于虚拟模型控制的抓取运动规划器，利用粗略物体模板、人类抓取类型、以物体为中心的交互与柔顺滑动接触四个原则，使闭合运动本身即可容忍约1cm的尺寸误差和数厘米、数十度的位姿误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧手抓取时物体形状、尺寸与位姿往往只能近似已知；现有抓取规划器通常需要精确模型或依赖反馈纠错，而闭合运动自身能容忍多大不准确性尚不明确。

Method: 基于四项原则设计运动规划器：粗略物体模板、人类抓取类型、以物体为中心的交互，以及用柔顺滑动接触替代预设接触点；通过虚拟模型控制实现，并在Shadow灵巧手上进行评估。

Result: 无反馈条件下，规划的闭合运动可容忍约1cm尺寸误差和数厘米、数十度的位姿误差，在27个测试条件中的25个里优于最先进的数据驱动规划器；在80件日常物体上成功抓取82.5%，并在自主流程中取得成功。

Conclusion: 鲁棒性可以设计进闭合运动本身，而非仅依赖反馈；该规划器为不确定环境下的可靠操作提供了路径，未来将结合物理手上的自适应反馈控制。

Abstract: Dexterous robot hands must often grasp objects whose shape, size, and pose are known only approximately. Grasp planners typically require accurate object models or correct errors with feedback, but how much inaccuracy a closing motion can tolerate on its own remains unclear. To address this question, we designed a motion planner based on four principles: a coarse template of the object, human grasp types, an object-centric interaction, and compliant, sliding contacts instead of prescribed contact points. This paper presents the planner, implemented through virtual model control, and its evaluation on a Shadow Dexterous Hand. Without feedback, the planned closing motions tolerated size errors of about 1cm and pose errors of several centimeters and tens of degrees, a wider range than a state-of-the-art data-driven planner in 25 of 27 tested conditions. They also grasped 82.5% of 80 everyday objects and succeeded within an autonomous pipeline. Robustness can thus be designed into the closing motion itself, rather than left only to feedback. This planner opens a path toward reliable manipulation in uncertain settings, which we will pursue by combining it with adaptive feedback control on the physical hand.

</details>


### [431] [Learning Safe Humanoid Navigation from Reduced Order Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19272)
*William D. Compton,Zachary Olkin,Ryan Bena,Aaron D. Ames*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RoM-Nav：将人形机器人导航分解为降阶动力学导航策略与全阶动力学策略，并用Poisson安全滤波保障OOD安全，在Unitree G1上实现无地图多层导航（垂直位移>10m、路径>100m）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准单阶段强化学习导航流程难以扩展到多层/多楼层地形，瓶颈在于人形机器人与楼梯等复杂地形的交互难度大。

Method: 将导航问题分解为两部分：先用降阶动力学模型加完整3D LiDAR观测训练复杂多层地形导航策略；再以此导航知识热启动（kickstart）全阶人形动力学策略，循环中固定（frozen）运动策略；并对导航策略输出施加Poisson安全滤波以恢复分布外（OOD）障碍下的安全性。

Result: Poisson安全滤波在不降低导航成功率的前提下恢复OOD障碍安全性；RoM-Nav在Unitree G1上完成无地图多楼层导航，测试包含超过10m垂直位移和超过100m路径长度。

Conclusion: 通过降阶到全阶的策略分解与安全滤波，可使人形机器人强化学习导航扩展到多楼层复杂地形，实现长距离、大高差的无地图自主导航。

Abstract: Research in humanoid robotics has achieved rapid progress in locomotion, and recent results have pushed the boundary on autonomous navigation. We demonstrate that a standard single-stage RL navigation pipeline struggles to scale to multi-level and multi-story terrain, limited by the difficulty of complex humanoid terrain interactions such as stairs. To overcome this challenge, we decompose the navigation problem into two pieces. First, we train a policy operating on the reduced order dynamics but with full 3D LiDAR observations to navigate complex, multi-story terrain. We then utilize this navigation knowledge to kickstart a policy operating on the full-order humanoid dynamics, with a frozen locomotion policy in the loop. Additionally, we demonstrate that applying a Poisson safety filter to the navigation policy output recovers safety in the presence of out-of-distribution obstacles, without dropping navigation success rate. We demonstrate the resulting RoM-Nav policy on a Unitree G1, accomplishing mapless multi-floor navigation covering trials with over 10m of vertical displacement and over 100m of path length. Project page with videos https://wdc3iii.github.io/rom-nav/ .

</details>


### [432] [OHRID-Retail: An Open Multimodal Dataset of Human Activity in Retail Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19302)
*Xiangrui Wang,Yuetong Wu,Jalen Beeman,Robert Cook,Yu Gu,Nathanial Pearson,Trevor Smith,Read Hayes,Boyi Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文发布OHRID Retail数据集：16名健康成年人模拟货架拣选任务，在无机器人、低速引导、高速引导三种条件下采集全身运动学（17个惯性传感器）与肌肉活动（10通道表面肌电），支持人机交互与职业生物力学研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 描述人类与移动机器人在共享环境中行为的数据集仍然有限，尤其是零售场景——其同时涉及行走、伸手、物品操作与机器人引导移动等复合行为，缺乏公开的多模态数据资源。

Method: 16名健康成年人参与模拟货架拣选任务，采用被试内三条件设计（无机器人、低速机器人引导、高速机器人引导），每条件完成两次试验；使用17个Xsens Awinda惯性传感器记录全身运动学，使用Delsys Trigno表面肌电传感器在10个位置测量肌肉活动，并提供原始记录、处理后指标、文档与可复现分析资源。

Result: 描述性分析显示，全身运动强度与肌肉激活在不同机器人交互条件和不同身体部位之间存在差异。

Conclusion: OHRID Retail为人类活动识别、多模态传感器融合、职业生物力学、人因工程、人感知机器人导航及零售等共享环境中的人机交互研究提供开放数据支持。

Abstract: Open datasets describing human behavior in environments shared with mobile robots remain limited, particularly for retail activities that combine locomotion, reaching, object handling, and robot guided movement. This paper introduces OHRID Retail, an open, human centered multimodal dataset collected from 16 healthy adults performing a simulated shelf picking task under three within participant conditions: no robot, low speed robot guidance, and high speed robot guidance. Each participant completed two trials per condition. Whole body kinematics were recorded using 17 Xsens Awinda inertial sensors and muscle activity was measured at 10 locations using Delsys Trigno surface electromyography sensors. Descriptive analyses demonstrate variation in whole body movement intensity and muscle activation across robot interaction conditions and body locations. OHRID Retail provides openly available raw recordings, processed measures, documentation, and reproducible analysis resources. The dataset can support research in human activity recognition, multimodal sensor fusion, occupational biomechanics, ergonomics, human aware robot navigation, and human robot interaction in retail and related shared environments.

</details>


### [433] [GAVEL: Graph World Models for Verified and Efficient Long-Horizon LLM Task Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19315)
*Ruiyang Wang,Hao-Lun Hsu,Swarajh Mehta,Jiwoo Kim,Zhihao Dou,Miroslav Pajic*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GAVEL 提出以显式图世界模型为核心的验证与修复框架，用于提升大语言模型长时程机器人规划的可靠性，在 BEHAVIOR-1K 上将单任务成功率从 41.2% 提升至 91.8%，多任务成功率从 19.9% 提升至 92.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 虽为长时程机器人规划提供了灵活接口，但生成的计划常违反具身约束、难以从规划错误中恢复，且在部分可观测条件下推理能力不足，因而需要一种可验证、可修复的规划保障机制。

Method: 构建以显式图世界模型为中心的 GAVEL 框架。该图编码对象关系、动作前置条件与效果，以及对未观测对象位置的概率信念分布；在执行前预测 LLM 生成动作的后果、检测违规并直接依据世界模型修复可从模型中推导出修正方案的动作，仅将需要语义推理的错误交由 LLM 重新规划。针对多任务指令，基于对象可能位置的分布对剩余子任务重排序，以最小化期望搜索代价。

Result: 在 BEHAVIOR-1K 的 100 个单任务长时程任务与 500 条多任务指令上评测。使用 Qwen3-8B 时，单任务成功率由 41.2% 提升至 91.8%，多任务成功率由 19.9% 提升至 92.6%；相较静态变体，基于分布信念的推理将移动距离减少约 5.4%。

Conclusion: 显式图世界模型作为约束外壳可显著提升长时程具身规划的可靠性与效率，且该增益在紧凑型与前沿托管 LLM 能力上均成立。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for long-horizon robot planning, but generated plans often fail to respect embodiment constraints, recover from planning errors, or reason effectively under partial observability. We present GAVEL, a framework for verifying and repairing long-horizon LLM planning built around an explicit graph world model. The graph represents relevant object-relations, action pre-conditions and effects, and probabilistic beliefs over unobserved object locations. This model can predict the consequences of LLM-generated actions before execution, detect violations, and repair those whose corrections follow directly from the world model. This method also reserves LLM replanning solely for errors requiring semantic reasoning. For multi-task instructions, GAVEL reasons over distributions of possible object locations to reorder remaining subtasks and minimize expected search cost. We evaluate GAVEL on BEHAVIOR-1K across 100 single long-horizon tasks and 500 multi-task instructions. With Qwen3-8B, GAVEL improves single-task success from 41.2% to 91.8% and multi-task success from 19.9% to 92.6%. Distributional belief reasoning also reduces travel distance by approximately 5.4% compared with a static variant. These improvements show that an explicit graph world model harness can substantially improve the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon embodied planning across compact and frontier hosted LLM capabilities.

</details>


### [434] [A Morphing Aerial Robot With Thruster-Integrated Flexible Continuum Links for Shape Adaptive Aerial Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19328)
*Eri Sawada,Kazuki Sugihara,Ayano Miyamichi,Kunio Kojima,Kei Okada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种形态可变、旋翼分布式且带柔性连续体连杆的空中机器人，兼具形状适应性与扩展力螺旋空间，实现稳定飞行与多类空中操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空中操作是拓展空中机器人应用的关键。实现多功能空中操作有两条主要研究方向：(i) 用柔性操作器获得高环境适应性；(ii) 将推进器沿操作器分布以扩展可行力螺旋空间。但此前没有空中机器人同时满足这两项要求。

Method: 设计"形态可变+旋翼分布式+柔性连续体连杆"的空中机器人：连续体连杆作为柔性操作器，可被动顺应环境形状；沿连杆分布的推进器扩展可行推力力螺旋空间，使末端执行器能施加较大交互力。为抑制轻质连续体连杆的振动，开发兼具高扭转与垂向刚度的复合板簧结构，并提出抑振控制方法。

Result: 借助上述实现，验证了稳定飞行以及多种空中操作任务。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个使用集成推进器的柔性连杆实现空中操作的工作，同时满足了柔性适应性与扩展力螺旋空间两项需求。

Abstract: In recent years, aerial manipulation has attracted increasing attention as a key to expand the application of aerial robots. In this work, we focus on two major research directions for achieving versatile aerial manipulation: (i) acquiring high environmental adaptability using soft manipulators, and (ii) expanding the feasible wrench space by distributing thrusters along the manipulator. However, no aerial robot has simultaneously satisfied these two requirements.
