TL;DR: Navi-Agent 是一种零样本 VLN-CE 智能体，通过构建无需坐标的空间状态（导航拓扑）实现闭环导航，在零样本基准与真实机器人平台上取得几何约束方法中的最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本 VLN-CE 系统多依赖几何定位或坐标表示维持空间状态；近期几何约束导航虽去除了深度与全局一致坐标，但在地点确认、进度验证与失败恢复上仍难以维持持久空间感知。

Method: Navi-Agent 从视觉观测与已执行运动历史构建无坐标空间状态，组织为导航拓扑：节点表示视觉地点，边表示运动转移。基于该表示实现观测驱动的近似自定位、任务进度验证及基于视觉重访的恢复；采用闭环导航流程：指令分解为子目标、执行局部视觉导航、并借助空间状态验证已访问地点。

Result: 在零样本 VLN-CE 基准与真实机器人平台上的实验表明，Navi-Agent 在几何约束方法中达到 SOTA，同时与依赖几何定位的方法相比具备竞争力。

Conclusion: 以导航拓扑为核心的无坐标空间状态能够有效支撑地点确认、进度验证与重访恢复，为零样本 VLN-CE 提供了一种不依赖深度与全局坐标的可行方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an embodied agent to execute long-horizon instructions in unknown environments. Existing zero-shot VLN-CE systems typically maintain spatial states through geometric localization or coordinate-based representations. Recent geometry-constrained navigation removes depth and globally consistent coordinates, but maintaining persistent spatial awareness for place confirmation, progress verification, and recovery remains challenging. We present Navi-Agent, a zero-shot VLN-CE agent that constructs a coordinate-free spatial state from visual observations and executed motion histories. Navi-Agent organizes this state as a navigation topology, where nodes represent visual places and edges represent motion transitions. This representation enables observation-based approximate self-localization, task progress verification, and visual revisitation-based recovery. Navi-Agent performs closed-loop navigation by decomposing instructions into sub-goals, executing local visual navigation, and verifying visited places through the constructed spatial state. Experiments on zero-shot VLN-CE benchmark and real-world robot platforms show that Navi-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance among geometry-constrained methods while remaining competitive with approaches relying on geometric localization.

</details>


### [504] [Imagine-TAMP: Imagination-Guided Task and Motion Planning in Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20396)
*Antareep Singha,Shivaram Kumar,Yoonwoo Kim,Yoonchang Sung*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Imagine-TAMP是一个交错规划与执行框架，利用语义与几何"想象"在部分可观测下比较任务级策略，提升观测与操作决策质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在杂乱环境中常需操作位置仅部分可观测的物体，核心难题是决定"先获取新的观测"还是"先操作可能遮挡目标的物体"。传统TAMP依赖符号动作代价或昂贵几何规划，无法有效刻画某次观测揭示被遮挡目标的概率。

Method: 提出Imagine-TAMP：①视觉语言模型基于目标与可见物体的常识关系塑造粒子信念分布；②生成式场景模型估计未观测区域的合理几何；③在给定目标假设与想象场景下生成多个符号计划骨架，并赋予非单位代价，近似操作开销与感知动作带来的目标可见性；④遴选骨架后精化为可行连续计划并执行，新观测更新信念并在必要时触发重规划。

Result: 在受视角约束的货架场景中，非单位几何评估将成功率从46.0%提升至84.0%；语义信念塑造进一步减少操作与重规划次数。在真实机器人上，完整系统相比仅几何消融版本规划时间减少32%。

Conclusion: 想象引导的评估能显著改善"观测vs操作"的决策质量，语义与几何想象相结合可提高任务成功率、降低操作与重规划开销并缩短规划时间。

Abstract: Robots operating in cluttered environments must often manipulate objects whose locations are only partially observable. A central challenge is deciding whether to acquire another observation or to first manipulate objects that may occlude the target. Conventional task and motion planning (TAMP) approaches typically make this decision using symbolic action costs or expensive geometric planning, neither of which adequately captures how likely an observation is to reveal an occluded target. We introduce Imagine-TAMP, an interleaved planning and execution framework that uses semantic and geometric imagination to compare alternative task-level strategies under partial observability before committing to expensive motion planning. A vision-language model shapes a particle belief over target locations using commonsense relationships between the target and visible objects, while a generative scene model estimates plausible geometry in unobserved regions. Given a target hypothesis and imagined scene, Imagine-TAMP generates multiple symbolic plan skeletons and assigns non-unit costs that approximate both manipulation effort and target visibility from sensing actions, distinguishing a short but poorly informative observation strategy from a longer strategy that first manipulates an occluder to better expose the target. The selected skeleton is then refined into a feasible continuous plan and executed, with new observations updating the belief and triggering replanning when necessary. Experiments show that imagination-guided evaluation improves observation-versus-manipulation decisions: in viewpoint-constrained shelf scenes, non-unit geometric evaluation increases success from 46.0% to 84.0%, while semantic belief shaping further reduces manipulation and replanning. On a real robot, the complete system reduces planning time by 32% relative to a geometry-only ablation.

</details>


### [505] [Resilient Motion Planning for Free-Flying Space Robots under Actuator Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20407)
*Nicolas de Maddalena,Joris Verhagen,Jana Tumova*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种概率式主动运动规划框架，将执行器失效建模为马尔可夫链，结合预计算可达集与RRT*规划器，最大化自由飞行机器人到达目标的概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自由飞行机器人依赖多个推进器进行机动，一旦一个或多个推进器失效，机器人可能丧失控制能力并导致任务失败。但其自由飞行特性意味着即使无驱动，仍会沿（局部）直线轨迹继续运动。因此需要一种能显式考虑执行器失效、并利用该自由飞行特性的运动规划方法，以提升任务韧性。

Method: 将执行器失效模式建模为马尔可夫链，并沿规划时域传播成功到达目标的概率；使用预计算的可达集评估机器人在潜在失效情况下到达各路径点的能力；再由基于RRT*的规划器将这些路径点串联，形成完整规划。

Result: 该算法最大化整体目标到达概率，能够充分利用自由飞行特性生成最具韧性的运动规划。并在物理自由飞行平台上通过注入执行器失效进行了实验验证。

Conclusion: 所提概率式主动规划框架可有效应对执行器失效，实现对目标到达概率的优化，并通过实物平台实验证明了方法的可行性。

Abstract: Free-flying robots rely on multiple thrusters to maneuver in space. If one or more of these thrusters fail, the robot may lose control authority and risk mission failure. At the same time, their free-flying nature implies that, even in the absence of actuation, they continue along (locally) straight-line trajectories. In this work we present a probabilistic, proactive, motion planning framework that explicitly accounts for actuator failures in space. We model actuator failure modes as a Markov chain and propagate the probability of successfully reaching the goal along the planning horizon. Precomputed reachable sets evaluate the robot's capabilities of reaching waypoints under potential failures and an RRT$^*$-based planner concatenates these waypoints. The resulting algorithm maximizes the overall target-reaching probability, providing maximally resilient motion plans utilizing free-flying properties. We validate our approach experimentally on a physical free-flyer platform with injected actuator failures.

</details>


### [506] [Time-Efficient Iterative Learning Planning for Safety-Critical Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20435)
*Zhiyi Chen,Shuli Lv,Chen Min,Yong Xu,Jian Sun,Quan Quan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文将迭代学习规划(ILP)扩展至动态环境下的安全关键导航，通过集成预期风险混合控制屏障函数(ARB-CBF)，实现实时避障与轻量规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主移动机器人在板载算力受限下需兼顾规划效率与安全关键动态避障；ILP虽轻量高效，但缺乏显式动态障碍感知与规避机制。

Method: 引入ARB-CBF扩展ILP：基于局部障碍风险以分数幂更新学习通行速度与转向偏置剖面，生成名义控制指令，运行时由ARB-CBF修正以提供实时安全保证。

Result: 算法分析表明ILP重规划阶段复杂度为O(kN)（k次迭代、N个路点），ARB-CBF为线性复杂度；仿真与实机实验验证框架在时间效率与安全性上优于基于优化的基线，且计算开销更低。

Conclusion: 该框架在资源受限平台上兼具高效性与安全性，适合动态环境下的实时导航部署。

Abstract: Autonomous mobile robots require timeefficient planning and safety-critical dynamic obstacle avoidance under constrained onboard computation. While Iterative Learning Planning (ILP) offers lightweight and efficient traversal planning, it lacks explicit mechanisms for dynamic obstacle perception and avoidance. This article extends ILP to safety-critical navigation in dynamic environments by integrating an anticipatory risk-blended control barrier function (ARB-CBF). The extended ILP learns traversal-speed and steering-bias profiles via a fractionalpower update based on local obstacle risk, generating nominal control commands that ARB-CBF modifies at runtime for real-time safety guarantees. Algorithmic analysis demonstrates that the ILP replanning stage scales at O(kN) for k iterations and N waypoints, while ARB-CBF executes with linear complexity. Comprehensive simulations and real-world experiments validate the framework, demonstrating superior temporal efficiency and safety with lower computational overhead compared to optimizationbased baselines, making it highly suitable for resourceconstrained platforms.

</details>


### [507] [Spatial-Semantic Uncertainty in VLM-Based Target Search: Balancing Exploration and Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20443)
*Alkesh K. Srivastava,Jonathan Diller,Vijay Kumar,Philip Dames*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出空间-语义不确定性分解框架，将候选位置的空间不确定性与目标身份的语义不确定性分开建模，并据此设计基于期望信息增益的规划器，在搜索-识别任务中显著提升置信决策率并减少冗余探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于VLM的机器人目标搜索需同时决定"去哪里找"和"哪个候选是目标"，但现有系统常把空间不确定性与语义不确定性混为一谈，缺乏对"探索更多"与"尽早识别"之间权衡的显式机制。

Method: 构建空间-语义不确定性表述：对两个分量分别维护信念，将VLM的概率证据整合进全局目标身份后验（含未发现目标的概率质量）；由此使信息论规划器可用空间与语义期望信息增益（EIG）分别评价候选发现与目标消歧；在500个合成目标上评估6种VLM不确定性引出接口。

Result: 相似的识别准确率可能掩盖校准与过度自信上的巨大差异；在退化观测的搜索-识别实验中，基于EIG的规划器在75.0%–92.5%的试验中达到置信决策，而随机搜索仅20.0%；不同空间-语义权重在达到置信后识别准确率相当；提高语义权重可减少不必要的探索与VLM查询。

Conclusion: 不确定性表示与不确定性驱动规划在具身VLM系统中扮演不同角色：显式地对语义不确定性进行规划，可在不牺牲决策质量的前提下加速目标确认。

Abstract: Robots searching for a target from a natural-language description must determine not only where to search, but also which observed candidate is the desired target. These decisions reflect two distinct sources of uncertainty - spatial uncertainty over candidate locations and semantic uncertainty over target identity - that are often conflated in VLM-based search systems. We introduce a spatial-semantic uncertainty formulation that maintains separate beliefs over each component and integrates probabilistic VLM evidence into a global target-identity posterior, including probability mass for undiscovered targets. This decomposition allows an information-theoretic planner to independently value candidate discovery and target disambiguation through spatial and semantic expected information gain (EIG), providing an explicit mechanism for trading broader exploration against earlier identification. We evaluate six VLM uncertainty-elicitation interfaces on 500 synthetic targets and show that similar recognition accuracy can conceal substantial differences in calibration and false confidence. In degraded-observation search-and-identify experiments, EIG-based planners reach confident decisions in 75.0%-92.5% of trials, compared with 20.0% for Random search, while different spatial-semantic weightings achieve comparable identification accuracy once confidence is attained. Increasing semantic emphasis reduces unnecessary exploration and VLM queries, demonstrating that explicitly planning over semantic uncertainty can accelerate target resolution without sacrificing decision quality. These results highlight the distinct roles of uncertainty representation and uncertainty-driven planning in embodied VLM systems.

</details>


### [508] [Visual Sim-to-Real Learning for Robotic Insertion under Geometric Variations: Application to Rebar Installation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20477)
*Tao Sun,Beining Han,Patrick Yin,Rui Xu,Harry He,Abhishek Gupta,Szymon Rusinkiewicz,Yi Shao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 RebarSim，一个完全在仿真中训练的视觉 sim-to-real 系统，用于钢筋插入任务。通过特权状态教师策略蒸馏为多视角学生策略，学生在真实工厂钢筋上实现零样本 91.3% 的成功率，并证明几何多样性与预训练均带来收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 钢筋插入是建筑工地最具重复性和体力消耗的任务之一，且属于 1.4 mm 间隙的接触密集型问题。零件在两层上变化：结构构件的标称设计与围绕标称设计的制造公差，导致真实数据需随设计和批次变化重新采集。因此需要一种无需真实数据的 sim-to-real 方法。

Method: 在程序化生成的钢筋几何上，用强化学习训练基于特权状态的教师策略；再通过广泛域随机化，将教师蒸馏为多视角学生策略，学生直接以原始 RGB 和本体感受为输入并输出动作。

Result: 学生策略零样本迁移到真实世界，在真实工厂生产钢筋上成功率为 91.3%。在多样标称设计上训练可提升教师和学生在未见设计上的零样本成功率，且学生策略优于单设计专家在其自身设计上的表现；预训练学生适应新设计所需蒸馏样本比从零训练少 4–6 倍。移除外观随机化或 DAgger 混合均会显著降低成功率。

Conclusion: 视觉 sim-to-real 迁移依赖外观随机化与 DAgger 混合；几何多样性和预训练对零样本泛化和快速适应均有益，验证了纯仿真训练在接触密集型钢筋插入任务中的可行性。

Abstract: Rebar insertion is among the most repetitive and physically demanding tasks on construction sites, and a contact-rich problem at 1.4 mm clearance. The parts, however, vary at two levels: a nominal design per structural member, and fabrication tolerance around each nominal design. Real-world data therefore has to be re-collected as designs and batches change. We present RebarSim, a visual sim-to-real system trained entirely in simulation. A privileged state-based teacher is trained with reinforcement learning over procedurally generated rebar geometries, then distilled into a multi-view student that maps raw RGB and proprioception directly to actions under extensive domain randomization. The student transfers to the real world zero-shot, seating rebars taken from a real factory production run in 91.3% of real-robot rollouts. Underlying that result, geometry diversity and pretraining both bring benefits. Training across a diverse set of nominal designs rather than one lifts the zero-shot success of both the teacher and the student on unseen designs, and the student policy outperforms a single-design specialist on that specialist's own design. A pretrained student then adapts to a new design with 4--6x fewer distillation samples than one trained from scratch. Visual sim-to-real transfer depends on appearance randomization and the DAgger mixture: removing either one sharply lowers success. Videos, code, and task assets are available at https://rebarsim.github.io.

</details>


### [509] [Towards AI-enhanced control: a numerical technique for trajectory smoothing of a parallel robot for pancreatic surgery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20499)
*Iosif Birlescu,Alexandru Pusca,Bogdan Gherman,Calin Vaida,Ionut Zima,Damien Chablat,Doina Pisla*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于微创胰腺手术并联机器人末端执行器轨迹平滑的数值方法，通过生成S曲线控制加速度以降低组织损伤，并支持实时主从控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微创手术中并联机器人末端执行器若加速度变化剧烈，会对组织造成额外创伤；同时主从实时控制架构要求轨迹平滑算法具备实时性，因此需要一种兼顾平滑性与实时性的轨迹生成方法。

Method: 面向实时主从控制架构，采用3D空间鼠标作为速度控制指令输入；在末端执行器速度场中生成S曲线以控制加速度，并依据空间鼠标的指令输入对S曲线进行分段以实现实时控制；还考虑了加速度时间对所有指令输入恒定的特殊情况。

Result: 数值结果表明，末端执行器参数空间与主动关节参数均实现稳定过渡，未出现突变，验证了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法能够实现并联机器人末端执行器的平滑轨迹控制，减少微创手术中的组织创伤；后续工作将开展实验模型验证，并集成到基于AI的训练模块中。

Abstract: The paper presents a numerical approach for the end-effector trajectory smoothing of a parallel robot designed for minimally invasive pancreatic surgery. The approach is tailored for real-time master-slave control architecture and uses a 3D space mouse for command input for velocity control. The trajectory smoothing is achieved by generating S-curves in the end-effector velocity fields, thus controlling the accelerations, which in turn reduces tissue trauma in the minimally invasive procedures. Real-time control is enabled by segmenting the S-curves based on the command inputs from the 3D space mouse. A special case is considered where the acceleration time is constant for all command inputs. Numeric results demonstrate stable transitions (without abrupt changes) in both the end-effector parameter space and in the active joints parameters, thereby validating the proposed approach. Further work aims to test the approach on an experimental model and integrate it into AI-based training modules.

</details>


### [510] [Integrated Guidance and Control of a Mother-Child UAV-UGV System for Cooperative Missions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20540)
*Aashish Sahu,R. Prasanth Kumar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出并外场验证了一套异构“巡视车-母机-子机”系统的自主空中回收框架，实现子机在悬停多旋翼载体上的自主回收与同步下降，20次任务中17次成功，成功率为85%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型多旋翼在悬停多旋翼载体上回收的难点在于回收面本身是主动控制、推力受限的飞行器，与地面或船载平台不同，因此需要系统级的协调控制与预测能力。

Method: 回收栈包括：jerk有界参考生成、扰动观测器增强的平面跟踪、可行性感知的垂直控制、基于离散时间障碍函数的相对垂直几何安全滤波器，以及通信感知的载体状态预测；整体在PX4-ROS 2架构上实现，融合RTK GNSS、IMU与气压计，母机侧一维激光雷达仅作近距接触辅助提示。

Result: 全程保持RTK固定解；20次户外协同任务中17次完成部署、出击与回收，任务成功率85%；成功回收的平均终端对准时间6.3 s，接受时平均平面对准误差0.18 m，0.40 m捕获半径内最大终端平面偏差0.32 m，耦合下降期间最小相对垂直间距0.41 m；母机平面定点RMS误差0.25 m；3次失败发生于不同任务阶段并单独分析。

Conclusion: 结果表明在测试的外场作业包线内可实现实用的自主空中回收。

Abstract: Autonomous recovery of a small multirotor onto a hovering multirotor carrier differs from recovery onto ground or shipborne platforms because the recovery surface is itself an actively controlled, thrust-limited aerial vehicle. This paper presents a field-validated autonomy framework for a heterogeneous rover-mothership-child system executing rover supervision, mothership transit, child deployment and sortie, autonomous return, aerial recovery, and synchronized descent. The recovery stack combines jerk-bounded reference generation, disturbance-observer-augmented planar tracking, feasibility-aware vertical control, a discrete-time barrier-based safety filter for relative vertical geometry, and communication-aware carrier-state prediction. The contribution is the coordinated system-level integration of these methods for recovery onto a hovering multirotor and its full-scale outdoor validation. The framework is implemented on a PX4-ROS 2 architecture using RTK-enabled GNSS, IMU, and barometric fusion, with mothership-side 1D lidar used only as an auxiliary near-contact cue. RTK-fixed positioning was maintained throughout testing. Across 20 outdoor cooperative missions, 17 successfully completed deployment, sortie, and recovery, giving an observed mission success rate of 85%. For successful recoveries, mean terminal-alignment time was 6.3 s, mean planar alignment error at acceptance was 0.18 m, maximum terminal planar deviation was 0.32 m within a 0.40 m capture radius, and minimum logged relative vertical separation during coupled descent was 0.41 m. Mothership planar station-keeping RMS error was 0.25 m. The three unsuccessful trials occurred at different mission stages and are analyzed separately. Results demonstrate practical autonomous aerial recovery within the tested outdoor operating envelope.

</details>


### [511] [Learning Slope-Adaptive Whole-Body Locomotion for Humanoid Robots in Roofing Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20558)
*Songyang Liu,Shuai Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出以任务语义与场景落地为核心的人形机器人屋面作业全身运动学习框架，在Unitree G1上实现满足支撑、作业间隙与不穿透约束的多种屋面动作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 屋面作业需在斜面上协调行走、平衡与作业性身体运动，对人形机器人挑战大；直接重定向人类演示虽保留动作外观，却使机器人的手足相对屋面的位置不正确，缺乏屋面几何的空间参照。

Method: 用跟踪系统采集人类演示并重定向到机器人，配合度量屋面模型提供空间参照；通过轨迹级优化将推断的支撑接触点与标注的作业关系落地到屋面；再用执行感知的强化学习，使策略在动态跟踪误差下保持这些关系。

Result: 在多运动跟踪、屋面坡度覆盖矩阵、五组消融的钉枪实验、锤击与横向推压跨任务实验，以及与纯强化学习和零样本遥操作的对比中评估。所有种子均满足支撑、作业间隙和不穿透标准；钉枪、锤击、推压的作业间隙误差0.256–0.531 cm，每任务3/3成功；实体实验复现上坡行走、钉枪、锤击和弯腰动作，机体坐标系平均运动误差低于80 mm。

Conclusion: 场景落地的人类运动学习可作为面向建筑作业的人形机器人运动基元的有前景基础。

Abstract: Roofing requires workers to coordinate locomotion, balance, and work-related body motions on pitched surfaces, creating a challenging application for humanoid robots. Directly retargeted human demonstrations, however, may preserve motion appearance while placing the robot's feet or hands incorrectly relative to the roof. This study presents a task-semantic scene-grounded framework for learning roofer-style whole-body motions on a Unitree G1. Human demonstrations are captured using a tracking system and retargeted to the robot, while a metric roof model supplies the spatial reference unavailable from the tracking system. A trajectory-level optimization grounds inferred support contacts and annotated work relations to the roof, and execution-aware reinforcement learning encourages the resulting policy to preserve these relations under dynamic tracking errors. The framework is evaluated through a multi-motion tracking study, a roof-pitch coverage matrix, a five-way nailgun ablation, cross-task experiments on hammering and lateral pushing, and comparisons with pure reinforcement learning and zero-shot teleoperation. Our method enables the robot to satisfy support, work-clearance, and nonpenetration criteria across all evaluated seeds. Across nailgun, hammering, and pushing, it achieves work-clearance errors between 0.256 and 0.531 cm and 3/3 successful evaluations per task. Physical experiments reproduce uphill walking, nailgun, hammering, and bending motions with mean base-frame motion errors below 80 mm. These findings establish scene-grounded human motion learning as a promising basis for construction-oriented humanoid motion primitives.

</details>


### [512] [OmniMimic: Dynamics-completed Motion Augmentation for Multi-style Omnidirectional Quadruped Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20566)
*Sheng Wu,Guoqiang Zhao,Zhe Yang,Fei Teng,Zhikun Zhou,Yanlin Yang,Zheng Fang,Hong Zheng,Yaonan Wang,Kailun Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OmniMimic将方向受限的动物演示扩展为覆盖各轴速度范围的多步态策略，在仿真中显著降低足端位置误差与速度跟踪误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动物演示能为四足机器人提供自然步态风格，但这些演示方向覆盖狭窄，导致后退、侧移和转向指令缺乏风格一致的监督信号；而手工设计奖励又难以刻画此类风格。

Method: 提出OmniMimic训练框架：1）通过时间反转、约束动力学补全与矢状面反射，构建超出观测方向的机器人专属运动学与物理监督；2）将指令从演示速度分布逐步扩展到目标各轴速度边界；3）采用共享actor加软门控、步态专用残差专家的结构，兼顾可复用运动技能与步态特定修正。

Result: 在仿真中对四种步态验证：与匹配的APEX基线相比，前向与后向参考速度下的平均足端位置RMSE降低12.9%，均匀笛卡尔指令网格上的速度跟踪RMSE降低63.1%。

Conclusion: OmniMimic能够把方向受限的动物演示转化为单一多步态策略，在目标各轴速度范围内实现更好的风格一致性与速度跟踪性能。

Abstract: Animal demonstrations provide quadruped robots with natural and distinctive gait styles that are difficult to specify through hand-crafted rewards. However, their narrow directional coverage leaves little style-consistent supervision for backward, lateral, and turning commands. We present OmniMimic, a training framework that turns directionally limited animal demonstrations into a single multi-gait policy over target per-axis velocity ranges. OmniMimic first combines temporal reversal, constrained dynamics completion, and sagittal reflection to construct robot-specific kinematic and physical supervision beyond the observed directions. It then expands commands progressively from the demonstrated velocity distribution toward the target per-axis bounds, and uses a shared actor with soft-gated, gait-specialized residual experts to balance reusable locomotion skills with gait-specific corrections. Across four gaits in simulation, OmniMimic reduces mean foot-position RMSE at forward and backward reference velocities by 12.9% and velocity-tracking RMSE on a uniform Cartesian command grid by 63.1%, compared with the matched APEX baseline. The project page is at https://OmniMimic.github.io.

</details>


### [513] [Walking on the Slope: Stable Bipedal Gaits with Genetic-Algorithm-Optimized Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20570)
*Madhav Rijal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对8自由度双足机器人，建立运动学与动力学模型，采用三次样条生成轨迹、牛顿-欧拉法计算关节力矩、ZMP判据评估稳定性，并用遗传算法优化髋高、摆动足抬升量与额状面倾角。MATLAB仿真表明机器人可稳定行走至步时0.5 s、坡度22.5°，超出后ZMP离开支撑多边形；稳定性由连杆质量分布而非总质量决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要为可在平地与斜面行走的8自由度双足机器人提供完整的运动学、动力学、轨迹生成与稳定性分析框架，并在满足ZMP稳定约束的前提下降低关节做功，明确稳定性的可行边界及其主导因素。

Method: 采用DH参数与齐次变换推导正运动学，闭式逆运动学将髋部与摆动足笛卡尔轨迹（三次样条生成）映射为关节角；用牛顿-欧拉迭代算法计算关节力矩；以ZMP判据评估动态稳定性；用遗传算法在ZMP可行性惩罚下最小化关节做功，优化髋高、最大摆动足抬升量与额状面倾角。

Result: MATLAB仿真显示，标称8自由度模型在步完成时间低至0.5 s、坡度达22.5°（给定足部几何）时仍保持ZMP稳定；超过该范围ZMP离开支撑多边形。稳定性主要由连杆间质量分布决定，而非机器人总质量。

Conclusion: 该建模与优化流程可为平地及斜面双足行走提供稳定边界判定与参数设计依据；当超出0.5 s或22.5°极限时，需修改足部尺寸或轨迹参数以恢复ZMP稳定性。

Abstract: This paper presents the kinematic and dynamic modeling, trajectory generation, and stability analysis of an 8-degree-of-freedom (DOF) biped robot walking on flat and inclined terrain. Denavit-Hartenberg (DH) parameters and homogeneous transformations are used to derive the forward kinematics, while closed-form inverse kinematics maps the desired hip and swing-foot Cartesian trajectories, generated with cubic splines, to joint angles. Joint torques are computed using the Newton-Euler iterative algorithm, and dynamic stability is evaluated using the zero moment point (ZMP) criterion. A genetic algorithm (GA) optimizes the hip height, maximum swing-foot lift, and frontal-plane tilt angle by minimizing the work done by the joints subject to a ZMP feasibility penalty. Simulation results in MATLAB show that the nominal 8-DOF model remains ZMP-stable for step completion times down to 0.5 s and for slope inclinations up to 22.5 degrees with the given foot geometry. Beyond these limits, the ZMP leaves the support polygon, and either the foot dimensions or the trajectory parameters must be modified. The results also show that ZMP stability is governed by the mass distribution among the links rather than the total mass of the robot.

</details>


### [514] [Accelerating Visual Policy Learning with Sampling-Based Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20575)
*Yilang Liu,Haoxiang You,Qian Wang,Daniel Rakita,Ian Abraham*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出采样引导策略搜索（SGPS），将基于采样的MPC与一阶策略梯度结合，在单张GPU上高效训练视觉运动策略并实现零样本真机迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉运动与操作策略学习需协调与环境接触，计算和显存开销大。一阶策略梯度（FoPG）借助可微仿真降低成本，但局部优化易收敛到非预期的接触模式。

Method: SGPS将采样式模型预测控制的动作-目标反复细化与一阶策略优化耦合：先用行为克隆从采样动作初始化策略；训练在扰动初始状态和随机化动力学下交替进行采样细化与短时域FoPG更新。视觉训练采用解耦FoPG，将渲染排除在计算图外，从而无需状态-策略教师即可直接从深度观测学习。

Result: 在单张GPU上于仿真Unitree Go2与G1机器人上学习运动、越障、推箱和双臂搬运策略。实验表明细化不仅用于初始化和跟踪还能提升策略学习。蒸馏后的策略零样本迁移到真实Go2，用机载深度自主小跑、爬行、跨栏并切换行为。

Conclusion: SGPS通过采样引导的细化有效缓解FoPG局部最优问题，在低成本单卡条件下实现多任务视觉策略学习与真机零样本部署。

Abstract: Learning visual policies for locomotion and manipulation requires coordinating contact with the environment and can incur substantial computation and GPU memory costs. First-order policy gradients (FoPG) reduce training cost through differentiable simulation, but local optimization can converge to unintended contact patterns. To address this shortfall, we propose Sampling-Guided Policy Search (SGPS), which couples recurring action-target refinement by sampling-based model-predictive control with first-order policy optimization. Behavior cloning initializes the policy from sampled actions; training then alternates sampling-based refinement with short-horizon FoPG updates under perturbed initial states and randomized dynamics. For visual policy training, we use a decoupled FoPG formulation that excludes rendering from the computation graph, enabling direct learning from depth observations without a state-policy teacher. On a single GPU, SGPS learns policies for locomotion, obstacle traversal, crate pushing, and bimanual carrying on simulated Unitree Go2 and G1 robots. Our experiments further show that refinement improves policy learning beyond initialization and tracking alone. For hardware deployment, the distilled policy transfers zero-shot to a real Go2 and uses onboard depth to autonomously trot, crawl, clear hurdles, and switch between these behaviors.

</details>


### [515] [V2-STRep: VLM-Grounded Structured Task Representations for Reusable Robot Skills Acquired from Generated Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20582)
*Yexin Hu,Dongheui Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: V2-STRep是一个零样本框架，将人类操作视频生成的运动转化为可复用的机器人技能，通过VLM驱动的结构化任务表示实现跨场景迁移与指令适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类操作视频为机器人技能获取提供了丰富的运动与交互线索，视频生成模型可从初始场景图像和任务指令合成演示，避免逐任务录制。但现有方法恢复的运动仅为单一场景的特定实现，任务结构、几何关系与约束均隐含其中，难以复用。

Method: 提出V2-STRep，将生成视频运动转换为结构化任务表示：用VLM基础表征运动阶段、参考对象和任务相关约束，目标以最小几何结构描述（点、点法向、轴、平面、完整6D位姿）。将VLM提供的2D图像空间线索结合RGB-D观测提升至3D，重建任务几何与候选抓取位姿；几何特定规则实现运动向新场景迁移；任务约束轨迹优化将抓取选择与完整运动规划耦合，在满足任务要求的同时利用剩余旋转自由度适应关节限位；更新部署接地与约束即可在新兼容指令下复用，无需重新生成视频。

Result: 在六项真实世界操作任务上，相比基线方法提升了执行成功率，实现了成功习得技能的可靠跨场景迁移，并能适应变化的部署指令。

Conclusion: V2-STRep通过结构化任务表示将生成视频的运动抽象为可复用技能，在零样本条件下实现了跨场景迁移与指令自适应，验证了从人类操作视频中高效获取机器人技能的可行性。

Abstract: Human manipulation videos provide rich motion and interaction cues for acquiring robot skills without robot demonstrations. Video generation models synthesize such demonstrations from an initial scene image and task instruction, avoiding the need to record demonstrations for each task. However, the recovered motion captures only one scene-specific realization, leaving task structure, geometric relations, and constraints implicit. We present V2-STRep, a zero-shot framework that converts generated video motion into reusable robot skills through VLM-grounded structured task representations. The representation specifies motion phases, references, and task-relevant constraints, with targets described by minimal geometric structures: points, point-normals, axes, planes, and full 6D poses. VLM-provided 2D image-space cues are lifted into 3D using RGB-D observations to reconstruct task geometry and candidate grasp poses. Geometry-specific rules transfer motion to new scenes, while task-constrained trajectory optimization couples grasp selection with complete robot motion planning. It preserves task requirements while using remaining rotational freedom to accommodate joint limits. Updating deployment grounding and constraints enables reuse under new compatible instructions without generating another video. Experiments on six real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved execution success over baselines, reliable cross-scene transfer of successfully acquired skills, and adaptation to changed deployment instructions.

</details>


### [516] [CoRef-GS: Cooperative Referring Gaussian Splatting for Multi-Agent Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20586)
*Zhikun Zhou,Kunyu Peng,Runyi Yang,Junhao Cai,Di Wen,Ruiping Liu,Danda Pani Paudel,Yi Zhou,Luc Van Gool,Kailun Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CoRef-GS协作指代高斯泼溅框架，实现融合地图上的视角条件指代定位，并构建双四足基准CoQuad-Ref。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身机器人指代场景理解需从指定视角对物体与关系查询进行定位；单智能体局部语义高斯地图可支持，但协作场景下独立重建地图对齐融合后，目标或上下文地标可能来自其他智能体观测，而空间关系仍须从查询机器人视角解释。现有语言感知高斯方法仅面向单地图查询，高斯配准方法只优化几何/光度对齐，未保持语言定位所需的语义兼容性。

Method: 提出CoRef-GS框架：构建局部开放词汇实例感知高斯地图；通过跨智能体对齐模块，基于几何与语义一致性对齐部分重叠地图；使用视角条件掩码关系图进行查询定位。同时构建CoQuad-Ref双四足基准，涵盖真实与仿真室内场景。

Result: 仿真场景中，CoRef-GS将旋转误差从粗初始化后的2.58°降至精化后的0.15°；真实世界指代mIoU相较ReferSplat从52.6%提升至68.8%。

Conclusion: CoRef-GS有效解决融合地图上的协作指代高斯定位问题，兼顾几何可对齐性、实例级语义可比性与视角条件关系推理，并公开基准与源码。

Abstract: Referring scene understanding for embodied robots requires grounding object- and relation-centric language queries from a designated viewpoint. While a local semantic Gaussian map can support such grounding within one agent's observations, cooperative settings require this ability to remain effective after independently reconstructed maps are aligned and fused. In this setting, the referred target or its contextual landmark may come from another agent's observations, while spatial relations must still be interpreted from the querying robot's viewpoint. We formulate this problem as cooperative referring Gaussian grounding over fused maps, which requires geometric alignability, instance-level semantic comparability, and view-conditioned relation reasoning. Existing language-aware Gaussian methods mainly focus on single-map querying, whereas Gaussian registration methods optimize geometric or photometric alignment without preserving language-grounding-oriented semantic compatibility. We propose CoRef-GS, a cooperative referring Gaussian splatting framework. CoRef-GS constructs local open-vocabulary instance-aware Gaussian maps, then aligns partially overlapping maps with a cross-agent alignment module by geometric and semantic consistency, and grounds queries using a view-conditioned mask relation graph. We further introduce CoQuad-Ref, a dual-quadruped benchmark spanning both real-world and simulated indoor scenes. Experiments show that, on simulated scenes, CoRef-GS reduces the rotation error from 2.58° after coarse initialization to 0.15° after refinement, and improves real-world referring mIoU over ReferSplat from 52.6% to 68.8%. The established benchmark and source code will be publicly released at https://github.com/ruojiruoli17/CoRef-GS.git.

</details>


### [517] [Semantic SLAM in Precision Agriculture using Bayesian Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20604)
*Ruben Beumer,Sander Doodeman,René van de Molengraft,Duarte Antunes*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出面向精准农业的实时语义世界建模框架，融合贝叶斯概率建图与g²o图优化SLAM，实现不依赖GPS的作物定位与建图，经仿真与Spot实体实验验证可实时建图上至少400株植物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精准农业中自主机器人需在农田环境中同时完成建图与定位，而传统方案过度依赖GPS，且缺乏对作物语义属性（种类、尺寸、健康状况）的结构化建模，难以支撑精细农业任务。

Method: 框架将对象及其语义属性的概率建图（通过贝叶斯推断更新）与基于g²o的图优化SLAM相结合；使用深度相机观测，训练YOLOv8n目标检测模型提取目标与语义信息；在Gazebo仿真及室内人工植株场地用Boston Dynamics四足机器人Spot开展实验。

Result: 仿真与物理实验表明，系统可在不单独依赖GPS的情况下实现准确定位与建图，并能实时完成至少400株植物的语义建图。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了语义概率建图与图优化SLAM集成用于精准农业自主机器人的可行性，为作物级语义地图的实时构建提供了有效方案。

Abstract: This paper presents a real-time semantic world modeling framework specialized for precision agriculture using autonomous robots. The framework combines probabilistic mapping of objects and their semantic attributes, updated through Bayesian inference, with a graph-based Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) approach implemented using $g^2o$, a general framework for graph optimization. This integration enables accurate mapping and localization without relying solely on GPS. By leveraging semantic information such as plant type, size, and health, the robot can perform tasks while mapping and localizing itself within a field of crops. The proposed framework was validated through Gazebo simulations and physical experiments on an indoor field with artificial plants using Boston Dynamics' robot dog Spot. A YOLOv8n object detection model was trained to extract object and semantic data from depth camera observations. These simulations and experiments demonstrate that the system can successfully perform real-time mapping of up to at least 400 plants.

</details>


### [518] [Bayesian Continuum Robot Dynamics and State Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20605)
*James M. Ferguson,Tucker Hermans,Alan Kuntz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于因子图的连续体机器人动力学状态估计方法，通过Cosserat杆动力学建模，将惯性与阻尼等效为外加载荷，保持动态平衡的代数形式与准静态情形一致，实现动态运动下的随机前向仿真与状态估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因子图方法对连续体机器人状态估计主要依赖准静态假设或白噪声运动先验，在惯性效应显著时无法准确刻画底层物理，导致动态运动中的估计精度受限。

Method: 将连续体机器人的Cosserat杆动力学作为建模基础，把惯性和阻尼项改写为等效外加载荷，使动态平衡方程保留与先前准静态工作相同的代数形式；在无骨架观测时退化为机器人运动的随机前向仿真，在有观测时联合优化运动学与动力学状态并推断外加载荷等状态量。

Result: 通过仿真与实验验证了该方法，在腱驱动连续体机器人上实现了随机前向仿真以及状态估计。

Conclusion: 将动力学等效为静态形式的因子图框架可有效扩展至动态情形，克服准静态近似的局限，为连续体机器人动态状态估计提供统一且可验证的方案。

Abstract: Recent factor graph approaches to continuum robot state estimation have been successful for quasi-static applications and spatiotemporal estimation using white-noise kinematic motion priors. However, when inertial effects are significant, these approximations may fail to capture the underlying physics, limiting accuracy during dynamic motions. In contrast, our approach approximates the Cosserat rod dynamics of continuum robots. We write inertia and damping as equivalent applied loads, so that the dynamic balance retains the algebraic form of the static one from prior work with quasi-static robots. Without backbone observations, the framework reduces to a stochastic forward simulation of the robot's motion. Given observations, it jointly refines kinematic and dynamic states and infers external loads, among other states. We validate the approach through simulation and experiments, demonstrating stochastic forward simulation as well as state estimation on tendon-driven continuum robots.

</details>


### [519] [Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20822)
*Bingxin Xu,Yuzhang Shang,Zhen Dong,Emilio Ferrara*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文首次评估编码智能体在安全约束下的机器人操作，发现其主要失败在于规划阶段忽视安全约束，提出SafeHarness（障碍感知路径规划与接触执行）以修复该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体（coding agent）已成为机器人操作的有前景范式：语言模型将控制器写成程序，无需机器人特定训练即可操作机器人。但该范式是否安全尚未被研究。作者因此在带安全约束的任务中评估其安全性：每个任务包含一个操作目标和一个不可触碰的障碍物，以检验智能体是否会把规避障碍作为优先级。

Method: 作者将操作分解为路径阶段（route phase）与富接触时刻（contact-rich moment）以定位失败来源。提出SafeHarness，赋予模型两个障碍感知工具：(1) 障碍感知路径规划——将物体表达为包围盒，并在其上以路点序列绘制候选路径，智能体预先规划、验证、必要时重规划后再执行；(2) 障碍感知接触执行——选择接触位置使接触本身避开障碍。

Result: SafeHarness取得71.9%任务成功率与87.5%避障率，分别超越此前SOTA 6.5%与27.0%；为无该工具的同款智能体的2.3倍与1.5倍。

Conclusion: 基线编码智能体在多数情况下会碰撞障碍物，把任务完成当作唯一目标而忽视安全；其失败不在感知或指令，而在规划中安全约束从未成为优先级。通过障碍感知的路径规划与接触执行工具可有效弥补该缺口，显著提升安全性与成功率。

Abstract: Coding agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation: a language model writes the robot controller as a program, and agents built in this way now operate robots without robot-specific training.Whether this paradigm is also safe, however, has not been asked. We evaluate coding agent under a safety constraint, where each task pairs a manipulation goal with an obstacle the robot must not touch. The agent pursues the goal but collides with the obstacle in most cases, treating task completion as its sole objective while neglecting safety. The agent reasons about the obstacle in its traces, and the prompt already forbids touching it, so neither perception nor instruction is at fault; the fault lies in the planning, where the stated constraint never becomes a priority. By decomposing manipulation into a route phase and a contact-rich moment, we locate the source of the failure. Along the route, the model cannot prioritize the safety constraint, having no notion of a clearing route and none of replanning once a chosen route becomes infeasible. At the contact, it is unaware that contact execution is bounded by the same constraint. To close this gap, we present SafeHarness, which equips the model with two obstacle-aware harnesses that enable it to prioritize the safety constraint. Obstacle-aware route planning grounds the objects as bounding boxes and draws candidate routes over them as sequences of waypoints. The agent then plans a route in advance, verifies it, replans when necessary, and only then executes it. Obstacle-aware contact execution instead selects the contact position so that the contact itself avoids the obstacle. SafeHarness attains 71.9% task success and 87.5% collision avoidance, surpassing the previous SOTA by 6.5% and 27.0%, respectively. These results are $2.3\times$ and $1.5\times$ those of the same agent without harnesses.

</details>


### [520] [INSPECT: Learning Robot View Selection from Assistant Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20615)
*Di Wen,Kailun Yang,Wenhao Guo,Yitian Shi,Junwei Zheng,Yufan Chen,Ruiping Liu,Jiale Wei,Rania Rayyes,Kunyu Peng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 INSPECT 系统，使机器人借助智能眼镜助手的第一视角记录学习视角偏好，在装配检测中自主选择最能验证零件状态与安装正确性的观察视角，并在齿轮箱与角磨机数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人执行装配检测时需判断零件是否存在及安装是否正确。第一视角辅助记录中的头部运动与工件操作提供了检测证据，语音状态确认则将观察与流程结果关联。但机器人难以直接复用这些人类示范数据：目标域缺乏视角标签，且需在仅有当前观察与已知位姿的条件下选择视角。

Method: 提出 INSPECT：(1) Presence-Invariant TwinSwap（PI-TwinSwap）通过成对身份干预校准物体证据；(2) Claim-indexed supervision 将证据需求与相机可复现的观察变化分离；(3) Object-centered calibration 将相对视角偏好适配到机器人位姿；(4) Clause-level screening 校验预测证据。机器人仅用当前观察和已知位姿选视角，无需候选图像。

Result: 在实体齿轮箱装配图像上，INSPECT 在非 oracle 策略中取得最高视角效用，人类评定的完全可验证率由保持当前视角的 34.8% 提升至 41.7%；在 IMPACT 商用角磨机记录上，迁移的相对视角选择器在感知头冻结条件下将正确决策率从 50.6% 提升至 54.3%。

Conclusion: INSPECT 可从第一视角辅助记录中学习视角偏好，在无目标域视角标签条件下实现机器人自主视角选择，提升装配检测的可验证性与决策正确率。

Abstract: Robots inspecting an assembly must determine which parts are present and whether they are correctly installed. During egocentric assembly assistance, head motion and workpiece handling reveal evidence for these checks, while spoken state confirmations link observations to procedural outcomes. We introduce INSPECT, which learns robot view preferences from records of a smart-glasses assistant that answers part queries and provides next-step guidance. Presence-Invariant TwinSwap (PI-TwinSwap) calibrates object evidence through paired identity interventions. Claim-indexed supervision separates evidence requirements from camera-reproducible observation changes. Object-centered calibration adapts relative view preferences to robot poses, while clause-level screening checks predicted evidence. The robot selects views using only its current observation and known poses, without candidate images. Evaluation uses annotated assistant-video replay to simulate state feedback, without target-domain view labels for policy training. On images of physical gearbox assemblies, INSPECT achieves the highest view utility among the compared non-oracle policies and raises human-rated full verifiability from 34.8% to 41.7% compared with keeping the current view. On commercial angle-grinder recordings in IMPACT, the transferred relative-view selector increases the correct decision rate from 50.6% to 54.3% with a frozen perception head. The source code is available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/INSPECT.

</details>


### [521] [A Simulation Platform for AUV Fault Recovery: Exploring LLM-Based Diagnostic Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20620)
*Khalid Halba,Kylie Cooper,James G. Bellingham*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SPAR闭环仿真平台，将实时C载具软件与LLM编排层耦合，通过480次断层（mass-shift）试验的集成测试评估LLM辅助的AUV故障诊断与恢复规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AUV在超出可靠通信范围时无法依赖人工干预，需自主从故障中恢复；传统确定性分层控制可管理正常运行，但难以应对未预期故障，因此引入LLM作为诊断与恢复规划器，并需要严格的集成式评估方法而非单次演示。

Method: 构建SPAR（Simulation Platform for AUV Recovery）闭环仿真架构：耦合实时C载具软件与高层编排层，支持基于物理的故障注入、结构化提示、语言模型交互、任务文件生成、验证、执行与LLM判官评分；在mass-shift故障下进行480次试验，覆盖不同故障实现、提示结构、推理模型与任务条件，评估1个前沿模型与3个可本地部署的现成LLM。

Result: 模型选择主导诊断性能：前沿模型在85-90%试验中将重心偏移机制列入前三假设，最佳本地模型仅为60-78%；推理分析显示本地模型成功与遵循完整诊断流程相关，较弱模型常在执行器仍跟踪指令时过早断定升降舵故障；诊断与操作决策性能在该数据集中未见耦合。

Conclusion: 贡献在于：提出将未预期故障恢复从检测扩展到缓解的架构，以及面向低功耗AUV上LLM辅助任务管理的集成评估方法。

Abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) operating beyond reliable communications must recover from failures without human intervention. We investigate an architecture in which conventional deterministic layered control autonomy manages normal operations, while an invokable large language model (LLM) serves as a diagnostic and recovery planner when onboard anomaly detection identifies performance outside expected limits. Because language models are stochastic, rigorous evaluation requires ensemble testing rather than individual demonstrations. We present a closed-loop simulation architecture that couples real-time C vehicle software with a higher-level orchestration layer for physics-based fault injection, structured prompting, language-model interaction, mission file generation, validation, execution, and LLM-judge scoring. The framework, which we call SPAR (Simulation Platform for AUV Recovery), supports evaluation across fault realizations, prompt structures, reasoning models, and mission conditions. We vary these for a mass-shift fault over 480 SPAR trials, evaluating a frontier model and three off-the-shelf locally deployable LLMs. Model choice dominates diagnosis: the frontier model places the CG-shift mechanism in its top three hypotheses in 85-90% of trials, versus 60-78% for the best local model. Reasoning analysis indicates that local-model success is associated with following the complete diagnostic procedure, whereas weaker models often commit prematurely to elevator failure even though the actuator tracks its command. Diagnosis and operational decision performance do not appear to be coupled in this dataset. The contributions are an architecture extending unanticipated-fault recovery from detection to mitigation and an ensemble methodology for evaluating LLM-assisted mission management on low-power AUVs.

</details>


### [522] [SmellDiffusion: Diffusion-Based Quadruped Navigation with Olfactory Scene Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20624)
*Faith Ogunwoye,Iana Zhura,Hajira Amjad,Timofei Kozlov,Didar Seyidov,Dmitrii Plotnikov,Fedor Fedorov,Dzmitry Tsetserukou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SmellDiffusion仿真管线，用开放词汇嗅觉场景图表示气体分区，结合几何门控源修正与扩散轨迹生成，实现气源定位与导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人需在执行指定气体泄漏任务时保持气体种类辨识、估计气源并导航至目标，但流场中浓度峰值常偏离真实源，导致源估计误差。

Method: 在开放词汇嗅觉场景图中表示种类特异气体区域，经典与扩散规划器共享目标；采用峰值局部几何门控进行选择性源修正，并用扩散模型生成气体引导轨迹。

Result: 424个源-风配置中28个峰值偏离源超0.5m；门控在10个留出偏移中检出9个（精度0.64）；修正使偏移案例平均误差由1.468m降至0.592m，全案例由0.205m降至0.180m。扩散best-of-ten气体暴露与气体引导A*相当（0.0476 vs 0.0455），单次扩散41.7ms快于A*的72.3ms；Gazebo实测误差A* 0.39m、扩散0.31m。

Conclusion: 几何门控结合前向匹配修正在低调用率下显著降低源估计误差，扩散规划器在暴露与精度上可媲美经典方法，但时序采样增加总耗时，A*仍为最快最短路方法。

Abstract: A robot sent to a named gas leak must preserve gas identity, estimate the source, and navigate to the resulting goal. We present SmellDiffusion, a simulation pipeline that represents species-specific gas zones in an open-vocabulary olfactory scene graph and shares the selected goal between classical and diffusion planners. Its key components are a peak-local geometric gate for selective source correction and diffusion-based, gas-guided trajectory generation. Among 424 unique source-wind configurations in solved flow, 28 have a concentration peak displaced more than 0.5m from the source. A source-independent geometric gate, calibrated only on the training split and evaluated at the observed peak, detects 9 of 10 held-out displacements at 0.64 precision. Gating a precomputed forward-matching correction reduces mean error on the displaced cases from 1.468m to 0.592m (60%), using matching for only 14/204 cases. All-case mean error falls from 0.205m to 0.180m. All planners receive the same scene-graph source estimate as their goal. In a controlled comparison, best-of-ten diffusion achieves mean gas exposure comparable to gas-guided A* (0.0476 versus 0.0455). A single diffusion proposal takes 41.7ms, compared with 72.3ms for gas-guided A*, although best-of-ten sequential sampling increases total runtime. Plain A* also reaches the same goal and remains the fastest and shortest-path method. Six matched Gazebo runs give mean robot-to-source errors of 0.39m for A* and 0.31m for diffusion.

</details>


### [523] [RTK-Vision PPO for Autonomous Micro UAV Recovery on an Airborne Carrier](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20629)
*Aashish Sahu,R Prasanth Kumar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RTK-视觉引导的强化学习框架，实现微型UAV从移动空中载机上起飞、独立飞行任务后自主返航并重新对接，完成完整的空中部署-回收循环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实现微型无人机在移动空中载机上的自主回收，可支持"部署-任务-回收"的可重复使用作战模式；但该任务耦合了远程交会、近距感知、载机运动、气动干扰以及不连续的接触事件，技术难度大。

Method: 子机由大型载机物理搭载并在空中起飞执行独立任务；双方均搭载RTK-GNSS，载机持续共享导航状态。近距离回收阶段RTK保持工作，朝下相机配合标记检测器提供相对对齐线索。终端回收策略采用PPO算法，在MuJoCo物理仿真中训练，加入显式传感器噪声模型、气动扰动代理和标记延迟随机化，再迁移到硬件；底层稳定由PX4负责，确定性安全门独立于学习策略授权下降。

Result: PPO策略在2000个随机终端回收测试回合中成功率99.55%，相同条件下调优PD基线为78.4%，平面终端误差中位数6.62 cm。14次户外试验中完整任务成功13次（92.9%），涵盖近距回收和载机远离释放点后的回收。

Conclusion: 验证了完整的自主空中部署-回收循环，而非孤立的着陆机动，为巡检、监视和移动物流场景中可重复使用的载机-子机协同作业奠定实用基础。

Abstract: Autonomous recovery of a micro unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) onto a moving airborne carrier enables reusable deploy-mission-recover operation, but couples long-range rendezvous, close-range perception, carrier motion, aerodynamic interaction, and a discontinuous contact event. This paper presents an RTK-vision-guided reinforcement-learning framework in which a child UAV is physically transported by a larger carrier, takes off from the carrier while airborne, executes an independent sortie, returns to the carrier's current position, redocks, and subsequently descends with the carrier. Both vehicles carry RTK-GNSS, and the carrier continuously shares its navigation state with the child. Near the recovery deck, RTK remains active while a downward-facing camera with a fiducial marker detector provides marker-relative alignment cues. A proximal policy optimization (PPO) policy governing the terminal recovery phase is trained in a physics-based MuJoCo simulation environment with explicit sensor noise models, an aerodynamic disturbance surrogate, and marker-latency randomization, then transferred to hardware. PX4 retains low-level stabilization, and a deterministic safety gate authorizes descent independently of the learned policy. The PPO checkpoint achieves 99.55% success over 2,000 held-out randomized terminal episodes, compared with 78.4% for a tuned PD baseline under identical conditions, with a median planar terminal error of 6.62 cm. Across 14 outdoor trials, the full mission succeeds in 13 trials (92.9%), spanning both near-region recovery and recovery after the carrier translates away from the release point. The results demonstrate a complete autonomous aerial deployment-and-recovery cycle rather than an isolated landing maneuver, establishing a practical basis for reusable carrier-child operation in inspection, surveillance, and mobile-logistics applications.

</details>


### [524] [TraceFlow: Guiding Frozen Flow-Matching Robot Policies with Success and Failure Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20646)
*Jiaxuan Zhang,Ruizhe Liu,Yu Zhang,Yanchao Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TraceFlow: 将检索到的成功/失败轨迹的动作密度转为有界引导场，单比特终局标签即可修正冻结的流匹配动作专家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时方法（检索成功样本、学习批评器、验证器、动力学模型）均不利用机器人自身失败轨迹作为负证据，且需要额外标签；本文仅用每回合1比特终局结果。

Method: TraceBank 存时间有序的状态-动作记录及终局标签，初始化于目标任务训练轨迹并接纳部署机器人自身回合；以进度对齐的引导场把成功/失败轨迹的动作密度转为对冻结流匹配动作专家的有界修正，不更新权重。

Result: 真实装箱有序任务：基线50次中21次按序完成，TraceFlow 39次，叠放第1轮47次，错序回合由20降至0。仿真收益有选择性：RoboMemArena Sequence 78.92%→91.50%，Transferring 54.41%→62.00%（叠放第2轮），26任务总体不变，Counting与Occlusion分别降1.12与1.42点，LIBERO-Plus (Long) +1.27点(p=0.0733)。

Conclusion: 叠放增益有限，各分支均在第十轮前见顶；库内成功-失败比无法预测检索分配。

Abstract: A vision-language-action (VLA) policy with a flow-matching action expert generates each action chunk (a short command sequence) by integrating a learned velocity field; once its weights are fixed, the success or failure of an earlier rollout cannot change the chunk generated now. Concurrent test-time methods give a frozen policy such an input from retrieved successes, a learned critic, a verifier, or a dynamics model, but none uses the robot's own failed rollouts as negative evidence with nothing but a terminal outcome bit. We introduce TraceFlow, a progress-aligned guidance field that turns the action densities of retrieved successful and failed rollouts into a bounded correction to a frozen flow-matching action expert, using one terminal outcome bit per rollout and no other label. Its TraceBank stores traces, time-ordered state-action records with a terminal label, starts from the target-task training traces, and later admits the deployed robot's own rollouts. On an ordered real-robot packing task the base completes 21 of 50 trials in order, TraceFlow 39, and one stacking round without any weight update 47, with wrong-sequence episodes falling from 20 to 0. In simulation the gain is selective: with per-suite selected settings, TraceFlow raises RoboMemArena Sequence from 78.92\% to 91.50\% task success and Transferring from 54.41\% to 62.00\% at stacking round 2, leaves the 26-task aggregate unchanged, lowers Counting and Occlusion by 1.12 and 1.42 points, and changes LIBERO-Plus (Long) by +1.27 points (p = 0.0733). Stacking gains are finite, every branch peaking before round ten, and the bank's success-to-failure ratio predicts no retrieval allocation.

</details>


### [525] [SkipVLA: Skipping VLA Steps with Classical Planning for Fast Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20648)
*Kaivalya Agrawal,Md Ashiqur Rahman,Raymond A. Yeh,Zachary Kingston*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SkipVLA将预训练VLA与经典运动规划器结合成混合策略：自由空间运动交由规划器完成，仅在抓取、放置等接触密集型技能时查询VLA。该方法复用冻结的VLA视觉-语言主干预测规划运动的目标位姿，无需新增演示数据即可学习该预测器。在13个LIBERO仿真任务和6-DoF YAM机械臂的3个抓放任务上，任务完成速度最高提升2.5倍，能耗显著降低，成功率不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型作为通用机器人策略可端到端映射图像与语言指令到动作，但推理速度慢，尤其长时程任务需大量策略查询。现有加速方案（蒸馏小模型、异步动作块重叠、搭配快速低层策略）仍需在学习策略下运行整个任务。而经典运动规划器虽能快速求取无碰撞运动，却需要显式目标且缺乏语义理解。因此需要一种将二者的互补优势结合、同时不牺牲成功率的方法。

Method: SkipVLA是一种混合策略：自由空间运动由经典运动规划器负责，仅在接触密集型技能（抓取、放置）处查询预训练VLA。该方法复用VLA冻结的视觉-语言主干，为每段规划运动预测目标位姿，并利用大型VLA已学到的知识训练该位姿预测器，从而不向系统引入额外演示数据。

Result: 在仿真中，使用三种VLA在13个LIBERO任务上评估；在物理6-DoF YAM机械臂上评估三个抓放任务。结果显示任务完成速度最高提升2.5倍，能耗显著降低，同时保持相同的任务成功率。

Conclusion: 将VLA的语义理解与经典运动规划器的高效无碰撞规划相结合，仅在必要处调用VLA，可在不损失成功率的前提下大幅降低VLA策略的时延与能耗，为长时程机器人任务提供了一种高效混合策略范式。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a class of generalist robot policies that map camera images and language instructions directly to robot actions. While promising, these models remain slow at test time, particularly for long-horizon tasks that require many queries to the policy. Recent efforts reduce VLA latency by distilling smaller models, overlapping asynchronous action chunks, or pairing the VLA with a fast low-level policy, but still run a learned policy for the entire task. In contrast to VLA, classical motion planners quickly find collision-free motions, but require an explicit goal and have no semantic understanding of the task. In this work, we present SkipVLA, a hybrid policy that combines a pretrained VLA with a classical motion planner, using the planner for free-space motion and querying the VLA only for contact-rich skills such as grasping and placing. SkipVLA reuses the frozen vision-language backbone of the VLA to predict a target pose for each planned motion, and learns this predictor without additional demonstrations introduced into the system by using what was already learnt by the large VLA. We evaluate SkipVLA with three VLAs on 13 LIBERO tasks in simulation and three pick-and-place tasks on a physical 6-DoF YAM arm, demonstrating up to 2.5x faster task completion and significantly lower energy consumption while achieving the same task success rate.

</details>


### [526] [DexTouch-WM: Learning Action-Conditioned Tactile World Models from Human Touch for Dexterous Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20649)
*Yan Qin,Yue Chen,Wenwei Lin,Shujia Liu,Chuqiao Lyu,Kailun Su,Chenze Yu,Ping Luo,Wenbo Ding,Tianxing Chen,Renjing Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 DexTouch-WM，一种基于人类触觉数据可扩展学习的动作条件世界模型，联合预测未来RGB观测与双手触觉动态，并验证其可用于策略评估与合成轨迹生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触丰富的灵巧操作预测模型依赖密集触觉交互数据，但真实机器人数据采集成本高且与特定传感器本体绑定，难以规模化，因此需要引入可扩展的人类触觉监督来突破数据瓶颈。

Method: 核心洞察是当触觉观测与动作空间兼容时，人手与机器人的操作共享可迁移的接触动力学。具体做法：在人手与灵巧机器人手上部署布局一致的柔性压阻阵列，将人体动作重定向到机器人动作空间，使人类交互可监督同一动力学模型；模型耦合预训练视频专家与轻量触觉专家，采用解剖感知触觉token和对齐的动作条件。

Result: 在人类到机器人扩展实验中，固定5小时真实机器人监督，将人类交互数据从0小时增至100小时，尽管人类与机器人任务集不重叠，机器人域的视觉、几何与接触预测在留出集上均有显著提升；世界模型还可作为策略评估的代理环境，并生成合成轨迹用于真实机器人策略学习。

Conclusion: 可扩展的人类交互为学习灵巧机器人世界模型提供了互补的数据维度，人类触觉数据能够有效迁移并增强机器人域的预测与策略学习能力。

Abstract: Learning predictive models of contact-rich dexterous manipulation requires dense tactile interaction, but such data are costly to scale on real robots and remain tied to embodiment-specific sensors. We introduce DexTouch-WM, an action-conditioned world model that learns from scalable human touch to jointly predict future RGB observations and bilateral tactile dynamics. Our insight is that human and robot manipulation share transferable contact dynamics when their tactile observations and action spaces are made compatible. We deploy flexible piezoresistive arrays with a shared sensing layout on both human and dexterous robot hands, and retarget human motion into the robot action space so that human interaction can supervise the same dynamics model used for real-robot prediction. DexTouch-WM couples a pretrained video expert with a lightweight tactile expert using anatomy-aware tactile tokens and aligned action conditioning. In human-to-robot scaling experiments, we keep five hours of real-robot supervision fixed while increasing human interaction from 0 to 100 hours, and observe substantial improvements in held-out robot-domain visual, geometric, and contact prediction despite disjoint human and robot task sets. Beyond prediction, we evaluate the world models as surrogate environments for policy evaluation and as generators of synthetic trajectories for real-robot policy learning, showing that scalable human interaction provides a complementary data axis for learning dexterous robot world models.

</details>


### [527] [HIL-UMI: Bringing Human-in-the-Loop Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Models to Universal Manipulation Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20659)
*Zimu Han,Yiming Zeng,Jiyao Zhang,Zihao Zhao,Yuanfei Wang,Yixiang Jin,Shiqi Li,Shuangben Chen,Wei Huang,Ruodai Li,Hui Shen,Hao Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 HIL-UMI 框架，在无需真实机器人执行的情况下，通过手持 UMI 设备进行人机在环的 VLA 后训练，利用能量分数触发数据采集并用优势估计指导行为克隆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模 VLA 模型虽有强先验，但适配具体部署仍困难。任务级示范的 SFT 存在两点局限：静态数据对分布外状态覆盖不足；标准模仿目标无法区分有进展的行为与低价值数据。交互式后训练虽可缓解，却通常依赖真实机器人反复执行与人工干预。

Method: HIL-UMI 在手持 UMI 示范中，对同一观测流查询当前策略但不执行其预测。用 Energy Score 比较人类动作轨迹与策略推断，当差异指示分布外区域时触发采集。另一反馈回路中，用低在线优势预测识别关键片段以精炼基于进展的优势估计器；更新后的估计器再以基础示范与新策略数据的平衡混合指导优势条件行为克隆。

Result: 在四个真实世界任务（含长时程与精细操作）上，HIL-UMI 相对 SFT 取得一致提升，并同时受益于定向采集与优势精炼。在 Clean Up Table 任务上优于 HG-DAgger，且单帧采集时间更低。

Conclusion: 该方法在保持人机在环学习的迭代性与策略感知特性的同时，将数据采集与机器人部署解耦，为跨操作者、跨地点的 VLA 后训练提供了可扩展路径。

Abstract: Large-scale vision-language-action (VLA) models provide powerful priors for robot manipulation, yet adapting them to a specific deployment remains challenging. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on task-specific demonstrations provides a step toward deployment, but faces two persistent limitations: static data provide limited coverage of out-of-distribution states, and standard imitation objectives do not distinguish progressing behavior from less useful data. Interactive post-training can address these limitations, but typically requires repeated policy execution and human intervention on a physical robot. We introduce HIL-UMI, a policy-guided Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) framework for robot-free human-in-the-loop VLA post-training. During handheld UMI demonstrations, HIL-UMI queries the current policy on the same observation stream without executing its predictions. The Energy Score compares the human action trajectory with policy inference and triggers collection when their discrepancy indicates an out-of-distribution region. In a separate feedback loop, low online advantage predictions identify essential segments for refining a progress-based advantage estimator. The updated estimator then guides advantage-conditioned behavioral cloning using a balanced mixture of base demonstrations and new policy data. This design preserves the iterative and policy-aware nature of human-in-the-loop learning while decoupling data collection from robot deployment. Experiments on four real-world tasks spanning long-horizon and precise manipulation show that HIL-UMI achieves consistent improvement over SFT and benefits from both targeted collection and advantage refinement. Moreover, HIL-UMI outperforms HG-DAgger on Clean Up Table with lower per-frame collection time, suggesting a scalable path for VLA post-training across operators and locations.

</details>


### [528] [Learning Foresight without Explicit Trajectories for 3D Diffusion Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20669)
*Zhongbo Zhang,Zaibin Zhang,Yifan Wang,Changbo Yan,Lijun Wang,Huchuan Lu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Movement Trend Guidance，通过从短历史中学习交互演变的紧凑隐表示，并在推理时仅保留该隐表示作为面向未来的条件，在不引入显式规划的前提下增强 3D 扩散策略的前瞻能力，参数仅增加 3.52%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D 扩散策略能生成几何上可行的动作，但成功操作不仅需要知道当前可行的运动，还需预判交互的走向。现有策略大多依赖动作学习隐式地涌现这种前瞻能力，缺乏显式的未来导向机制，因此需要一种简单有效的方式来提供前瞻而无需引入显式规划。

Method: 方法核心为 Movement Trend Guidance：从短观测历史中学习交互演变的紧凑隐表示；训练时用稀疏的未来末端执行器状态监督该表示；推理时仅保留该隐表示，与当前观测一起作为未来导向的条件。该隐表示对动作生成提供全局条件，同时仅在 UNet 瓶颈处引入额外的门控 FiLM 分支。方法保留了原有的密集动作与滚动时域（receding-horizon）框架，仅较 DP3 增加 3.52% 参数。

Result: 在 RoboTwin2.0、LIBERO-40 和 DexArt 上均一致优于 DP3：50 任务 RoboTwin2.0 混合训练中达 62.8%（对比 56.1%）；LIBERO-40 上达 71.93%（对比 37.08%）；五个真机任务上达 72.0%（对比 49.0%）。

Conclusion: 结果表明，扩散策略能够从"知道交互走向"中显著受益，而无需被告知具体移动到哪里；该方法在保持原框架与低参数开销的同时，持续提升了 3D 扩散策略的性能。

Abstract: 3D diffusion policies are strong at generating geometrically grounded actions from current observations, but successful manipulation requires not only knowing what motion is feasible now, but also anticipating where the interaction is heading. Existing policies largely leave such foresight to emerge implicitly from action learning. We introduce Movement Trend Guidance, a simple but effective way to provide this foresight without introducing an explicit plan. From a short observation history, the policy learns a compact latent representation of interaction evolution. During training, sparse future gripper states supervise this representation; at inference, only the latent is retained as future-oriented conditioning alongside the current observation. The latent provides global conditioning for action generation, while an additional gated FiLM branch is used only at the UNet bottleneck. Despite adding only 3.52% more parameters to DP3, our method preserves the original dense-action and receding-horizon formulation and consistently improves upon DP3 across RoboTwin2.0, LIBERO-40, and DexArt. It reaches 62.8% vs. 56.1% in 50-task RoboTwin2.0 mixed training, 71.93% vs. 37.08% on LIBERO-40, and 72.0% vs. 49.0% on five real-robot tasks. These results show that a diffusion policy can benefit substantially from knowing where an interaction is heading, without being told exactly where to move.

</details>


### [529] [MAGNETAR: Multipath-Guided Spatial Posteriors for Transmitter Pose Inference in the Upper Mid-Band](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20670)
*Haozhe Lei,Ruibin Chen,Yuhan Jiang,Ali Rasteh,Aditya Dhananjay,Sundeep Rangan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MAGNETAR从单次异步RF多径快照推断发射机的平面位置与朝向联合后验分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在杂乱房间中，单次测量常与多个发射机位置与朝向一致，仅给点估计不够，需刻画多模态不确定性。

Method: 以AoA与SNR估计为输入，结合房间布局与接收机位姿；采用共享2D U-Net，逐候选朝向条件化，在离散化的位置-朝向网格上联合归一化得分；训练用Real-to-Sim校准的10 GHz仿真加少量实测数据。

Result: 基于网格的联合后验在留出仿真上优于参数化方法；朝向条件化评分器向机器人实测迁移最好；融合联合后验优于融合仅位置的边缘后验。

Conclusion: 联合建模位置与朝向、网格化归一化及朝向条件化评分可提升多径下RF发射机定位的鲁棒性与迁移性。

Abstract: Robots that localize a radio transmitter need more than a point estimate: in cluttered rooms, one measurement is often consistent with several transmitter locations and, because upper-mid-band antennas are directional, several headings. We present MAGNETAR, which infers a joint posterior over planar transmitter position and heading from a single asynchronous radio-frequency (RF) multipath snapshot, represented by angle-of-arrival and signal-to-noise-ratio estimates, given the room layout and receiver pose. Among our five neural scorers, MAGNETAR adopts a shared 2D U-Net conditioned on each candidate heading, jointly normalizing scores over a discretized position-heading grid. Training uses real-to-sim-calibrated 10 GHz simulations and a small measured subset. Grid-based joint posteriors outperform parametric ones on held-out simulations, the heading-conditioned scorer transfers best to robotic measurements, and fusing joint posteriors improves on fusing position-only marginals.

</details>


### [530] [Towards Scaling Marine Perception with Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20680)
*Haoyu Ma,Onur Bagoren,Anja Sheppard,Elias Fandi,Ashrith Edukulla,Tanner Aslan,Natasha Sieh,Jingyu Song,Katherine A. Skinner*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工作扩展了基于IsaacSim的水下感知仿真器OceanSim，加入合成数据生成（SDG）流水线，可自动生成大规模、带标注、照片级真实的水下数据集，并在真实海胆检测任务上验证了仿真到现实的迁移效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下环境中可扩展的机器学习受限于真实标注数据匮乏：真实数据采集成本高、耗时费力，难以大规模获取与整理。仿真数据有望弥补这一缺口，从而支撑水下感知的学习任务。

Method: 在IsaacSim-based的水下感知仿真器OceanSim基础上，扩展一套合成数据生成（SDG）流水线，支持用户生成大规模、自动标注、照片级真实的数据集，并可配置场景外观、结构与传感器设置；在真实海胆检测任务上进行评测，分析不同合成场景变化形式对sim-to-real性能的影响。

Result: 在真实世界海胆检测任务上验证了该流水线的有效性，并系统考察了不同合成场景变化对sim-to-real性能的影响；同时总结了主要发现。

Conclusion: 研究讨论了当前流水线的主要局限，并指出未来方向：提升水下渲染保真度、增强场景多样性，以及改进sim-to-real泛化能力的评估方法；代码已开源。

Abstract: Scalable machine learning in challenging underwater environments is strongly limited by the lack of labeled real-world training data. This data is often expensive and laborious to gather, making large-scale real-world data challenging to gather and curate. However, simulated data can help close the gap, enabling many learning-based tasks for underwater perception. In this work, we extend OceanSim, an IsaacSim-based underwater perception simulator, with a Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) pipeline for training models to be used in underwater scenarios. The proposed pipeline enables users to generate large, automatically labeled, photorealistic datasets with configurable scene appearance, structure, and sensor settings. We evaluate the pipeline on a real-world sea urchin detection task and study how different forms of synthetic scene variation affect sim-to-real performance. Based on these experiments, we discuss findings on our results, main limitations of the current pipeline and identify future directions for improving underwater rendering fidelity, scene diversity, and the evaluation of sim-to-real generalization. The open-source code can be found at https://github.com/umfieldrobotics/OceanSim.

</details>


### [531] [Custom PX4 firmware for autonomous hybrid aerial-marine missions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20691)
*Andrea Capuozzo,Fabio Ruggiero,Vincenzo Lippiello*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文为跨域（空中-水面）混合无人机提出一种PX4固件扩展，引入手动与自主水上导航模式，并与标准PX4任务流程及QGroundControl界面集成，支持区分空中与水上航点的统一任务规划与执行。仿真案例验证了实现，并展示了在平静与波浪条件下的稳定水面航行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水环境测绘与监测需要能在同一任务中结合飞行与水面航行的混合无人机，但现有PX4固件与地面站（QGroundControl）缺乏对水面导航模式及跨域混合任务的支持。

Method: 对PX4固件进行扩展，加入手动与自主水上导航模式；将其集成到标准PX4任务流水线与QGroundControl界面；在保留原有飞行功能与安全机制的前提下，实现带有空中/水上差异化航点的统一规划与执行。通过仿真案例进行验证。

Result: 仿真案例研究验证了该实现的有效性，并表明在平静和波浪条件下均能保持稳定的水面航行。

Conclusion: 该PX4固件扩展使得混合空中-水上无人机能够以统一方式规划和执行跨域任务，同时兼容既有飞行功能与安全机制，为水环境测绘与监测提供了可行的软件基础。

Abstract: Mapping and monitoring aquatic environments can benefit from hybrid aerial-amphibious drones able to combine flight and water-surface navigation within the same mission. This paper presents a PX4 firmware extension for such platforms, introducing manual and autonomous marine navigation modes integrated with the standard PX4 mission pipeline and QGroundControl interface. The proposed framework preserves existing flight functionalities and safety mechanisms while enabling unified planning and execution of hybrid aerial-marine missions with differentiated aerial and marine waypoints. Simulated case studies validate the implementation and demonstrate stable surface navigation under calm and wavy conditions.

</details>


### [532] [HOPHY: A Hierarchical Hypergraph Representation for Off-Road Path and Mission Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20694)
*Pranay Meshram,Charuvahan Adhivarahan,Prithvi Poddar,Ehsan Tarkesh Esfahani,Chen Wang,Souma Chowdhury,Karthik Dantu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 HOPHY——一种基于超图的可复用分层越野地形表示，将地图尺度地形组织为几何连接语义区域、保连通粗区域与类型化超边，支持状态变化下的局部更新；在公里级真实越野地图上实现 100% 规划成功率、中位代价偏差<0.01%，并显著降低查询与重规划延迟；用于多机器人任务分配时相对像素 A* 减少 79 倍计算量，并在实体 Jackal 上完成 1.5 km 八任务野外任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害响应、搜救与战术 UGV 等任务级自主需要在连续变化的地形条件、智能体类型和目标之间反复进行路径与任务规划；像素网格搜索在公里尺度上重复查询代价高昂，而语义抽象必须在地形条件变化时仍保持有效代价与连通性。

Method: HOPHY（Hierarchical Off-Road Planning using Hypergraphs）：构建可复用的分层地形表示，包含几何连接语义区域（GSNodes）、保连通的粗区域（Coarse Regions），以及用于编码地形、智能体与天气上下文的类型化超边；通过超边交集定位受影响区域及相关边，实现局部状态更新而无需重建整个层级结构。

Result: 在覆盖公里级区域的真实越野地图上，规划成功率达 100%，相对 oracle（像素 A*）的中位代价偏差小于 0.01%，查询与重规划延迟显著低于对比的像素与抽象基线；在多机器人任务分配（MRTA）中，总计算量较像素 A* 减少 79 倍、较最快抽象基线减少 7.2 倍，任务跨度（makespan）与像素 A* 相当；在实体 Clearpath Jackal 上成功执行 1.5 km、八任务的混合地表户外任务，并完成一次由阻塞触发的重规划路线。

Conclusion: HOPHY 以超图表征实现可复用、可增量更新的分层越野规划，在保持接近像素级最优解质量的同时大幅降低计算与重规划开销，并可支撑实际多机器人任务级自主。

Abstract: Mission-level autonomy for disaster response, search and rescue, and tactical UGV operations requires repeated path and mission planning as terrain conditions, agent types, and objectives change. Pixel-grid search is costly for repeated kilometer-scale queries, while semantic abstractions must maintain valid costs and connectivity as conditions change. We present HOPHY (Hierarchical Off-Road Planning using Hypergraphs), a reusable hierarchical terrain representation that organizes map-scale terrain into geometrically connected semantic regions (GSNodes), connectivity-preserving critical regions (Coarse Regions), and typed hyperedges for terrain, agent, and weather context. Hyperedge intersections select affected regions and incident edges for state updates without rebuilding the hierarchy. Across real off-road maps spanning kilometer-scale areas, HOPHY achieves 100% planning success and less than 0.01% median cost deviation from the oracle (pixel A*), with substantially lower query and replanning latency than the evaluated pixel and abstraction baselines. Applied to a multi-robot task-allocation (MRTA) problem, these gains reduce total computation by 79x over pixel A* and 7.2x over the fastest abstraction baseline, with mission makespan comparable to pixel A*. Finally, we demonstrate HOPHY on a physical Clearpath Jackal that successfully executes a 1.5-km, eight-task mission across mixed-surface outdoor terrain and a blockage-triggered replanned route.

</details>


### [533] [MoWAM: Explicit Future Motion Prediction for Efficient World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20709)
*Jiayu Wang,Bin Zhu,Yue Yu,Jingjing Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出MoWAM，用显式未来运动预测替代未来视频生成，在训练时学习未来视觉动态、联合预测运动与动作，推理时完全去除视频生成，并支持推理时扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有World Action Models通过引入未来动态提升机器人策略学习，但推理时显式生成未来视频带来巨大计算开销；若去掉未来生成虽提升效率，却使未来动态仅隐式编码于观测特征中，在分布偏移下鲁棒性受限。

Method: MoWAM不重建完整未来场景，而是将结构化机器人运动建模为未来的紧凑抽象，捕捉机器人在当前场景与交互约束下预期如何演化。采用Mixture-of-Transformer架构，训练时学习未来视觉动态并联合预测运动与动作，使推理时可完全移除视频生成，同时保留显式未来表示。紧凑运动表示还支持推理时扩展：采样多个运动-动作候选对，并用运动感知的任务进度验证器进行选择。

Result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus及真实世界操作任务上，MoWAM取得强分布内性能、更优的分布外鲁棒性，以及高于代表性WAM基线的真实世界平均成功率。随候选数量增加，性能持续提升。

Conclusion: 显式未来运动预测为推理时扩展提供了高效且有效的基础，在保持效率的同时增强鲁棒性。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by incorporating future dynamics, yet explicitly generating future videos at inference introduces substantial computational overhead. Removing future generation improves efficiency, but leaves future dynamics only implicitly encoded in observation features, which can limit robustness under distribution shifts. We propose MoWAM, an efficient WAM that replaces future video generation with explicit future motion prediction. Instead of reconstructing the complete future scene, MoWAM models structured robot motion as a compact abstraction of the future, capturing how the robot is expected to evolve under the current scene and interaction constraints. A Mixture-of-Transformer architecture learns future visual dynamics during training while jointly predicting motion and action, allowing video generation to be removed entirely at inference while retaining an explicit representation of the future. The compact motion representation further enables efficient inference-time scaling by sampling multiple candidates of motion and action pairs and selecting among them with a motion-aware task-progress verifier. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that MoWAM achieves strong in-distribution performance, improved out-of-distribution robustness, and higher average real-world success than representative WAM baselines. In addition, performance improves as more candidates are explored, demonstrating that explicit future motion provides an effective and efficient basis for inference-time scaling.

</details>


### [534] [Underwater Visual Target Tracking with Target-Specific Depth Estimation and Adaptive Model-Fusion Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20731)
*Yuheng Zhou,Haiyang Cheng,Yanqi Feng,Pangkit Fong,Mei Xuan Lee,Marcus Gee,Chongrong Fang,Jianping He*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 面向AUV的水下视觉目标跟踪受深度测量不可靠与目标运动未知困扰。本文提出立体视觉伺服框架：感知端通过目标专用深度提取与卡尔曼滤波获得稳定3D相对状态；控制端解耦偏航调节与平移控制，采用自适应模型融合MPC实时求解平移指令。仿真与实机实验验证其优于现有框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下视觉目标跟踪面临两大挑战：一是深度测量不可靠（水下成像质量差、目标像素深度噪声大），二是目标运动模式未知。现有框架难以在保证实时性的同时处理上述不确定性，因此需要一个既能稳定获取3D相对状态、又能适应不同目标运动模式的视觉伺服方案。

Method: 感知部分：从立体图像中通过目标专用深度提取与卡尔曼滤波得到稳定的3D相对状态；利用颜色、视差和时间线索构建目标深度掩膜以筛选可靠目标像素，随后对深度测量值与检测到的图像中心分别滤波。控制部分：将偏航调节与平移控制解耦，避免计算量大的耦合多自由度优化，从而实现实时平移MPC；平移控制器采用自适应模型融合预测控制，融合恒速与零速目标模型以适应不同运动模式，并依据历史预测误差更新模型权重，在驱动能力、跟随距离和视野约束下计算平移指令。

Result: 通过仿真与真实世界实验验证了所提框架的有效性，并表明其性能优于现有框架。

Conclusion: 该立体视觉伺服框架通过"感知端滤波去噪＋控制端解耦与自适应模型融合"的组合，兼顾了3D状态估计的稳定性、目标运动模式的适应性以及实时性，可作为AUV水下目标跟踪的有效方案。

Abstract: Vision-based underwater target tracking is challenged by unreliable depth measurements and unknown target motion. This paper proposes a stereo visual-servoing framework for an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV). For perception, the framework derives a stable 3D relative state from stereo images through target-specific depth extraction and Kalman filtering. It constructs a target-depth mask from color, disparity, and temporal cues to select reliable target pixels, and then filters the resulting depth measurement and detected image center separately. For control, the framework decouples yaw regulation from translational control, avoiding computationally expensive coupled multi-DOF optimization and enabling real-time translational MPC. The translational controller employs adaptive model-fusion predictive control, combining constant-velocity and zero-velocity target models to accommodate different target-motion patterns. It updates the model weights using historical prediction errors and computes translational commands subject to actuation, following-distance, and field-of-view constraints. Through simulations and real-world experiments, we validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and show it has better performance than existing frameworks.

</details>


### [535] [MILER: Semantic Mid-Level Representation for Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning in Unstructured Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20747)
*Thomas Steinecker,Denis Trescher,Alexander Bienemann,Thorsten Luettel,Mirko Maehlisch*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MILER提出端到端策略框架，通过中层语义表征仿真器与BEVFusion感知对齐、轨迹对齐控制，实现非结构化环境下零样本sim-to-real自动驾驶，并在真实车辆上完成17.3 km无人干预测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习具备超越人类性能与自学习策略的潜力，但在真实世界自动驾驶中应用仍很稀少，尤其在非结构化环境中，主要难点在于该场景下的sim-to-real迁移困难。

Method: 离线阶段使用自定义语义中层表征（MLR）仿真器，用强化学习训练策略网络，控制输出直接作用于自行车模型；部署阶段用BEVFusion处理相机与LiDAR数据，生成与MLR仿真器一致的语义鸟瞰图表征；策略网络输出不直接作用于实车，而采用轨迹对齐策略实现感知与控制的零样本sim-to-real迁移。

Result: 在包含多种障碍物、发夹弯、最高33.6 km/h速度及越野路段的多样测试道上评估，两辆不同车辆在3.0 km测试道上累计无人干预行驶17.3 km；整个软件栈运行于Jetson AGX Orin。

Conclusion: 所提MILER框架验证了在非结构化环境中实现零样本sim-to-real感知与控制迁移的有效性，并可在嵌入式平台上实时部署。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning constitutes a promising approach owing to its potential for superhuman performance and self-learned policies. However, its application to real-world autonomous driving remains scarce, particularly in unstructured environments, because of the challenges associated with sim-to-real transfer for unstructured environments. In this work, we present MILER, an end-to-end policy framework with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. During offline training, we employ a custom semantic mid-level representation (MLR) simulator and train the policy network using reinforcement learning, with its control outputs applied directly to a bicycle model. During deployment on the real vehicle, camera and LiDAR data are processed by BEVFusion to generate a semantic bird's-eye-view representation consistent with that of the MLR simulator. The actions generated by the policy network are not applied directly to the real vehicle. Instead, we employ a trajectory-alignment strategy that enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of both perception and control. We extensively evaluate the proposed framework on a diverse test track comprising numerous challenges, including various obstacles, hairpin curves, velocities of up to 33.6 km/h, and off-road sections. In total, we drove 17.3 km with two different vehicles on a 3.0 km test track without human intervention, thereby demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach. Furthermore, the entire software stack runs on a Jetson AGX Orin.

</details>


### [536] [OPTED: On-Policy Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Driving using a Render-Free Teacher](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20756)
*Damiano Da Col,Maximilian Igl,Peter Karkus,Kashyap Chitta,Boris Ivanovic,Marco Pavone,Konrad Schindler,Christos Sakaridis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出OPTED框架，通过特权教师模型解耦强化学习与端到端策略的后训练，在AlpaSim中微调相机模型，驾驶得分提升最高9.5倍，样本效率提升约三个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅靠扩大预训练数据收益递减，后训练愈发重要。端到端驾驶策略以开环行为克隆预训练，闭环部署时误差累积会使车辆偏离训练分布，增加安全风险。闭环后训练可缓解该问题，但基于传感器的策略需要昂贵的仿真，直接RL后训练成本高。

Method: OPTED将RL与端到端策略后训练解耦：先在向量化输入（HD地图与边界框）上用RL训练特权教师，再由该教师为预训练学生模型提供闭环后训练监督。在AlpaSim中，利用真实驾驶日志的神经重建（3DGS）对TransFuser和VaVAM两个相机模型进行微调。

Result: 驾驶得分分别提升1.6倍（TransFuser）和9.5倍（VaVAM）。在受控实验中，OPTED以约三个数量级更少的仿真交互达到与直接RL后训练相当的闭环性能，同时更贴近人类驾驶先验。

Conclusion: OPTED以特权教师监督替代直接RL，实现了高效且样本经济的闭环后训练，在提升闭环驾驶性能的同时保留人类先验，为物理AI领域的端到端策略后训练提供了可行路径。

Abstract: As scaling pre-training data alone yields diminishing returns, post-training is becoming increasingly important across physical AI domains such as autonomous driving. End-to-end driving policies are pre-trained in open loop with behavior cloning on human demonstrations. However, compounding errors during closed-loop deployment can take the vehicle outside the training data distribution, increasing the risk of safety-critical incidents. Closed-loop post-training can mitigate this risk but requires costly simulation for sensor-based policies. We propose OPTED (on-policy fine-tuning for end-to-end driving) which decouples reinforcement learning from the post-training of the end-to-end policy: a privileged teacher is trained using RL on vectorized inputs (HD-map and bounding boxes). This teacher then provides supervision to the pre-trained student during closed-loop post-training. We apply OPTED to two camera-based models, TransFuser and VaVAM, and fine-tune them in AlpaSim, using neural reconstructions (3DGS) of real driving logs. Driving scores increase by factors of 1.6$\times$ and 9.5$\times$, respectively. In controlled experiments OPTED matches closed-loop performance with approximately three orders of magnitude fewer simulator interactions than direct RL post-training, while staying closer to the human prior. Project page: https://01dami23.github.io/opted/

</details>


### [537] [Agile-WAM: An Agile Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20761)
*Hanchu Zhou,Brendan Lynch,Raman Goyal,Dechen Gao,Begum Kasap,Boqi Zhao,Junshan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出TARO——一种轻量敏捷的触觉世界动作模型，通过共享潜空间与流匹配联合生成动作块及未来视觉/触觉潜表示，并结合多时域多模态预测应对视觉与触觉的不同时间尺度特性，在仿真与真实任务中实现高成功率与低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 触觉世界动作模型（WAMs）可联合预测未来世界状态与机器人动作，学习支持有效控制的物理动态。但现有触觉WAM多依赖大规模预训练生成式骨干网络捕捉接触丰富的物理动态，导致推理效率低、部署不灵活。因此需要一种敏捷架构，能在保证控制性能的同时降低推理延迟，适配高频精确的机器人控制。

Method: TARO将视觉与触觉观测编码为共享潜空间，作为"视觉-触觉到动作"直接流匹配过程的来源，联合生成动作块潜表示以及未来视觉/触觉潜变量。针对视觉与触觉信号时间尺度不同的特点（相邻视觉帧高度相似，触觉信号在接触时突变），引入多时域多模态预测：对视觉潜变量施以更大时间偏移的监督，而触觉潜变量预测下一帧，以捕捉细粒度接触动态。

Result: 在9个仿真和5个真实世界接触丰富操作任务上，TARO表现强劲且稳健，成功率超越最强基线，同时保持低推理延迟。真实实验中总体成功率相对提升29.4%，推理延迟为11.9 ms。

Conclusion: 结果表明，多模态世界动作模型可通过敏捷架构实现，适用于精确、高频率的机器人控制。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) advance beyond conventional visuomotor policies by jointly predicting future world states and robot actions, enabling the policy to learn physical dynamics that support effective control. However, recent tactile WAMs often rely on large-scale pretrained generative backbones to capture contact-rich physical dynamics, which limit their inference efficiency and flexible deployment. In this paper, we present \ABBR{}, an agile tactile World Action Model for contact-rich robot control. \ABBR{} encodes visual and tactile observations into a shared latent that serves as the source of a direct vision-tactile-to-action flow-matching process, which can jointly generate latent representations of action chunks and future visual/tactile latents. A key observation is that vision and tactile signals evolve at inherently different timescales: adjacent visual frames are often highly similar, whereas tactile signals can change abruptly upon contact. We therefore introduce multi-horizon multimodal prediction in \ABBR{}, which provides supervision for visual latent at a larger temporal offset while predicting the tactile latent in the next frame to capture fine-grained contact dynamics. Across nine simulated and five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, \ABBR{} demonstrates strong and robust performance, outperforming the strongest baseline in success rate while maintaining low inference latency. In particular, in five real-world experiments, \ABBR{} yields a relative gain of $\textbf{29.4\%}$ in overall success rates while achieving inference latency of $\textbf{11.9 ms}$.
